     5	// Statistical analysis layer: outlier detection, trend regression, Pareto
     6	// concentration, payment aging and generated insights.
     7	//
     8	// Ported from the reference dashboard's useAIEngine, with its mock-data
     9	// assumptions corrected for the real schema — each fix is noted at the site.
    10	// All functions are pure and take already-filtered data.
    11	
    12	// --- Statistics primitives ---
    13	
    14	export interface Stats {
    15	  mean: number;
    16	  stdDev: number;
    17	  n: number;
    18	}
    19	
    20	/**
    21	 * Mean and sample standard deviation in one pass over the array.
    22	 *
    23	 * The reference called mean()/stdDev() from inside a loop over the same
    24	 * array, making outlier detection O(n^2) — tolerable for a 200-row mock,
    25	 * ~144M operations on 12k real invoices. Computing the stats once and
    26	 * reusing them makes it O(n).
    27	 */
    28	export function computeStats(values: number[]): Stats {
    29	  const n = values.length;
    30	  if (n === 0) return { mean: 0, stdDev: 0, n: 0 };
    31	
    32	  let sum = 0;
    33	  for (const v of values) sum += v;
    34	  const mean = sum / n;
    35	
    36	  if (n < 2) return { mean, stdDev: 0, n };
    37	
    38	  let sqDiff = 0;
    39	  for (const v of values) sqDiff += (v - mean) ** 2;
    40	  return { mean, stdDev: Math.sqrt(sqDiff / (n - 1)), n };
    41	}
    42	
    43	export function zScoreFrom(value: number, stats: Stats): number {
    44	  return stats.stdDev === 0 ? 0 : (value - stats.mean) / stats.stdDev;
    45	}
    46	
    47	export function coefficientOfVariation(stats: Stats): number {
    48	  return stats.mean === 0 ? 0 : stats.stdDev / stats.mean;
    49	}
    50	
    51	export interface Regression {
    52	  slope: number;
    53	  intercept: number;
    54	  rSquared: number;
    55	  forecast: number;
    56	}
    57	
    58	/** Ordinary least squares against the series index, plus a one-step-ahead
    59	 *  forecast and R² goodness of fit. */
    60	export function linearRegression(ys: number[]): Regression {
    61	  const n = ys.length;
    62	  if (n < 2) return { slope: 0, intercept: ys[0] ?? 0, rSquared: 0, forecast: ys[0] ?? 0 };
    63	
    64	  const xMean = (n - 1) / 2;
    65	  const yStats = computeStats(ys);
    66	  const yMean = yStats.mean;
    67	
    68	  let num = 0;
    69	  let den = 0;
    70	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    71	    num += (i - xMean) * (ys[i] - yMean);
    72	    den += (i - xMean) ** 2;
    73	  }
    74	
    75	  const slope = den === 0 ? 0 : num / den;
    76	  const intercept = yMean - slope * xMean;
    77	
    78	  let ssRes = 0;
    79	  let ssTot = 0;
    80	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    81	    ssRes += (ys[i] - (intercept + slope * i)) ** 2;
    82	    ssTot += (ys[i] - yMean) ** 2;
    83	  }
    84	
    85	  return {
    86	    slope,
    87	    intercept,
    88	    rSquared: ssTot === 0 ? 0 : 1 - ssRes / ssTot,
    89	    // Clamped at zero: a steep downward slope extrapolates to negative
    90	    // revenue, which is never a meaningful projection to show.
    91	    forecast: Math.max(0, intercept + slope * n),
    92	  };
    93	}
    94	
    95	// --- Anomaly detection ---
    96	
    97	export type AnomalySeverity = "critical" | "warning" | "info";
    98	export type AnomalyType =
    99	  | "outlier_amount"
   100	  | "high_entropy"
   101	  | "low_confidence"
   102	  | "ambiguous_margin"
   103	  | "price_spike"
   104	  | "missing_due_date";
   105	
   106	export interface Anomaly {
   107	  id: string;
   108	  type: AnomalyType;
   109	  severity: AnomalySeverity;
   110	  entity: string;
   111	  entityId: string;
   112	  metric: string;
   113	  value: number;
   114	  expected: number;
   115	  zScore: number;
   116	  /** Structured payload so the UI can localize instead of receiving prose. */
   117	  context: Record<string, string | number>;
   118	}
   119	
   120	const AMOUNT_Z_WARNING = 2.5;
   121	const AMOUNT_Z_CRITICAL = 3.5;
   122	const LOW_CONFIDENCE = 0.65;
   123	const CRITICAL_CONFIDENCE = 0.55;
   124	/** margin is CHECK-constrained to 0..1 and measures top1 minus top2 score:
   125	 *  LOW margin means the model nearly tied two categories. The reference
   126	 *  flagged `margin > 35`, which is unreachable under that constraint and
   127	 *  backwards besides — a high margin is a confident prediction. */
   128	const AMBIGUOUS_MARGIN = 0.05;
   129	
   130	/**
   131	 * Business anomalies by default.
   132	 *
   133	 * The classifier's own uncertainty signals — entropy, confidence, margin —
   134	 * are model diagnostics, not something a GM can act on, so they are excluded
   135	 * from the client-facing surface. The detectors are retained behind
   136	 * `includePipelineSignals` for whoever maintains the classifier.
   137	 */
   138	export function detectAnomalies(
   139	  invoices: Invoice[],
   140	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   141	  { includePipelineSignals = false }: { includePipelineSignals?: boolean } = {}
   142	): Anomaly[] {
   143	  const anomalies: Anomaly[] = [];
   144	
   145	  // 1. Invoice total outliers.
   146	  const amounts = invoices.map((inv) => inv.total_amount ?? 0);
   147	  const amountStats = computeStats(amounts);
   148	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   149	    const z = zScoreFrom(inv.total_amount ?? 0, amountStats);
   150	    if (Math.abs(z) > AMOUNT_Z_WARNING) {
   151	      anomalies.push({
   152	        id: `amt-${inv.invoice_id}`,
   153	        type: "outlier_amount",
   154	        severity: Math.abs(z) > AMOUNT_Z_CRITICAL ? "critical" : "warning",
   155	        entity: inv.invoice_folio,
   156	        entityId: inv.invoice_id,
   157	        metric: "total_amount",
   158	        value: inv.total_amount ?? 0,
   159	        expected: amountStats.mean,
   160	        zScore: z,
   161	        context: {
   162	          folio: inv.invoice_folio,
   163	          seller: inv.seller_name,
   164	          buyer: inv.buyer_name,
   165	          direction: z > 0 ? "above" : "below",
   166	        },
   167	      });
   168	    }
   169	  }
   170	
   171	  // 2. High-entropy classifications. Pipeline diagnostic, so gated.
   172	  // Threshold is data-driven (z > 2) rather than the reference's fixed
   173	  // 1.8/2.2 — entropy is unbounded in this schema and its scale depends on
   174	  // the category count, so a hardcoded cutoff either floods or never fires
   175	  // depending on the taxonomy size.
   176	  const entropies = items.map((i) => i.entropy);
   177	  const entropyStats = computeStats(entropies);
   178	  for (const item of items) {
   179	    const z = zScoreFrom(item.entropy, entropyStats);
   180	    if (includePipelineSignals && z > 2) {
   181	      anomalies.push({
   182	        id: `ent-${item.item_id}`,
   183	        type: "high_entropy",
   184	        severity: z > 3 ? "critical" : "warning",
   185	        entity: item.item_text,
   186	        entityId: item.item_id,
   187	        metric: "entropy",
   188	        value: item.entropy,
   189	        expected: entropyStats.mean,
   190	        zScore: z,
   191	        context: { itemText: item.item_text, entropy: item.entropy.toFixed(2) },
   192	      });
   193	    }
   194	  }
   195	
   196	  // 3. Low-confidence predictions. Pipeline diagnostic.
   197	  for (const item of items) {
   198	    if (includePipelineSignals && item.top1_score < LOW_CONFIDENCE) {
   199	      anomalies.push({
   200	        id: `conf-${item.item_id}`,
   201	        type: "low_confidence",
   202	        severity: item.top1_score < CRITICAL_CONFIDENCE ? "critical" : "warning",
   203	        entity: item.item_text,
   204	        entityId: item.item_id,
   205	        metric: "top1_score",
   206	        value: item.top1_score,
   207	        expected: 0.85,
   208	        zScore: 0,
   209	        context: {
   210	          itemText: item.item_text,
   211	          scorePct: Math.round(item.top1_score * 100),
   212	        },
   213	      });
   214	    }
   215	  }
   216	
   217	  // 4. Ambiguous predictions. Pipeline diagnostic.
   218	  for (const item of items) {
   219	    if (includePipelineSignals && item.margin < AMBIGUOUS_MARGIN && !item.reviewed) {
   220	      anomalies.push({
   221	        id: `mar-${item.item_id}`,
   222	        type: "ambiguous_margin",
   223	        severity: item.margin < 0.02 ? "warning" : "info",
   224	        entity: item.item_text,
   225	        entityId: item.item_id,
   226	        metric: "margin",
   227	        value: item.margin,
   228	        expected: AMBIGUOUS_MARGIN,
   229	        zScore: 0,
   230	        context: {
   231	          itemText: item.item_text,
   232	          margin: item.margin.toFixed(3),
   233	          predicted: item.predicted_name ?? item.predicted_code,
   234	        },
   235	      });
   236	    }
   237	  }
   238	
   239	  // 5. Unit-price spikes for the same catalog item, against that item's own
   240	  // history rather than a global mean — comparing a litre of milk to a
   241	  // forklift tells you nothing.
   242	  const byCatalogItem = new Map<string, InvoiceItem[]>();
   243	  for (const item of items) {
   244	    if (item.unit_price === null) continue;
   245	    const list = byCatalogItem.get(item.catalog_item_id);
   246	    if (list) list.push(item);
   247	    else byCatalogItem.set(item.catalog_item_id, [item]);
   248	  }
   249	  for (const [, group] of byCatalogItem) {
   250	    if (group.length < 5) continue; // too few observations for a meaningful z
   251	    const priceStats = computeStats(group.map((i) => i.unit_price as number));
   252	    for (const item of group) {
   253	      const z = zScoreFrom(item.unit_price as number, priceStats);
   254	      if (z > 2.5) {
   255	        anomalies.push({
   256	          id: `price-${item.item_id}`,
   257	          type: "price_spike",
   258	          severity: z > 3.5 ? "critical" : "warning",
   259	          entity: item.item_text,
   260	          entityId: item.item_id,
   261	          metric: "unit_price",
   262	          value: item.unit_price as number,
   263	          expected: priceStats.mean,
   264	          zScore: z,
   265	          context: {
   266	            itemText: item.item_text,
   267	            paid: item.unit_price as number,
   268	            usual: Math.round(priceStats.mean),
   269	          },
   270	        });
   271	      }
   272	    }
   273	  }
   274	
   275	  // 6. Credit-term invoices with no due date — an AP blind spot rather than a
   276	  // statistical outlier, but it belongs on the same worklist.
   277	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   278	    if (!inv.due_date && inv.transaction_type === "COMPRAS") {
   279	      anomalies.push({
   280	        id: `due-${inv.invoice_id}`,

--- ai 281-560 ---
   281	        type: "missing_due_date",
   282	        severity: "info",
   283	        entity: inv.invoice_folio,
   284	        entityId: inv.invoice_id,
   285	        metric: "due_date",
   286	        value: 0,
   287	        expected: 0,
   288	        zScore: 0,
   289	        context: { folio: inv.invoice_folio, seller: inv.seller_name },
   290	      });
   291	    }
   292	  }
   293	
   294	  const severityRank: Record<AnomalySeverity, number> = { critical: 0, warning: 1, info: 2 };
   295	  return anomalies.sort(
   296	    (a, b) => severityRank[a.severity] - severityRank[b.severity] || Math.abs(b.zScore) - Math.abs(a.zScore)
   297	  );
   298	}

   300	// --- Trend analysis ---
   301	
   302	export type TrendDirection = "up" | "down" | "flat";
   303	
   304	export interface TrendAnalysis {
   305	  metricKey: string;
   306	  slope: number;
   307	  rSquared: number;
   308	  direction: TrendDirection;
   309	  volatility: number;
   310	  forecast: number;
   311	  confidence: number;
   312	  latest: number;
   313	}
   314	
   315	export function analyzeTrends(invoices: Invoice[], items: InvoiceItem[]): TrendAnalysis[] {
   316	  const byPeriod = new Map<
   317	    string,
   318	    { total: number; count: number; ventas: number; compras: number; lines: number }
   319	  >();
   320	
   321	  const linesByInvoice = new Map<string, number>();
   322	  for (const item of items) {
   323	    linesByInvoice.set(item.invoice_id, (linesByInvoice.get(item.invoice_id) ?? 0) + 1);
   324	  }
   325	
   326	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   327	    const key = periodOf(inv);
   328	    let entry = byPeriod.get(key);
   329	    if (!entry) {
   330	      entry = { total: 0, count: 0, ventas: 0, compras: 0, lines: 0 };
   331	      byPeriod.set(key, entry);
   332	    }
   333	    const total = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   334	    entry.total += total;
   335	    entry.count += 1;
   336	    if (inv.transaction_type === "VENTAS") entry.ventas += total;
   337	    else entry.compras += total;
   338	    entry.lines += linesByInvoice.get(inv.invoice_id) ?? 0;
   339	  }
   340	
   341	  const periods = Array.from(byPeriod.keys()).sort();
   342	  if (periods.length < 3) return [];
   343	
   344	  const series = (pick: (v: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof byPeriod.get>>) => number) =>
   345	    periods.map((p) => pick(byPeriod.get(p)!));
   346	
   347	  const build = (metricKey: string, ys: number[]): TrendAnalysis => {
   348	    const { slope, rSquared, forecast } = linearRegression(ys);
   349	    const stats = computeStats(ys);
   350	    // Direction is judged against the series MEAN, not ys[0]. The reference
   351	    // used `slope > ys[0] * 0.02`, which misclassifies any series starting
   352	    // at or near zero and inverts entirely on a negative first value.
   353	    const threshold = Math.abs(stats.mean) * 0.02;
   354	    const direction: TrendDirection =
   355	      slope > threshold ? "up" : slope < -threshold ? "down" : "flat";
   356	
   357	    return {
   358	      metricKey,
   359	      slope,
   360	      rSquared,
   361	      direction,
   362	      volatility: coefficientOfVariation(stats),
   363	      forecast,
   364	      confidence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rSquared)),
   365	      latest: ys[ys.length - 1] ?? 0,
   366	    };
   367	  };
   368	
   369	  return [
   370	    build("totalRevenue", series((v) => v.total)),
   371	    build("invoiceVolume", series((v) => v.count)),
   372	    build("ventas", series((v) => v.ventas)),
   373	    build("compras", series((v) => v.compras)),
   374	    build("lineVolume", series((v) => v.lines)),
   375	  ];
   376	}

   378	// --- Pareto / concentration ---
   379	
   380	export type ParetoDimension = "seller" | "buyer" | "category" | "city" | "item";
   381	
   382	export interface ParetoEntry {
   383	  key: string;
   384	  name: string;
   385	  amount: number;
   386	  count: number;
   387	  pct: number;
   388	  cumulativePct: number;
   389	}
   390	
   391	export interface ParetoResult {
   392	  entries: ParetoEntry[];
   393	  total: number;
   394	  /** How many entries account for 80% of the total. */
   395	  paretoCount: number;
   396	  paretoPct: number;
   397	  /** Herfindahl-Hirschman Index over percentage shares (0–10,000). */
   398	  hhi: number;
   399	  /** Share held by the single largest entry, 0–100. */
   400	  topShare: number;
   401	}
   402	
   403	export function analyzePareto(
   404	  invoices: Invoice[],
   405	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   406	  dimension: ParetoDimension,
   407	  categoriesById: Map<string, Category>
   408	): ParetoResult {
   409	  const map = new Map<string, { name: string; amount: number; count: number }>();
   410	  const add = (key: string, name: string, amount: number) => {
   411	    let entry = map.get(key);
   412	    if (!entry) {
   413	      entry = { name, amount: 0, count: 0 };
   414	      map.set(key, entry);
   415	    }
   416	    entry.amount += amount;
   417	    entry.count += 1;
   418	  };
   419	
   420	  if (dimension === "seller") {
   421	    for (const inv of invoices) add(inv.seller_rut, inv.seller_name, inv.total_amount ?? 0);
   422	  } else if (dimension === "buyer") {
   423	    for (const inv of invoices) add(inv.buyer_rut, inv.buyer_name, inv.total_amount ?? 0);
   424	  } else if (dimension === "city") {
   425	    // Attribute to the counterparty's city rather than always the seller's:
   426	    // on a VENTAS invoice the seller is us, so the reference's seller-only
   427	    // rule collapsed every sale into our own city.
   428	    for (const inv of invoices) {
   429	      const city =
   430	        (inv.transaction_type === "COMPRAS" ? inv.seller_city : inv.buyer_city) ?? "";
   431	      add(city || "__unknown__", city, inv.total_amount ?? 0);
   432	    }
   433	  } else if (dimension === "category") {
   434	    // Uses the EFFECTIVE category. The reference matched final_categories_id
   435	    // only, so every unreviewed line — the majority — fell into "Sin
   436	    // categoría" and understated every real category.
   437	    for (const item of items) {
   438	      const id = effectiveCategoryId(item);
   439	      const category = categoriesById.get(id);
   440	      add(id, category?.name ?? item.predicted_name ?? item.predicted_code, item.amount ?? 0);
   441	    }
   442	  } else {
   443	    for (const item of items) add(item.catalog_item_id, item.item_text, item.amount ?? 0);
   444	  }
   445	
   446	  const sorted = Array.from(map.entries())
   447	    .map(([key, v]) => ({ key, ...v }))
   448	    .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount);
   449	
   450	  const total = sorted.reduce((s, v) => s + v.amount, 0);
   451	
   452	  let cumulative = 0;
   453	  let paretoCount = 0;
   454	  let reachedPareto = false;
   455	  const entries: ParetoEntry[] = sorted.map((v) => {
   456	    const pct = total > 0 ? (v.amount / total) * 100 : 0;
   457	    cumulative += pct;
   458	    if (!reachedPareto) {
   459	      paretoCount += 1;
   460	      if (cumulative >= 80) reachedPareto = true;
   461	    }
   462	    return { ...v, pct, cumulativePct: cumulative };
   463	  });
   464	
   465	  const hhi = entries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.pct ** 2, 0);
   466	
   467	  return {
   468	    entries,
   469	    total,
   470	    paretoCount,
   471	    paretoPct: entries.length > 0 ? (paretoCount / entries.length) * 100 : 0,
   472	    hhi,
   473	    topShare: entries[0]?.pct ?? 0,
   474	  };
   475	}

   477	// --- Payment analysis ---
   478	
   479	export interface PaymentMetric {
   480	  paymentForm: string;
   481	  count: number;
   482	  totalAmount: number;
   483	  avgAmount: number;
   484	  pct: number;
   485	}
   486	
   487	export type AgingBucketKey = "no_due_date" | "current" | "1-30" | "31-60" | "61-90" | "90+";
   488	
   489	export interface AgingBucket {
   490	  key: AgingBucketKey;
   491	  count: number;
   492	  amount: number;
   493	}
   494	
   495	export interface PaymentAnalysis {
   496	  paymentMetrics: PaymentMetric[];
   497	  agingBuckets: AgingBucket[];
   498	  totalOverdue: number;
   499	  overdueCount: number;
   500	  overduePct: number;
   501	  total: number;
   502	  avgTermDays: number | null;
   503	}
   504	
   505	const AGING_ORDER: AgingBucketKey[] = [
   506	  "no_due_date",
   507	  "current",
   508	  "1-30",
   509	  "31-60",
   510	  "61-90",
   511	  "90+",
   512	];
   513	
   514	/**
   515	 * Payment-form mix and due-date aging.
   516	 *
   517	 * Three corrections against the reference:
   518	 *  - `asOf` is a parameter, not a hardcoded `new Date('2024-10-31')`.
   519	 *  - Invoices with no due_date get their own bucket. The reference did
   520	 *    `new Date(null)` → Invalid Date → NaN comparisons, which fell through
   521	 *    every branch into "90+ days overdue" and silently invented overdue debt.
   522	 *  - No hardcoded 'Contado' skip. That literal only existed in the mock's
   523	 *    payment_form values; real values are unconstrained, so cash invoices are
   524	 *    identified by simply having no due date.
   525	 *
   526	 * As with the AP tab, this schema has no paid/settled flag, so "overdue"
   527	 * means past due date, not necessarily unpaid.
   528	 */
   529	export function analyzePayments(invoices: Invoice[], asOf: Date): PaymentAnalysis {
   530	  const payMap = new Map<string, PaymentMetric>();
   531	  const buckets = new Map<AgingBucketKey, AgingBucket>(
   532	    AGING_ORDER.map((key) => [key, { key, count: 0, amount: 0 }])
   533	  );
   534	
   535	  let total = 0;
   536	  let totalOverdue = 0;
   537	  let overdueCount = 0;
   538	  let termSum = 0;
   539	  let termCount = 0;
   540	
   541	  const asOfMs = asOf.getTime();
   542	
   543	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   544	    const amount = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   545	    total += amount;
   546	
   547	    const form = inv.payment_form ?? "";
   548	    let metric = payMap.get(form);
   549	    if (!metric) {
   550	      metric = { paymentForm: form, count: 0, totalAmount: 0, avgAmount: 0, pct: 0 };
   551	      payMap.set(form, metric);
   552	    }
   553	    metric.count += 1;
   554	    metric.totalAmount += amount;
   555	
   556	    if (!inv.due_date) {
   557	      const bucket = buckets.get("no_due_date")!;
   558	      bucket.count += 1;
   559	      bucket.amount += amount;
   560	      continue;

--- ai 561-820 ---
   561	    }
   562	
   563	    const dueMs = new Date(`${inv.due_date}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
   564	    const issuedMs = new Date(`${inv.invoice_date}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
   565	    if (Number.isFinite(dueMs) && Number.isFinite(issuedMs)) {
   566	      termSum += (dueMs - issuedMs) / 86_400_000;
   567	      termCount += 1;
   568	    }
   569	
   570	    const overdueDays = Math.floor((asOfMs - dueMs) / 86_400_000);
   571	    const key: AgingBucketKey =
   572	      overdueDays <= 0
   573	        ? "current"
   574	        : overdueDays <= 30
   575	          ? "1-30"
   576	          : overdueDays <= 60
   577	            ? "31-60"
   578	            : overdueDays <= 90
   579	              ? "61-90"
   580	              : "90+";
   581	
   582	    const bucket = buckets.get(key)!;
   583	    bucket.count += 1;
   584	    bucket.amount += amount;
   585	
   586	    if (key !== "current") {
   587	      totalOverdue += amount;
   588	      overdueCount += 1;
   589	    }
   590	  }
   591	
   592	  const paymentMetrics = Array.from(payMap.values())
   593	    .map((m) => ({
   594	      ...m,
   595	      avgAmount: m.count > 0 ? m.totalAmount / m.count : 0,
   596	      pct: total > 0 ? (m.totalAmount / total) * 100 : 0,
   597	    }))
   598	    .sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount);
   599	
   600	  return {
   601	    paymentMetrics,
   602	    agingBuckets: AGING_ORDER.map((key) => buckets.get(key)!),
   603	    totalOverdue,
   604	    overdueCount,
   605	    overduePct: invoices.length > 0 ? (overdueCount / invoices.length) * 100 : 0,
   606	    total,
   607	    avgTermDays: termCount > 0 ? termSum / termCount : null,
   608	  };
   609	}

   613	export interface GeoEntry {
   614	  city: string;
   615	  totalAmount: number;
   616	  ventas: number;
   617	  compras: number;
   618	  invoiceCount: number;
   619	  counterparties: number;
   620	}
   621	
   622	export function analyzeGeography(invoices: Invoice[]): GeoEntry[] {
   623	  const map = new Map<string, GeoEntry & { rutSet: Set<string> }>();
   624	
   625	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   626	    // Attribute to the counterparty's city — theirs is the location that
   627	    // varies; ours is the same on every row and would swamp the chart.
   628	    const isPurchase = inv.transaction_type === "COMPRAS";
   629	    const city = (isPurchase ? inv.seller_city : inv.buyer_city) ?? "";
   630	    const rut = isPurchase ? inv.seller_rut : inv.buyer_rut;
   631	    const key = city || "__unknown__";
   632	
   633	    let entry = map.get(key);
   634	    if (!entry) {
   635	      entry = {
   636	        city,
   637	        totalAmount: 0,
   638	        ventas: 0,
   639	        compras: 0,
   640	        invoiceCount: 0,
   641	        counterparties: 0,
   642	        rutSet: new Set(),
   643	      };
   644	      map.set(key, entry);
   645	    }
   646	
   647	    const amount = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   648	    entry.totalAmount += amount;
   649	    if (isPurchase) entry.compras += amount;
   650	    else entry.ventas += amount;
   651	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   652	    entry.rutSet.add(rut);
   653	  }
   654	
   655	  return Array.from(map.values())
   656	    .map(({ rutSet, ...rest }) => ({ ...rest, counterparties: rutSet.size }))
   657	    .sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount);
   658	}

   660	// --- Trading network ---
   661	
   662	export interface NetworkEdge {
   663	  sellerRut: string;
   664	  sellerName: string;
   665	  buyerRut: string;
   666	  buyerName: string;
   667	  amount: number;
   668	  invoiceCount: number;
   669	}
   670	
   671	/**
   672	 * Seller→buyer trading pairs. Both sides are real here because the schema
   673	 * denormalizes them onto every invoice, so this is a genuine two-sided graph
   674	 * rather than a star centred on our own organisation.
   675	 */
   676	export function analyzeNetwork(invoices: Invoice[], limit = 30): NetworkEdge[] {
   677	  const map = new Map<string, NetworkEdge>();
   678	
   679	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   680	    const key = `${inv.seller_rut}>${inv.buyer_rut}`;
   681	    let edge = map.get(key);
   682	    if (!edge) {
   683	      edge = {
   684	        sellerRut: inv.seller_rut,
   685	        sellerName: inv.seller_name,
   686	        buyerRut: inv.buyer_rut,
   687	        buyerName: inv.buyer_name,
   688	        amount: 0,
   689	        invoiceCount: 0,
   690	      };
   691	      map.set(key, edge);
   692	    }
   693	    edge.amount += inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   694	    edge.invoiceCount += 1;
   695	  }
   696	
   697	  return Array.from(map.values())
   698	    .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount)
   699	    .slice(0, limit);
   700	}

   702	// --- Generated insights ---
   703	
   704	export type InsightTone = "positive" | "negative" | "neutral" | "warning";
   705	
   706	export interface Insight {
   707	  id: string;
   708	  tone: InsightTone;
   709	  /** Translation key under Dashboard.insights.*; values fill its ICU params. */
   710	  messageKey: string;
   711	  values: Record<string, string | number>;
   712	  priority: number;
   713	}
   714	
   715	/**
   716	 * Builds the narrative summary shown at the top of the Overview tab.
   717	 *
   718	 * Returns translation keys plus values rather than assembled Spanish strings
   719	 * (as the reference did), so the same logic serves both locales.
   720	 */
   721	/**
   722	 * The narrative summary on the Overview tab.
   723	 *
   724	 * Deliberately excludes two families the client-facing dashboard does not
   725	 * carry: extrapolated trend/forecast statements, and classifier throughput
   726	 * (auto-accept rate). What remains is grounded in invoices actually issued
   727	 * and received — concentration, net position, and flagged anomalies.
   728	 */
   729	export function generateInsights(
   730	  invoices: Invoice[],
   731	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   732	  anomalies: Anomaly[],
   733	  pareto: ParetoResult
   734	): Insight[] {
   735	  const insights: Insight[] = [];
   736	
   737	  if (pareto.entries.length > 0) {
   738	    insights.push({
   739	      id: "concentration",
   740	      tone: pareto.topShare > 40 ? "warning" : "neutral",
   741	      messageKey: "concentration",
   742	      values: {
   743	        count: pareto.paretoCount,
   744	        totalEntities: pareto.entries.length,
   745	        topName: pareto.entries[0].name,
   746	        topShare: pareto.topShare.toFixed(1),
   747	      },
   748	      priority: pareto.topShare > 40 ? 2 : 5,
   749	    });
   750	  }
   751	
   752	  const critical = anomalies.filter((a) => a.severity === "critical").length;
   753	  if (critical > 0) {
   754	    insights.push({
   755	      id: "critical-anomalies",
   756	      tone: "negative",
   757	      messageKey: "criticalAnomalies",
   758	      values: { count: critical },
   759	      priority: 0,
   760	    });
   761	  }
   762	
   763	  const ventas = invoices
   764	    .filter((i) => i.transaction_type === "VENTAS")
   765	    .reduce((s, i) => s + (i.total_amount ?? 0), 0);
   766	  const compras = invoices
   767	    .filter((i) => i.transaction_type === "COMPRAS")
   768	    .reduce((s, i) => s + (i.total_amount ?? 0), 0);
   769	  if (ventas > 0 && compras > 0) {
   770	    insights.push({
   771	      id: "margin",
   772	      tone: ventas > compras ? "positive" : "warning",
   773	      messageKey: ventas > compras ? "netPositive" : "netNegative",
   774	      values: { net: Math.round(Math.abs(ventas - compras)) },
   775	      priority: 4,
   776	    });
   777	  }
   778	
   779	  return insights.sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
   780	}

    28	function formatPeriod(period: string, locale: string): string {
    29	  // period is "YYYY-MM" straight off the generated column.
    30	  const [year, month] = period.split("-");
    31	  if (!year || !month) return period;
    32	  return new Date(Number(year), Number(month) - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString(locale, {
    33	    month: "short",
    34	    year: "2-digit",
    35	  });
    36	}
    37

    56	          <AreaChart data={data} margin={{ left: 4, right: 8 }}>
    57	            <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
    58	            <XAxis
    59	              dataKey="period"
    60	              tickLine={false}
    61	              axisLine={false}

--- src/components/analytics/fiscal-breakdown.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     4	import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
     5	import { ExactValue, SectionCard, useCLP } from "./primitives";
     6	import type { KpiData } from "@/lib/analytics/aggregate";
     7	
     8	const SWATCHES = ["bg-blue-500", "bg-purple-500", "bg-emerald-500"];
     9	
    10	/**
    11	 * Net + IVA + exempt composition of invoice totals.
    12	 *
    13	 * These three are invoice-level columns, so they're summed over invoices, not
    14	 * lines. Percentages are taken against the summed total_amount; if the source
    15	 * documents don't balance exactly the parts simply won't reach 100%, which is
    16	 * shown rather than normalized away.
    17	 */
    18	export function FiscalBreakdown({ kpis, linesReady }: { kpis: KpiData; linesReady: boolean }) {
    19	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.fiscal");
    20	  const clp = useCLP();
    21	
    22	  const rows = [
    23	    { label: t("net"), value: kpis.netAmount },
    24	    { label: t("iva"), value: kpis.ivaAmount },
    25	    { label: t("exempt"), value: kpis.exemptAmount },
    26	  ];
    27	
    28	  return (
    29	    <SectionCard title={t("title")} description={t("subtitle")}>
    30	      <div className="space-y-4">
    31	        {rows.map((row, index) => {
    32	          const pct = kpis.totalRevenue > 0 ? (row.value / kpis.totalRevenue) * 100 : 0;
    33	          return (
    34	            <div key={row.label}>
    35	              <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 mb-1.5">
    36	                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
    37	                  <span className={`size-2 rounded-full shrink-0 ${SWATCHES[index]}`} />
    38	                  <span className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{row.label}</span>
    39	                </div>
    40	                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 ml-auto">
    41	                  <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">
    42	                    {clp.full(row.value)}
    43	                  </span>
    44	                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums shrink-0">
    45	                    {pct.toFixed(1)}%
    46	                  </span>
    47	                </div>
    48	              </div>
    49	              <Progress value={Math.min(100, pct)} className="h-2" />
    50	            </div>
    51	          );
    52	        })}
    53	
    54	        <div className="pt-3 border-t flex flex-wrap justify-between items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5">
    55	          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{t("total")}</span>
    56	          <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap ml-auto">
    57	            {clp.full(kpis.totalRevenue)}
    58	          </span>
    59	        </div>
    60	
    61	        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-1">
    62	          <MiniStat label={t("invoices")} value={clp.num(kpis.totalInvoices)} />
    63	          <MiniStat
    64	            label={t("avg")}
    65	            value={clp.compact(kpis.avgInvoiceValue)}
    66	            exact={clp.full(kpis.avgInvoiceValue)}
    67	          />
    68	          <MiniStat label={t("lines")} value={linesReady ? clp.num(kpis.totalLines) : "—"} />
    69	        </div>
    70	
    71	        {linesReady && (kpis.discountTotal > 0 || kpis.recargoTotal > 0) && (
    72	          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
    73	            <MiniStat
    74	              label={t("discounts")}
    75	              value={clp.compact(kpis.discountTotal)}
    76	              exact={clp.full(kpis.discountTotal)}
    77	            />
    78	            <MiniStat
    79	              label={t("surcharges")}
    80	              value={clp.compact(kpis.recargoTotal)}
    81	              exact={clp.full(kpis.recargoTotal)}
    82	            />
    83	          </div>
    84	        )}
    85	      </div>
    86	    </SectionCard>
    87	  );
    88	}
    89	
    90	/**
    91	 * A narrow tile in a 2- or 3-up grid, so the value has very little room.
    92	 * `min-w-0` lets it shrink inside the grid track (grid items default to
    93	 * min-width:auto and refuse to), and `truncate` bounds the failure to an
    94	 * ellipsis instead of text spilling outside the card.
    95	 */
    96	function MiniStat({ label, value, exact }: { label: string; value: string; exact?: string }) {
    97	  return (
    98	    <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/50 p-2.5 text-center min-w-0 overflow-hidden">
    99	      <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground truncate">{label}</p>
   100	      <ExactValue
   101	        display={value}
   102	        exact={exact}
   103	        className="block text-sm sm:text-base font-bold tabular-nums mt-0.5 truncate"
   104	      />
   105	    </div>
   106	  );
   107	}

--- src/components/analytics/counterparty-panel.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     4	import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
     5	import { EmptyState, MeterRow, SectionCard, useCLP } from "./primitives";
     6	import type { CounterpartyMetric } from "@/lib/analytics/aggregate";
     7	import type { TransactionTypeFilter } from "@/lib/analytics/filters";
     8	
     9	interface CounterpartyPanelProps {
    10	  metrics: CounterpartyMetric[];
    11	  role: "seller" | "buyer";
    12	  /** Selects that company in the global filter, when we can resolve its id. */
    13	  onSelect?: (companyId: string) => void;
    14	  /** The active global Type filter, which changes what this panel contains. */
    15	  transactionType: TransactionTypeFilter;
    16	}
    17	
    18	/**
    19	 * Resolves the heading and caption from the role AND the active Type filter.
    20	 *
    21	 * "Seller" is not a stable concept: on a purchase invoice it is a supplier, on
    22	 * a sales invoice it is our own organisation. A fixed heading over content
    23	 * that changes with the filter is what made this panel read as wrong — it was
    24	 * ranking our own revenue against our suppliers' invoices in one column and
    25	 * calling the whole thing "Top Sellers".
    26	 */
    27	function resolveScope(role: "seller" | "buyer", type: TransactionTypeFilter) {
    28	  if (type === "COMPRAS") {
    29	    return role === "seller"
    30	      ? { title: "topSuppliers", hint: "hintSuppliers" }
    31	      : { title: "topBuyersSelf", hint: "hintBuyersSelf" };
    32	  }
    33	  if (type === "VENTAS") {
    34	    return role === "seller"
    35	      ? { title: "topSellersSelf", hint: "hintSellersSelf" }
    36	      : { title: "topCustomers", hint: "hintCustomers" };
    37	  }
    38	  // Type = All pools both directions, so each side necessarily contains our
    39	  // own organisation. Name it for what it literally is and say so.
    40	  return role === "seller"
    41	    ? { title: "topIssuers", hint: "hintIssuersAll" }
    42	    : { title: "topRecipients", hint: "hintRecipientsAll" };
    43	}
    44	
    45	export function CounterpartyPanel({
    46	  metrics,
    47	  role,
    48	  onSelect,
    49	  transactionType,
    50	}: CounterpartyPanelProps) {
    51	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.counterparties");
    52	  const clp = useCLP();
    53	
    54	  const max = metrics.length > 0 ? metrics[0].totalAmount : 1;
    55	  const scope = resolveScope(role, transactionType);
    56	
    57	  return (
    58	    <SectionCard title={t(scope.title)} description={t(scope.hint)}>
    59	      {metrics.length === 0 ? (
    60	        <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />
    61	      ) : (
    62	        <div className="space-y-1">
    63	          {metrics.map((m, index) => (
    64	            <MeterRow
    65	              key={m.rut}
    66	              rank={index + 1}
    67	              primary={m.name}
    68	              secondary={[
    69	                t("invoices", { count: m.invoiceCount }),
    70	                t("avg", { value: clp.compact(m.avgAmount) }),
    71	                m.giro ?? "",
    72	              ]
    73	                .filter(Boolean)
    74	                .join(" · ")}
    75	              value={clp.compact(m.totalAmount)}
    76	              exact={clp.full(m.totalAmount)}
    77	              fraction={max > 0 ? m.totalAmount / max : 0}
    78	              badge={
    79	                m.city ? (
    80	                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 font-normal">
    81	                    {m.city}
    82	                  </Badge>
    83	                ) : undefined
    84	              }
    85	              onClick={m.companyId && onSelect ? () => onSelect(m.companyId as string) : undefined}
    86	            />
    87	          ))}
    88	        </div>
    89	      )}
    90	    </SectionCard>
    91	  );
    92	}

--- src/components/analytics/insights-panel.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     4	import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Info, Sparkles, TrendingDown } from "lucide-react";
     5	import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
     6	import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
     7	import { useCLP } from "./primitives";
     8	import type { Insight, InsightTone } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
     9	
    10	const TONE_STYLES: Record<InsightTone, { wrap: string; icon: typeof Info }> = {
    11	  positive: {
    12	    wrap: "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/5 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400",
    13	    icon: CheckCircle2,
    14	  },
    15	  negative: {
    16	    wrap: "border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/5 text-red-700 dark:text-red-400",
    17	    icon: TrendingDown,
    18	  },
    19	  warning: {
    20	    wrap: "border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/5 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400",
    21	    icon: AlertTriangle,
    22	  },
    23	  neutral: { wrap: "border-border bg-muted/40 text-foreground", icon: Info },
    24	};
    25	
    26	export function InsightsPanel({ insights }: { insights: Insight[] }) {
    27	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.insights");
    28	  const clp = useCLP();
    29	
    30	  if (insights.length === 0) return null;
    31	
    32	  return (
    33	    <Card>
    34	      <CardHeader className="pb-3">
    35	        <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
    36	          <Sparkles className="size-4" />
    37	          {t("title")}
    38	        </CardTitle>
    39	        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("subtitle")}</p>
    40	      </CardHeader>
    41	      <CardContent className="pt-0">
    42	        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
    43	          {insights.map((insight) => {
    44	            const style = TONE_STYLES[insight.tone];
    45	            const Icon = style.icon;
    46	            // Money values arrive as raw numbers so they can be formatted in
    47	            // the viewer's locale here rather than baked into the message.
    48	            const values: Record<string, string | number> = { ...insight.values };
    49	            if (typeof values.forecast === "number") {
    50	              values.forecast = clp.compact(values.forecast);
    51	            }
    52	            if (typeof values.net === "number") values.net = clp.compact(values.net);
    53	
    54	            return (
    55	              <div
    56	                key={insight.id}
    57	                className={cn(
    58	                  "flex items-start gap-2.5 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm",
    59	                  style.wrap
    60	                )}
    61	              >
    62	                <Icon className="size-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
    63	                <p className="leading-snug">{t(insight.messageKey, values)}</p>
    64	              </div>
    65	            );
    66	          })}
    67	        </div>
    68	      </CardContent>
    69	    </Card>
    70	  );
    71	}

--- src/components/analytics/tabs/categories-tab.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useMemo } from "react";
     4	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     5	import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
     6	import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
     7	import { EmptyState, useCLP } from "../primitives";
     8	import type { CategoryMetric } from "@/lib/analytics/aggregate";
     9	
    10	interface CategoriesTabProps {
    11	  metrics: CategoryMetric[];
    12	  onSelect: (categoryId: string) => void;
    13	}
    14	
    15	export function CategoriesTab({ metrics, onSelect }: CategoriesTabProps) {
    16	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.categories");
    17	  const clp = useCLP();
    18	
    19	  // Share of classified line value, computed here rather than carried on the
    20	  // metric: it is a property of the current filter, not of the category.
    21	  const grandTotal = useMemo(
    22	    () => metrics.reduce((sum, m) => sum + m.totalAmount, 0),
    23	    [metrics]
    24	  );
    25	
    26	  if (metrics.length === 0) return <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />;
    27	
    28	  return (
    29	    <div className="space-y-4">
    30	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
    31	        {metrics.slice(0, 12).map((m) => {
    32	          const sharePct = grandTotal > 0 ? (m.totalAmount / grandTotal) * 100 : 0;
    33	          return (
    34	            <button
    35	              key={m.categoriesId}
    36	              onClick={() => onSelect(m.categoriesId)}
    37	              className="text-left rounded-lg border p-3 hover:bg-accent/40 transition-colors"
    38	            >
    39	              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
    40	                <div className="min-w-0">
    41	                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 mb-1 font-mono">
    42	                    {m.code}
    43	                  </Badge>
    44	                  <p className="text-sm font-medium leading-snug truncate">{m.name}</p>
    45	                </div>
    46	                <span
    47	                  className="text-sm font-bold shrink-0 tabular-nums"
    48	                  title={clp.full(m.totalAmount)}
    49	                >
    50	                  {clp.compact(m.totalAmount)}
    51	                </span>
    52	              </div>
    53	              <div className="space-y-1.5">
    54	                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
    55	                  <span>{t("share")}</span>
    56	                  <span className="tabular-nums">{sharePct.toFixed(1)}%</span>
    57	                </div>
    58	                <Progress value={Math.min(100, sharePct)} className="h-1.5" />
    59	                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-0.5">
    60	                  <span>{t("lines", { count: m.itemCount })}</span>
    61	                  <span>·</span>
    62	                  <span>{t("items", { count: m.distinctItems })}</span>
    63	                </div>
    64	              </div>
    65	            </button>
    66	          );
    67	        })}
    68	      </div>
    69	    </div>
    70	  );
    71	}

    13	import type { AgingBucketKey, PaymentAnalysis } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
    14	
    15	// Aging is a risk signal, not a neutral magnitude ramp — reuse the app's
    16	// green/amber/orange/red attention idiom rather than a sequential palette.
    17	const BUCKET_COLORS: Record<AgingBucketKey, string> = {
    18	  no_due_date: "#94a3b8",
    19	  current: "#22c55e",
    20	  "1-30": "#84cc16",
    21	  "31-60": "#f59e0b",
    22	  "61-90": "#f97316",
    23	  "90+": "#ef4444",
    24	};
    25	
    26	export function PaymentsTab({ analysis }: { analysis: PaymentAnalysis }) {
    27	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.payments");
    28	  const clp = useCLP();
    29	
    30	  const chartData = analysis.agingBuckets.map((b) => ({
    31	    key: b.key,
    32	    label: t(`bucket_${b.key}`),
    33	    amount: b.amount,
    34	    count: b.count,
    35	    fill: BUCKET_COLORS[b.key],
    36	  }));
    37	
    38	  const config: ChartConfig = { amount: { label: t("amount"), color: "#94a3b8" } };
    39	  const maxPayment = analysis.paymentMetrics[0]?.totalAmount ?? 1;
    40	
    41	  return (
    42	    <div className="space-y-4">
    43	      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">

    52	          exact={clp.full(analysis.total)}

    73	          hint={t("avgTermsHint")}
    74	        />
    75	      </div>

    77	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
    78	        <SectionCard title={t("agingTitle")} description={t("agingHint")}>

    89	              />

   100	                ))}
   101	              </Bar>
   102	            </BarChart>
   103	          </ChartContainer>
   104	        </SectionCard>
   105	
   106	        <SectionCard title={t("formsTitle")} description={t("formsHint")}>
   107	          {analysis.paymentMetrics.length === 0 ? (

    23	import { analyzePareto } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
    24	import type { NetworkEdge, ParetoDimension } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
    25	import type { Category, Invoice, InvoiceItem } from "@/lib/analytics/types";
    26	
    27	interface ConcentrationTabProps {
    28	  invoices: Invoice[];
    29	  items: InvoiceItem[];
    30	  categoriesById: Map<string, Category>;
    31	  network: NetworkEdge[];
    32	}
    33	
    34	const DIMENSIONS: ParetoDimension[] = ["seller", "buyer", "category", "city", "item"];
    35	
    36	/** HHI thresholds follow the standard antitrust reading: under 1500 is
    37	 *  unconcentrated, 1500–2500 moderate, above 2500 highly concentrated. */
    38	function hhiTone(hhi: number): "positive" | "warning" | "negative" {
    39	  if (hhi < 1500) return "positive";
    40	  if (hhi < 2500) return "warning";
    41	  return "negative";
    42	}
    43	
    44	export function ConcentrationTab({
    45	  invoices,
    46	  items,
    47	  categoriesById,
    48	  network,
    49	}: ConcentrationTabProps) {
    50	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.concentration");
    51	  const clp = useCLP();
    52	  const [dimension, setDimension] = useState<ParetoDimension>("seller");
    53	
    54	  const pareto = useMemo(
    55	    () => analyzePareto(invoices, items, dimension, categoriesById),
    56	    [invoices, items, dimension, categoriesById]
    57	  );
    58	
    59	  const chartData = useMemo(
    60	    () =>
    61	      pareto.entries.slice(0, 15).map((e) => ({
    62	        name: e.name.length > 16 ? `${e.name.slice(0, 14)}…` : e.name,
    63	        amount: e.amount,
    64	        cumulative: e.cumulativePct,
    65	      })),
    66	    [pareto.entries]
    67	  );
    68	
    69	  const config: ChartConfig = {
    70	    amount: { label: t("amount"), theme: CHART_SERIES[0] },
    71	    cumulative: { label: t("cumulative"), theme: CHART_SERIES[1] },
    72	  };
    73	
    74	  const maxNetwork = network[0]?.amount ?? 1;
    75	
    76	  return (
    77	    <div className="space-y-4">
    78	      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
    79	        {DIMENSIONS.map((d) => (
    80	          <Button
    81	            key={d}
    82	            size="sm"
    83	            variant={dimension === d ? "default" : "outline"}
    84	            className="h-7 text-xs"
    85	            onClick={() => setDimension(d)}
    86	          >
    87	            {t(`dim_${d}`)}
    88	          </Button>
    89	        ))}
    90	      </div>
    91	
    92	      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
    93	        <StatCard
    94	          label={t("hhi")}
    95	          value={pareto.hhi.toFixed(0)}
    96	          tone={hhiTone(pareto.hhi)}
    97	          hint={t(
    98	            pareto.hhi < 1500 ? "hhiLow" : pareto.hhi < 2500 ? "hhiModerate" : "hhiHigh"
    99	          )}
   100	        />
   101	        <StatCard
   102	          label={t("paretoCount")}
   103	          value={clp.num(pareto.paretoCount)}
   104	          hint={t("paretoHint", {
   105	            pct: pareto.paretoPct.toFixed(0),
   106	            total: pareto.entries.length,
   107	          })}
   108	        />
   109	        <StatCard
   110	          label={t("topShare")}
   111	          value={clp.pct(pareto.topShare)}
   112	          tone={pareto.topShare > 40 ? "warning" : "default"}
   113	          hint={pareto.entries[0]?.name}
   114	        />
   115	        <StatCard label={t("totalEntities")} value={clp.num(pareto.entries.length)} />
   116	      </div>
   117	
   118	      <SectionCard title={t("paretoTitle")} description={t("paretoDescription")}>
   119	        {chartData.length === 0 ? (
   120	          <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />
   121	        ) : (
   122	          <ChartContainer config={config} className="aspect-auto h-[300px] w-full">
   123	            <ComposedChart data={chartData} margin={{ left: 4, right: 8 }}>
   124	              <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
   125	              <XAxis
   126	                dataKey="name"
   127	                tickLine={false}
   128	                axisLine={false}
   129	                tick={{ fontSize: 9 }}
   130	                interval={0}
   131	                angle={-30}
   132	                textAnchor="end"
   133	                height={70}
   134	              />
   135	              {/* Two y-axes here are legitimate and not the dual-axis
   136	                  anti-pattern: a Pareto chart's cumulative line is a fixed
   137	                  0-100% scale by definition, not a second measure invited
   138	                  into a false correlation with the bars. */}
   139	              <YAxis
   140	                yAxisId="left"
   141	                tickLine={false}
   142	                axisLine={false}
   143	                width={56}
   144	                tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}

   146	              />
   147	              <YAxis
   148	                yAxisId="right"
   149	                orientation="right"
   150	                domain={[0, 100]}
   151	                tickLine={false}
   152	                axisLine={false}
   153	                width={40}

   156	              />
   157	              <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
   158	              <Bar yAxisId="left" dataKey="amount" fill="var(--color-amount)" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} />
   159	              <Line
   160	                yAxisId="right"
   161	                dataKey="cumulative"
   162	                type="monotone"
   163	                stroke="var(--color-cumulative)"

   166	              />
   167	            </ComposedChart>
   168	          </ChartContainer>
   169	        )}
   170	      </SectionCard>

   189	                    <TableCell className="max-w-[200px]">

    64	                  count: e.counterparties,

    66	                value={clp.compact(e.totalAmount)}
    67	                exact={clp.full(e.totalAmount)}
    68	                fraction={max > 0 ? e.totalAmount / max : 0}
    69	                onClick={e.city ? () => onSelectCity(e.city) : undefined}
    70	              />
    71	            ))}
    72	          </div>
    73	        </SectionCard>
    74	
    75	        <SectionCard title={t("splitTitle")} description={t("splitHint")}>

   102	                }

   121	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("invoicesCol")}</TableHead>

     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useMemo } from "react";
     4	import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
     5	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     6	import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
     7	import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
     8	import {
     9	  Table,
    10	  TableBody,
    11	  TableCell,
    12	  TableHead,
    13	  TableHeader,
    14	  TableRow,
    15	} from "@/components/ui/table";
    16	import {
    17	  ChartContainer,
    18	  ChartTooltip,
    19	  ChartTooltipContent,
    20	  type ChartConfig,
    21	} from "@/components/ui/chart";
    22	import { CHART_SERIES } from "@/lib/dashboard/colors";
    23	import { EmptyState, SectionCard, StatCard, useCLP } from "../primitives";
    24	import {
    25	  aggregateScoreDistribution,
    26	  displayItemName,
    27	  selectReviewQueue,
    28	} from "@/lib/analytics/aggregate";
    29	import type { AiSourceMetric } from "@/lib/analytics/aggregate";
    30	import type { CatalogItem, Category, Invoice, InvoiceItem } from "@/lib/analytics/types";
    31	
    32	interface ModelTabProps {
    33	  items: InvoiceItem[];
    34	  sourceMetrics: AiSourceMetric[];
    35	  invoicesById: Map<string, Invoice>;
    36	  categoriesById: Map<string, Category>;
    37	  catalogById: Map<string, CatalogItem>;
    38	}
    39	
    40	const SOURCE_KEYS: Record<string, string> = {
    41	  model: "sourceModel",
    42	  product_lookup: "sourceProductLookup",
    43	  meter_lookup: "sourceMeterLookup",
    44	};
    45	
    46	export function ModelTab({
    47	  items,
    48	  sourceMetrics,
    49	  invoicesById,
    50	  categoriesById,
    51	  catalogById,
    52	}: ModelTabProps) {
    53	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.model");
    54	  const clp = useCLP();
    55	
    56	  const distribution = useMemo(() => aggregateScoreDistribution(items), [items]);
    57	  const queue = useMemo(
    58	    () => selectReviewQueue(items, invoicesById, 30),
    59	    [items, invoicesById]
    60	  );
    61	
    62	  const modelVersions = useMemo(() => {
    63	    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    64	    for (const item of items) {
    65	      if (!item.model_version) continue;
    66	      counts.set(item.model_version, (counts.get(item.model_version) ?? 0) + 1);
    67	    }
    68	    return Array.from(counts.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    69	  }, [items]);
    70	
    71	  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    72	    let reviewed = 0;
    73	    let corrected = 0;
    74	    let scoreSum = 0;
    75	    for (const item of items) {
    76	      if (item.reviewed) reviewed += 1;
    77	      if (item.final_categories_id && item.final_categories_id !== item.predicted_categories_id) {
    78	        corrected += 1;
    79	      }
    80	      scoreSum += item.top1_score;
    81	    }
    82	    return {
    83	      reviewed,
    84	      corrected,
    85	      // Of the lines a human actually looked at, how many did the model get
    86	      // wrong — the only honest accuracy signal available here, since
    87	      // unreviewed lines have no ground truth.
    88	      correctionRate: reviewed > 0 ? (corrected / reviewed) * 100 : null,
    89	      avgScore: items.length > 0 ? scoreSum / items.length : 0,
    90	    };
    91	  }, [items]);
    92	
    93	  const config: ChartConfig = { count: { label: t("lines"), theme: CHART_SERIES[0] } };
    94	
    95	  if (items.length === 0) return <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />;
    96	
    97	  return (
    98	    <div className="space-y-4">
    99	      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   100	        <StatCard label={t("avgConfidence")} value={clp.pct(summary.avgScore * 100)} />
   101	        <StatCard label={t("reviewedLines")} value={clp.num(summary.reviewed)} />
   102	        <StatCard
   103	          label={t("correctionRate")}
   104	          value={summary.correctionRate === null ? "—" : clp.pct(summary.correctionRate)}
   105	          tone={summary.correctionRate !== null && summary.correctionRate > 20 ? "warning" : "default"}
   106	          hint={t("correctionRateHint")}
   107	        />
   108	        <StatCard
   109	          label={t("modelVersion")}
   110	          value={modelVersions[0]?.[0] ?? "—"}
   111	          hint={
   112	            modelVersions.length > 1 ? t("multipleVersions", { count: modelVersions.length }) : undefined
   113	          }
   114	        />
   115	      </div>
   116	
   117	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
   118	        <SectionCard title={t("confidenceTitle")} description={t("confidenceHint")}>
   119	          <ChartContainer config={config} className="aspect-auto h-[240px] w-full">
   120	            <BarChart data={distribution} margin={{ left: 4, right: 8 }}>
   121	              <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
   122	              <XAxis
   123	                dataKey="bucket"
   124	                tickLine={false}
   125	                axisLine={false}
   126	                tick={{ fontSize: 9 }}
   127	                interval={0}
   128	              />
   129	              <YAxis tickLine={false} axisLine={false} width={44} tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} allowDecimals={false} />
   130	              <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
   131	              <Bar dataKey="count" fill="var(--color-count)" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} />
   132	            </BarChart>
   133	          </ChartContainer>
   134	        </SectionCard>
   135	
   136	        <SectionCard title={t("sourcesTitle")} description={t("sourcesHint")}>
   137	          <div className="space-y-3">
   138	            {sourceMetrics.map((s) => {
   139	              const key = SOURCE_KEYS[s.source];
   140	              return (
   141	                <div key={s.source}>
   142	                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1">
   143	                    <span className="text-sm font-medium">{key ? t(key) : s.source}</span>
   144	                    <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums">{clp.num(s.count)}</span>
   145	                  </div>
   146	                  <Progress value={s.autoAcceptRate} className="h-1.5" />
   147	                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
   148	                    <span>{t("autoRate", { pct: s.autoAcceptRate.toFixed(0) })}</span>
   149	                    <span>{t("avgScore", { score: (s.avgScore * 100).toFixed(0) })}</span>
   150	                    <span>{t("avgMargin", { margin: s.avgMargin.toFixed(3) })}</span>
   151	                    <span>{t("avgEntropy", { entropy: s.avgEntropy.toFixed(2) })}</span>
   152	                  </div>
   153	                </div>
   154	              );
   155	            })}
   156	          </div>
   157	        </SectionCard>
   158	      </div>
   159	
   160	      <SectionCard title={t("queueTitle")} description={t("queueHint")}>
   161	        {queue.length === 0 ? (
   162	          <EmptyState message={t("queueEmpty")} />
   163	        ) : (
   164	          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
   165	            <Table>
   166	              <TableHeader>
   167	                <TableRow>
   168	                  <TableHead>{t("item")}</TableHead>
   169	                  <TableHead>{t("counterparty")}</TableHead>
   170	                  <TableHead>{t("predicted")}</TableHead>
   171	                  <TableHead>{t("alternatives")}</TableHead>
   172	                  <TableHead className="text-right">{t("confidence")}</TableHead>
   173	                  <TableHead className="text-right">{t("margin")}</TableHead>
   174	                  <TableHead className="text-right">{t("entropy")}</TableHead>
   175	                </TableRow>
   176	              </TableHeader>
   177	              <TableBody>
   178	                {queue.map(({ item, invoice }) => {
   179	                  // top3 is jsonb on the row — the model's ranked runners-up.
   180	                  // Showing them turns "this is uncertain" into "here are the
   181	                  // two options it was torn between", which is what a
   182	                  // reviewer actually needs to decide.
   183	                  const alternatives = item.top3
   184	                    .filter((c) => c.categories_id !== item.predicted_categories_id)
   185	                    .slice(0, 2);
   186	                  return (
   187	                    <TableRow key={item.item_id}>
   188	                      <TableCell className="max-w-[220px]">
   189	                        <span className="text-sm font-medium block truncate">
   190	                          {displayItemName(item, catalogById)}
   191	                        </span>
   192	                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block truncate">
   193	                          {item.item_text}
   194	                        </span>
   195	                        {item.meter_code && (
   196	                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">
   197	                            {item.meter_code}
   198	                          </span>
   199	                        )}
   200	                      </TableCell>
   201	                      <TableCell className="max-w-[160px]">
   202	                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block truncate">
   203	                          {invoice ? invoice.seller_name : "—"}
   204	                        </span>
   205	                      </TableCell>
   206	                      <TableCell>
   207	                        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">
   208	                          {item.predicted_name ?? item.predicted_code}
   209	                        </Badge>
   210	                      </TableCell>
   211	                      <TableCell>
   212	                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
   213	                          {alternatives.length === 0 && (
   214	                            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>
   215	                          )}
   216	                          {alternatives.map((c, i) => (
   217	                            <span key={`${item.item_id}-${i}`} className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
   218	                              {c.name ??
   219	                                (c.categories_id
   220	                                  ? categoriesById.get(c.categories_id)?.name
   221	                                  : undefined) ??
   222	                                c.code ??
   223	                                "—"}
   224	                              {typeof c.score === "number" && (
   225	                                <span className="font-mono ml-1">
   226	                                  {(c.score * 100).toFixed(0)}%
   227	                                </span>
   228	                              )}
   229	                            </span>
   230	                          ))}
   231	                        </div>
   232	                      </TableCell>
   233	                      <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   234	                        {(item.top1_score * 100).toFixed(0)}%
   235	                      </TableCell>
   236	                      <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   237	                        <span className={item.margin < 0.05 ? "text-amber-600 font-semibold" : ""}>
   238	                          {item.margin.toFixed(3)}
   239	                        </span>
   240	                      </TableCell>
   241	                      <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   242	                        {item.entropy.toFixed(2)}
   243	                      </TableCell>
   244	                    </TableRow>
   245	                  );
   246	                })}
   247	              </TableBody>
   248	            </Table>
   249	          </div>

   251	      </SectionCard>
   252	    </div>
   253	  );

     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
     4	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     5	import { AlertTriangle, Info, ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react";
     6	import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
     7	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
     8	import {
     9	  Table,
    10	  TableBody,
    11	  TableCell,
    12	  TableHead,
    13	  TableHeader,
    14	  TableRow,
    15	} from "@/components/ui/table";
    16	import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
    17	import { EmptyState, SectionCard, StatCard, useCLP } from "../primitives";
    18	import type { Anomaly, AnomalySeverity } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
    19	
    20	interface RiskTabProps {
    21	  anomalies: Anomaly[];
    22	}
    23	
    24	const SEVERITY_STYLE: Record<AnomalySeverity, { badge: string; icon: typeof Info }> = {
    25	  critical: { badge: "bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 border-red-500/30", icon: ShieldAlert },
    26	  warning: { badge: "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 border-amber-500/30", icon: AlertTriangle },
    27	  info: { badge: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border", icon: Info },
    28	};
    29	
    30	
    31	export function RiskTab({ anomalies }: RiskTabProps) {
    32	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.risk");
    33	  const clp = useCLP();
    34	  const [severityFilter, setSeverityFilter] = useState<AnomalySeverity | "all">("all");
    35	
    36	  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    37	    const byType = new Map<string, number>();
    38	    let critical = 0;
    39	    let warning = 0;
    40	    let info = 0;
    41	    for (const a of anomalies) {
    42	      byType.set(a.type, (byType.get(a.type) ?? 0) + 1);
    43	      if (a.severity === "critical") critical += 1;
    44	      else if (a.severity === "warning") warning += 1;
    45	      else info += 1;
    46	    }
    47	    return { byType: Array.from(byType.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]), critical, warning, info };
    48	  }, [anomalies]);
    49	
    50	  const visible = useMemo(
    51	    () =>
    52	      (severityFilter === "all"
    53	        ? anomalies
    54	        : anomalies.filter((a) => a.severity === severityFilter)
    55	      ).slice(0, 60),
    56	    [anomalies, severityFilter]
    57	  );
    58	
    59	  // The three pipeline cases below are unreachable on the client surface —
    60	  // detectAnomalies no longer emits them — but the switch must stay
    61	  // exhaustive over AnomalyType, which still declares them for whoever
    62	  // enables includePipelineSignals.
    63	  const describe = (a: Anomaly): string => {
    64	    switch (a.type) {
    65	      case "outlier_amount":
    66	        return t("descOutlierAmount", {
    67	          folio: String(a.context.folio),
    68	          seller: String(a.context.seller),
    69	          direction: t(a.context.direction === "above" ? "above" : "below"),
    70	          z: a.zScore.toFixed(2),
    71	        });
    72	      case "high_entropy":
    73	        return t("descHighEntropy", {
    74	          item: String(a.context.itemText).slice(0, 48),
    75	          entropy: String(a.context.entropy),
    76	        });
    77	      case "low_confidence":
    78	        return t("descLowConfidence", {
    79	          item: String(a.context.itemText).slice(0, 48),
    80	          pct: String(a.context.scorePct),
    81	        });
    82	      case "ambiguous_margin":
    83	        return t("descAmbiguous", {
    84	          item: String(a.context.itemText).slice(0, 48),
    85	          margin: String(a.context.margin),
    86	          predicted: String(a.context.predicted),
    87	        });
    88	      case "price_spike":
    89	        return t("descPriceSpike", {
    90	          item: String(a.context.itemText).slice(0, 40),
    91	          paid: clp.full(Number(a.context.paid)),
    92	          usual: clp.full(Number(a.context.usual)),
    93	        });
    94	      case "missing_due_date":
    95	        return t("descMissingDueDate", {
    96	          folio: String(a.context.folio),
    97	          seller: String(a.context.seller),
    98	        });
    99	    }
   100	  };
   101	
   102	  return (
   103	    <div className="space-y-4">
   104	      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   105	        <StatCard label={t("total")} value={clp.num(anomalies.length)} />
   106	        <StatCard label={t("critical")} value={clp.num(counts.critical)} tone={counts.critical > 0 ? "negative" : "default"} />
   107	        <StatCard label={t("warning")} value={clp.num(counts.warning)} tone={counts.warning > 0 ? "warning" : "default"} />
   108	        <StatCard label={t("info")} value={clp.num(counts.info)} />
   109	      </div>
   110	
   111	
   112	      <SectionCard
   113	        title={t("logTitle")}
   114	        description={t("logHint")}
   115	        action={
   116	          <div className="flex gap-1">
   117	            {(["all", "critical", "warning", "info"] as const).map((s) => (
   118	              <Button
   119	                key={s}
   120	                size="sm"
   121	                variant={severityFilter === s ? "default" : "outline"}
   122	                className="h-7 text-[11px] px-2"
   123	                onClick={() => setSeverityFilter(s)}
   124	              >
   125	                {t(s === "all" ? "all" : s)}
   126	              </Button>
   127	            ))}
   128	          </div>
   129	        }
   130	      >
   131	        {visible.length === 0 ? (
   132	          <EmptyState message={t("noAnomalies")} />
   133	        ) : (
   134	          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
   135	            <Table>
   136	              <TableHeader>
   137	                <TableRow>
   138	                  <TableHead className="w-[110px]">{t("severity")}</TableHead>
   139	                  <TableHead className="w-[130px]">{t("type")}</TableHead>
   140	                  <TableHead>{t("detail")}</TableHead>
   141	                  <TableHead className="text-right w-[80px]">{t("zScore")}</TableHead>
   142	                </TableRow>
   143	              </TableHeader>
   144	              <TableBody>
   145	                {visible.map((a) => {
   146	                  const style = SEVERITY_STYLE[a.severity];
   147	                  const Icon = style.icon;
   148	                  return (
   149	                    <TableRow key={a.id}>
   150	                      <TableCell>
   151	                        <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("text-[10px] gap-1", style.badge)}>
   152	                          <Icon className="size-3" />
   153	                          {t(a.severity)}
   154	                        </Badge>
   155	                      </TableCell>
   156	                      <TableCell>
   157	                        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
   158	                          {t(`type_${a.type}`)}
   159	                        </span>
   160	                      </TableCell>
   161	                      <TableCell>
   162	                        <span className="text-sm">{describe(a)}</span>
   163	                      </TableCell>
   164	                      <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   165	                        {a.zScore === 0 ? "—" : a.zScore.toFixed(2)}
   166	                      </TableCell>
   167	                    </TableRow>
   168	                  );
   169	                })}
   170	              </TableBody>
   171	            </Table>
   172	          </div>
   173	        )}
   174	      </SectionCard>
   175	    </div>
   176	  );
   177	}

    38	}: ExplorerTabProps) {

    49	      if (list) list.push(item);
    50	      else map.set(item.invoice_id, [item]);
    51	    }
    52	    // Line order is meaningful on a document — preserve it.
    53	    for (const list of map.values()) {
    54	      list.sort((a, b) => a.invoice_line_number - b.invoice_line_number);
    55	    }

    70	        )
    71	      : invoices;

    73	  }, [invoices, search]);
    74	
    75	  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    76	  const safePage = Math.min(page, pageCount - 1);
    77	  const visible = filtered.slice(safePage * PAGE_SIZE, (safePage + 1) * PAGE_SIZE);
    78	
    79	  const selectedLines = selected ? (itemsByInvoice.get(selected.invoice_id) ?? []) : [];
    80	
    81	  if (invoices.length === 0) return <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />;
    82	
    83	  return (
    84	    <div className="space-y-4">
    85	      <SectionCard
    86	        title={t("invoicesTitle")}
    87	        description={t("invoicesHint", { shown: filtered.length, total: invoices.length })}
    88	        action={
    89	          <div className="relative">
    90	            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
    91	            <Input
    92	              value={search}
    93	              onChange={(e) => {
    94	                setSearch(e.target.value);
    95	                setPage(0);
    96	              }}
    97	              placeholder={t("searchPlaceholder")}
    98	              className="h-8 w-[260px] pl-8 text-xs"
    99	            />
   100	          </div>

   330	function addressOf(invoice: Invoice, side: "seller" | "buyer"): string | null {
   331	  const parts =
   332	    side === "seller"
   333	      ? [invoice.seller_address, invoice.seller_commune, invoice.seller_city]
   334	      : [invoice.buyer_address, invoice.buyer_commune, invoice.buyer_city];
   335	  const joined = parts.filter(Boolean).join(", ");
   336	  return joined || null;
   337	}

--- src/middleware.ts ---
     1	import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from "next/server";
     2	import { createMiddlewareClient } from "@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs";
     3	import createIntlMiddleware from "next-intl/middleware";
     4	import { routing } from "./i18n/routing";
     5	import { POST_LOGIN_PATH, isPublicPath } from "./lib/auth-routes";
     6	
     7	const intlMiddleware = createIntlMiddleware(routing);
     8	
     9	const LOCALE_PATTERN = routing.locales.join("|");
    10	
    11	function localeAndPath(pathname: string) {
    12	  const match = pathname.match(new RegExp(`^/(${LOCALE_PATTERN})(/.*)?$`));
    13	  const locale = match?.[1] ?? routing.defaultLocale;
    14	  const path = match?.[2] || "/";
    15	  return { locale, path };
    16	}
    17	
    18	// Copies any Set-Cookie the Supabase middleware client wrote onto `source`
    19	// (e.g. a refreshed session) onto `target` — needed because a fresh
    20	// NextResponse.redirect(...) doesn't carry over cookies set on another
    21	// response object.
    22	function withCookies(target: NextResponse, source: NextResponse) {
    23	  source.cookies.getAll().forEach((cookie) => target.cookies.set(cookie));
    24	  return target;
    25	}
    26	
    27	export default async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
    28	  const response = intlMiddleware(request);
    29	
    30	  // next-intl already issued a redirect (e.g. "/" -> "/es") — let it through as-is.
    31	  if (response.headers.get("location")) {
    32	    return response;
    33	  }
    34	
    35	  const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req: request, res: response });
    36	
    37	  const {
    38	    data: { session },
    39	  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    40	  const user = session?.user ?? null;
    41	
    42	  const { locale, path } = localeAndPath(request.nextUrl.pathname);
    43	  const isPublic = isPublicPath(path);
    44	
    45	  if (!user && !isPublic) {
    46	    const loginUrl = new URL(`/${locale}/login`, request.url);
    47	    return withCookies(NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl), response);
    48	  }
    49	
    50	  // Already signed in and asking for the login page — send them where a fresh
    51	  // sign-in would have landed them, so there is one post-login destination
    52	  // rather than two that can drift apart.
    53	  if (user && isPublic) {
    54	    const homeUrl = new URL(`/${locale}${POST_LOGIN_PATH}`, request.url);
    55	    return withCookies(NextResponse.redirect(homeUrl), response);
    56	  }
    57	
    58	  return response;
    59	}
    60	
    61	export const config = {
    62	  // Match only internationalized pathnames
    63	  matcher: ["/", "/(es|en)/:path*"],
    64	};

--- src/lib/auth-routes.ts ---
     1	/**
     2	 * Route constants shared by the middleware, the app shell and the login page.
     3	 *
     4	 * These were previously duplicated: `PUBLIC_PATHS` was declared separately in
     5	 * `middleware.ts` and `app-shell.tsx`, and the post-login destination was a
     6	 * bare string in the login page. Adding a public route to one copy and not the
     7	 * other produces either a redirect loop or a login screen wearing the app
     8	 * sidebar, so they live in one place.
     9	 *
    10	 * Every path here is locale-agnostic — the `/es` or `/en` prefix is applied by
    11	 * next-intl's navigation helpers, and stripped again by its `usePathname`.
    12	 */
    13	
    14	/** Reachable without a session. Everything else redirects to the login page. */
    15	export const PUBLIC_PATHS = ["/login"] as const;
    16	
    17	/** Where a user lands once authenticated. */
    18	export const POST_LOGIN_PATH = "/dashboard";
    19	
    20	export function isPublicPath(path: string): boolean {
    21	  return (PUBLIC_PATHS as readonly string[]).includes(path);
    22	}
