--- src/lib/supabase/server.ts ---
     1	import { createServerComponentClient } from "@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs";
     2	import { cookies } from "next/headers";
     3	
     4	export async function createClient() {
     5	  // auth-helpers-nextjs@0.10.0 calls `context.cookies()` synchronously and
     6	  // expects a cookie store with .get()/.set() back immediately. Next.js 16's
     7	  // `cookies()` is async, so we resolve it once up front and hand back a
     8	  // closure that returns the already-resolved store — cookie writes from here
     9	  // are still no-ops in this adapter either way (Server Components can't set
    10	  // cookies), which is why middleware is what actually refreshes the session.
    11	  // The package's bundled types still declare `cookies` as returning the raw
    12	  // `next/headers` async type, which no longer matches how it's actually used
    13	  // at runtime — hence the cast.
    14	  const cookieStore = await cookies();
    15	
    16	  return createServerComponentClient({
    17	    cookies: (() => cookieStore) as unknown as typeof cookies,
    18	  });
    19	}

    10	const geistSans = Geist({
    11	  variable: "--font-geist-sans",
    12	  subsets: ["latin"],
    13	});
    14

    16	  variable: "--font-geist-mono",
    17	  subsets: ["latin"],
    18	});
    19	
    20	export const metadata: Metadata = {
    21	  title: "Antillanca SPA - Sistema de Adquisiciones",
    22	  description: "Gestión de compras y control presupuestario",
    23	};
    24	
    25	export default async function RootLayout({
    26	  children,
    27	  params,
    28	}: {
    29	  children: React.ReactNode;
    30	  params: Promise<{ locale: string }>;
    31	}) {
    32	  const { locale } = await params;
    33	
    34	  // Ensure that the incoming `locale` is valid
    35	  if (!routing.locales.includes(locale as any)) {
    36	    notFound();
    37	  }

    45	      <body

--- src/app/[locale]/login/page.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useState } from "react";
     4	import { useTranslations, useLocale } from "next-intl";
     5	import { usePathname, useRouter, routing } from "@/i18n/routing";
     6	import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
     7	import { POST_LOGIN_PATH } from "@/lib/auth-routes";
     8	import { Milk, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
     9	import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
    10	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    11	import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
    12	import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
    13	import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
    14	
    15	export default function LoginPage() {
    16	  const t = useTranslations("Auth.login");
    17	  const languageT = useTranslations("Header.languageSelector");
    18	  const locale = useLocale();
    19	  const pathname = usePathname();
    20	  const router = useRouter();
    21	
    22	  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
    23	  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
    24	  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
    25	  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    26	
    27	  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    28	    e.preventDefault();
    29	    setIsSubmitting(true);
    30	    setError(null);
    31	
    32	    const supabase = createClient();
    33	    const { error: signInError } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
    34	      email,
    35	      password,
    36	    });
    37	
    38	    if (signInError) {
    39	      setError(t("error.invalidCredentials"));
    40	      setIsSubmitting(false);
    41	      return;
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    router.push(POST_LOGIN_PATH);
    45	    router.refresh();
    46	  };
    47	
    48	  return (
    49	    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 bg-muted/30 px-4">
    50	      <Card className="w-full max-w-sm shadow-lg">
    51	        {/* shadcn's CardHeader is a grid, so `items-center` aligned nothing
    52	            horizontally and the logo sat left of the centred text. Switch the
    53	            header to a flex column so the mark centres with the copy. */}
    54	        <CardHeader className="flex flex-col items-center text-center gap-2">
    55	          <div className="flex aspect-square size-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
    56	            <Milk className="size-5" />
    57	          </div>
    58	          <CardTitle className="text-xl">{t("title")}</CardTitle>
    59	          <CardDescription>{t("subtitle")}</CardDescription>
    60	        </CardHeader>
    61	        <CardContent>
    62	          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
    63	            <div className="grid gap-2">
    64	              <Label htmlFor="email">{t("email")}</Label>
    65	              <Input
    66	                id="email"
    67	                type="email"
    68	                required
    69	                autoComplete="email"
    70	                value={email}
    71	                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
    72	                placeholder={t("emailPlaceholder")}
    73	              />
    74	            </div>
    75	            <div className="grid gap-2">
    76	              <Label htmlFor="password">{t("password")}</Label>
    77	              <Input
    78	                id="password"
    79	                type="password"
    80	                required
    81	                autoComplete="current-password"
    82	                value={password}
    83	                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
    84	                placeholder={t("passwordPlaceholder")}
    85	              />
    86	            </div>
    87	
    88	            {error && <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>}
    89	
    90	            <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={isSubmitting}>
    91	              {isSubmitting ? (
    92	                <>
    93	                  <Loader2 className="size-4 animate-spin" />
    94	                  {t("submitting")}
    95	                </>
    96	              ) : (
    97	                t("submit")
    98	              )}
    99	            </Button>
   100	          </form>
   101	        </CardContent>
   102	      </Card>
   103	
   104	      {/* The header's language switcher lives inside AppShell, which login is
   105	          deliberately excluded from — so without this the sign-in screen is the
   106	          one place the locale can't be changed. */}
   107	      <div className="flex items-center gap-1" role="group" aria-label="Language">
   108	        {routing.locales.map((code) => (
   109	          <Button
   110	            key={code}
   111	            type="button"
   112	            variant="ghost"
   113	            size="sm"
   114	            aria-current={code === locale ? "true" : undefined}
   115	            onClick={() => {
   116	              if (code !== locale) router.replace(pathname, { locale: code });
   117	            }}
   118	            className={cn(
   119	              "h-7 px-2.5 text-xs",
   120	              code === locale
   121	                ? "text-foreground font-semibold"
   122	                : "text-muted-foreground font-normal"
   123	            )}
   124	          >
   125	            {languageT(code === "es" ? "spanish" : "english")}
   126	          </Button>
   127	        ))}
   128	      </div>
   129	    </div>
   130	  );
   131	}

--- src/components/header.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
     4	import { usePathname, useRouter } from "@/i18n/routing";
     5	import { SidebarTrigger } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";
     6	import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";
     7	import { UserRole, useRoleLabels } from "@/lib/roles";
     8	import { createClient } from "@/lib/supabase/client";
     9	import {
    10	  Select,
    11	  SelectContent,
    12	  SelectItem,
    13	  SelectTrigger,
    14	  SelectValue,
    15	} from "@/components/ui/select";
    16	import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
    17	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
    18	import { UserCircle, Languages, LogOut } from "lucide-react";
    19	import { useState } from "react";
    20	import { useTranslations, useLocale } from "next-intl";
    21	
    22	export function Header() {
    23	  const t = useTranslations("Common");
    24	  const headerT = useTranslations("Header");
    25	  const roleLabels = useRoleLabels();
    26	  const locale = useLocale();
    27	  const router = useRouter();
    28	  const pathname = usePathname();
    29	  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
    30	  const [role, setRole] = useState<UserRole>("ADMIN");
    31	
    32	  // Logic to simulate role switching for the demo
    33	  const handleRoleChange = (newRole: string) => {
    34	    setRole(newRole as UserRole);
    35	    window.dispatchEvent(
    36	      new CustomEvent("roleChanged", { detail: { role: newRole } })
    37	    );
    38	  };
    39	
    40	  const handleLanguageChange = (newLocale: string) => {
    41	    if (newLocale === locale) return;
    42	    // Carry the query string across — `usePathname` from next-intl strips both
    43	    // the locale prefix and the search params, so replacing with it alone would
    44	    // silently drop whatever state the current page keeps in the URL.
    45	    const query = searchParams.toString();
    46	    router.replace(query ? `${pathname}?${query}` : pathname, { locale: newLocale });
    47	    router.refresh();
    48	  };
    49	
    50	  const handleSignOut = async () => {
    51	    const supabase = createClient();
    52	    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    53	    router.push("/login");
    54	    router.refresh();
    55	  };
    56	
    57	  return (
    58	    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b bg-background px-6 shadow-sm">
    59	      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
    60	        <SidebarTrigger className="-ml-2" />
    61	        <Separator orientation="vertical" className="h-4" />
    62	        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/60 truncate">
    63	          {t("title")}
    64	        </h2>
    65	      </div>
    66	
    67	      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
    68	        {/* Language Switcher */}
    69	        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-secondary/50 border border-border">
    70	          <Languages className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
    71	          {/* Controlled on `locale`, not `defaultValue`. Switching locale keeps
    72	              this client component mounted, so an uncontrolled Select would go
    73	              on showing the previous language after the page had translated. */}
    74	          <Select value={locale} onValueChange={handleLanguageChange}>
    75	            <SelectTrigger className="h-7 border-none bg-transparent p-0 text-xs font-semibold focus:ring-0 w-[80px]">
    76	              <SelectValue />
    77	            </SelectTrigger>
    78	            <SelectContent>
    79	              <SelectItem value="es" className="text-xs">
    80	                {headerT("languageSelector.spanish")}
    81	              </SelectItem>
    82	              <SelectItem value="en" className="text-xs">
    83	                {headerT("languageSelector.english")}
    84	              </SelectItem>
    85	            </SelectContent>
    86	          </Select>
    87	        </div>
    88	
    89	        {/* Role Switcher */}
    90	        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary/5 border border-primary/10">
    91	          <UserCircle className="size-4 text-primary" />
    92	          <Select value={role} onValueChange={handleRoleChange}>
    93	            <SelectTrigger className="h-7 border-none bg-transparent p-0 text-xs font-bold focus:ring-0 w-[160px]">
    94	              <SelectValue placeholder={headerT("roleSelector.placeholder")} />
    95	            </SelectTrigger>
    96	            <SelectContent>
    97	              {Object.entries(roleLabels).map(([key, label]) => (
    98	                <SelectItem key={key} value={key} className="text-xs">
    99	                  {label}
   100	                </SelectItem>
   101	              ))}
   102	            </SelectContent>
   103	          </Select>
   104	          <Badge
   105	            variant="outline"
   106	            className="text-[10px] h-4 bg-white dark:bg-black uppercase tracking-tighter"
   107	          >
   108	            {t("demo")}
   109	          </Badge>
   110	        </div>
   111	
   112	        <Button
   113	          variant="ghost"
   114	          size="icon"
   115	          onClick={handleSignOut}
   116	          title={headerT("signOut")}
   117	        >
   118	          <LogOut className="size-4" />
   119	        </Button>
   120	      </div>
   121	    </header>
   122	  );
   123	}

     8	// Small presentational pieces shared across every analytics tab, so the tabs

    11	export function useCLP() {
    12	  const locale = useLocale();
    13	  return {
    14	    locale,
    15	    full: (value: number | null | undefined) =>
    16	      value === null || value === undefined
    17	        ? "—"
    18	        : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    19	            style: "currency",
    20	            currency: "CLP",
    21	            maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    22	          }).format(value),
    23	    /**
    24	     * Abbreviated form for places where space genuinely forces it — chart
    25	     * axis ticks and dense meter rows.
    26	     *
    27	     * This ROUNDS, and rounds to nearest, so it can overstate: 8,975,841,296
    28	     * renders as "$9.0B", a ~24M overstatement. That is fine for a scale
    29	     * marker and dangerous for a figure someone acts on, so it must never be
    30	     * the only representation of a value — pair it with `full` (as a visible
    31	     * exact line, a tooltip, or a title attribute) anywhere a reader might
    32	     * take a number from the screen.
    33	     */
    34	    compact: (value: number | null | undefined) => {
    35	      if (value === null || value === undefined) return "—";
    36	      const abs = Math.abs(value);
    37	      const sign = value < 0 ? "-" : "";
    38	      // Two decimals at B/M scale: at one decimal, 8,975,841,296 shows as
    39	      // "$9.0B" — a 24M overstatement. Two decimals brings that to ~4M
    40	      // (0.05%). K keeps one decimal since the worst case there is 50 CLP,
    41	      // and under 1,000 the value is already exact.
    42	      if (abs >= 1_000_000_000) return `${sign}$${(abs / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(2)}B`;
    43	      if (abs >= 1_000_000) return `${sign}$${(abs / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M`;
    44	      if (abs >= 1_000) return `${sign}$${(abs / 1_000).toFixed(1)}K`;
    45	      return `${sign}$${abs.toFixed(0)}`;
    46	    },
    47	    num: (value: number | null | undefined, digits = 0) =>
    48	      value === null || value === undefined
    49	        ? "—"
    50	        : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    51	            maximumFractionDigits: digits,
    52	            minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    53	          }).format(value),
    54	    pct: (value: number | null | undefined, digits = 1) =>
    55	      value === null || value === undefined ? "—" : `${value.toFixed(digits)}%`,
    56	  };
    57	}
    58	
    59	/**
    60	 * Wraps an abbreviated figure so the exact value is one hover (or keyboard
    61	 * focus) away. Abbreviation always loses precision, so the unrounded number
    62	 * has to stay reachable wherever a reader might act on it.
    63	 */
    64	export function ExactValue({
    65	  display,
    66	  exact,
    67	  className,
    68	}: {
    69	  display: string;
    70	  exact?: string;
    71	  className?: string;
    72	}) {
    73	  if (!exact) return <span className={className}>{display}</span>;
    74	  return (
    75	    <Tooltip>
    76	      <TooltipTrigger asChild>
    77	        {/* tabIndex so the exact figure is reachable without a mouse. */}
    78	        <span className={cn("cursor-help", className)} tabIndex={0}>
    79	          {display}
    80	        </span>
    81	      </TooltipTrigger>
    82	      <TooltipContent>
    83	        <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{exact}</span>
    84	      </TooltipContent>
    85	    </Tooltip>
    86	  );
    87	}

     2	// handles this correctly out of the box, unlike the existing locale-unaware
     3	// `$${value.toLocaleString()}` used in items-view.tsx/columns.tsx. Scoped to
     4	// the dashboard for now; candidate to unify into a shared formatter later.
     5	export function formatCLP(value: number | null | undefined, locale: string): string {
     6	  if (value === null || value === undefined) return "—";
     7	  return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale === "es" ? "es-CL" : "en-US", {
     8	    style: "currency",
     9	    currency: "CLP",
    10	    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    11	  }).format(value);

    34	export function formatPeriodLabel(
    35	  period: string,
    36	  granularity: "day" | "week" | "month",
    37	  locale: string
    38	): string {
    39	  const intlLocale = locale === "es" ? "es-CL" : "en-US";
    40	
    41	  if (granularity === "month") {
    42	    const [year, month] = period.split("-").map(Number);
    43	    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(intlLocale, { month: "short", year: "numeric" }).format(
    44	      new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, 1))
    45	    );
    46	  }
    47	
    48	  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(intlLocale, { month: "short", day: "numeric" }).format(
    49	    new Date(`${period}T00:00:00Z`)
    50	  );
    51	}

     1	import type { ItemOccurrence } from "@/lib/items/types";

    10	
    11	// Every function in this file consumes InvoiceSummary[], never raw
    12	// ItemOccurrence[] — invoice-level fields (net/IVA/exempt/total amount, due
    13	// date, payment form) live once per invoice, not once per line, so summing
    14	// them over ItemOccurrence[] directly would multiply-count every invoice by
    15	// its line count. Always go through deriveInvoiceSummaries first.
    16	
    17	// Groups occurrences by invoiceId, taking one representative per group —
    18	// invoice-level fields are identical across every line of the same invoice
    19	// by construction of the join, so "first occurrence encountered" is a safe,
    20	// cheap pick. Logs a warning (dev-only signal, not a thrown error) if two
    21	// occurrences sharing an invoiceId disagree on a supposedly invoice-level
    22	// field, since that would indicate a query/join bug rather than legitimate
    23	// data variation.
    24	export function deriveInvoiceSummaries(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): InvoiceSummary[] {
    25	  const map = new Map<string, InvoiceSummary>();
    26	
    27	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
    28	    const existing = map.get(occ.invoiceId);
    29	    if (existing) {
    30	      existing.lineItemCount += 1;
    31	      if (
    32	        existing.totalAmount !== occ.totalAmount ||
    33	        existing.dueDate !== occ.dueDate ||
    34	        existing.documentType !== occ.documentType
    35	      ) {
    36	        console.log(
    37	          `[dashboard] deriveInvoiceSummaries: invoice ${occ.invoiceId} has disagreeing ` +
    38	            "invoice-level fields across its lines — possible join bug:",
    39	          { existing, occurrence: occ }
    40	        );
    41	      }
    42	      continue;
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    map.set(occ.invoiceId, {
    46	      invoiceId: occ.invoiceId,
    47	      invoiceDate: occ.invoiceDate,
    48	      transactionType: occ.transactionType,
    49	      documentType: occ.documentType,
    50	      invoiceFolio: occ.invoiceFolio,
    51	      companyId: occ.companyId,
    52	      companyName: occ.companyName,
    53	      companyRut: occ.companyRut,
    54	      netAmount: occ.netAmount,
    55	      ivaAmount: occ.ivaAmount,
    56	      exemptAmount: occ.exemptAmount,
    57	      totalAmount: occ.totalAmount,
    58	      dueDate: occ.dueDate,
    59	      paymentForm: occ.paymentForm,
    60	      lineItemCount: 1,
    61	    });
    62	  }
    63	
    64	  return Array.from(map.values());
    65	}

    96	const AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER: ApAgingBucketKey[] = [
    97	  "no_due_date",
    98	  "current",
    99	  "1-30",
   100	  "31-60",
   101	  "61-90",
   102	  "90+",
   103	];
   104	
   105	function apAgingBucketFor(dueDate: string | null, asOfDate: Date): ApAgingBucketKey {
   106	  if (!dueDate) return "no_due_date";
   107	  const due = new Date(`${dueDate}T00:00:00Z`);
   108	  const diffDays = Math.floor((asOfDate.getTime() - due.getTime()) / 86_400_000);
   109	  if (diffDays <= 0) return "current"; // due today or still in the future
   110	  if (diffDays <= 30) return "1-30";
   111	  if (diffDays <= 60) return "31-60";
   112	  if (diffDays <= 90) return "61-90";
   113	  return "90+";
   114	}
   115	
   116	// Fixed, ORDERED buckets (not sorted by value) — an aging report reads
   117	// left-to-right by increasing risk, not by which bucket happens to be
   118	// largest. Caller should filter `invoices` to COMPRAS only first — AP
   119	// conceptually only applies to purchases.
   120	export function aggregateApAging(invoices: InvoiceSummary[], asOfDate: Date): ApAgingBucket[] {
   121	  const totals = new Map<ApAgingBucketKey, { total: number; invoiceCount: number }>();
   122	  for (const key of AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER) totals.set(key, { total: 0, invoiceCount: 0 });
   123	
   124	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   125	    const bucket = apAgingBucketFor(inv.dueDate, asOfDate);
   126	    const entry = totals.get(bucket)!;
   127	    entry.total += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   128	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   129	  }
   130	
   131	  return AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER.map((bucket) => ({
   132	    bucket,
   133	    total: totals.get(bucket)!.total,
   134	    invoiceCount: totals.get(bucket)!.invoiceCount,
   135	  }));
   136	}
   137	
   138	export function aggregatePaymentFormSplit(
   139	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[],
   140	  topN = 8
   141	): PaymentFormSplit[] {
   142	  const buckets = new Map<string, { label: string; total: number; invoiceCount: number }>();
   143	
   144	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   145	    const key = inv.paymentForm ?? "__unspecified__";
   146	    let bucket = buckets.get(key);
   147	    if (!bucket) {
   148	      bucket = { label: inv.paymentForm ?? "", total: 0, invoiceCount: 0 };
   149	      buckets.set(key, bucket);
   150	    }
   151	    bucket.total += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   152	    bucket.invoiceCount += 1;
   153	  }
   154	
   155	  const sorted: PaymentFormSplit[] = Array.from(buckets.entries())
   156	    .map(([key, b]) => ({
   157	      paymentForm: key === "__unspecified__" ? "" : key,
   158	      paymentFormLabel: b.label,
   159	      total: b.total,
   160	      invoiceCount: b.invoiceCount,
   161	      isOther: false,
   162	    }))
   163	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
   164	
   165	  if (sorted.length <= topN) return sorted;
   166	
   167	  const top = sorted.slice(0, topN);
   168	  const rest = sorted.slice(topN);
   169	  top.push({
   170	    paymentForm: "",
   171	    paymentFormLabel: "",
   172	    total: rest.reduce((s, r) => s + r.total, 0),
   173	    invoiceCount: rest.reduce((s, r) => s + r.invoiceCount, 0),
   174	    isOther: true,
   175	  });
   176	  return top;
   177	}

   179	// Computed on the credit-note-EXCLUDED subset — headline tax totals should
   180	// reflect real invoices, with credit notes surfaced separately via
   181	// aggregateCreditNoteSummary (see cross-cutting rules in the plan).
   182	export function aggregateTaxTotals(invoices: InvoiceSummary[]): TaxTotals {
   183	  const nonCreditNotes = invoices.filter((inv) => !isCreditNote(inv.documentType));
   184	
   185	  let netTotal = 0;
   186	  let ivaTotal = 0;
   187	  let exemptTotal = 0;
   188	  let grandTotal = 0;
   189	
   190	  for (const inv of nonCreditNotes) {
   191	    netTotal += inv.netAmount ?? 0;
   192	    ivaTotal += inv.ivaAmount ?? 0;
   193	    exemptTotal += inv.exemptAmount ?? 0;
   194	    grandTotal += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   195	  }
   196	
   197	  return { netTotal, ivaTotal, exemptTotal, grandTotal, invoiceCount: nonCreditNotes.length };
   198	}

   200	// Groups by the RAW, unfiltered document_type string — safe by construction
   201	// (no guessing), and this is the one chart that deliberately includes credit
   202	// notes rather than excluding them, since its whole job is composition.
   203	export function aggregateDocumentTypeBreakdown(invoices: InvoiceSummary[]): DocumentTypeSpend[] {
   204	  const buckets = new Map<string, { total: number; invoiceCount: number }>();
   205	
   206	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   207	    let bucket = buckets.get(inv.documentType);

   210	      buckets.set(inv.documentType, bucket);
   211	    }

   213	    bucket.invoiceCount += 1;
   214	  }
   215	
   216	  return Array.from(buckets.entries())
   217	    .map(([documentType, b]) => ({

   219	      total: b.total,
   220	      invoiceCount: b.invoiceCount,
   221	      isCreditNote: isCreditNote(documentType),
   222	    }))
   223	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
   224	}

    47	          showBothTypes={showBothTypes}

--- src/components/dashboard/tabs/explorer-tab.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
     4	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     5	import { Building2, Package, Tag } from "lucide-react";
     6	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
     7	import { ExplorerPanel } from "@/components/dashboard/explorer/explorer-panel";
     8	import type { DrillDimension, DrillLevel, DrillPath } from "@/lib/dashboard/drill";
     9	import type { InvoiceSummary, SpendGranularity } from "@/lib/dashboard/types";
    10	import type { Company, ItemOccurrence } from "@/lib/items/types";
    11	
    12	interface ExplorerTabProps {
    13	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[];
    14	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[];
    15	  companyMap: Map<string, Company>;
    16	  granularity: SpendGranularity;
    17	  showCompras: boolean;
    18	  showVentas: boolean;
    19	  onRequestAllTypes: () => void;
    20	  /** Lifted so the Comparison tab can jump straight to a category>company path. */
    21	  root: DrillDimension;
    22	  path: DrillPath;
    23	  onRootChange: (root: DrillDimension) => void;
    24	  onPathChange: (path: DrillPath) => void;
    25	}
    26	
    27	const ENTRY_POINTS: { key: DrillDimension; icon: typeof Building2; labelKey: string }[] = [
    28	  { key: "company", icon: Building2, labelKey: "entryCompanies" },
    29	  { key: "category", icon: Tag, labelKey: "entryCategories" },
    30	  { key: "item", icon: Package, labelKey: "entryItems" },
    31	];
    32	
    33	export function ExplorerTab({
    34	  occurrences,
    35	  invoices,
    36	  companyMap,
    37	  granularity,
    38	  showCompras,
    39	  showVentas,
    40	  onRequestAllTypes,
    41	  root,
    42	  path,
    43	  onRootChange,
    44	  onPathChange,
    45	}: ExplorerTabProps) {
    46	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.explorer");
    47	
    48	  // A drill path is only valid for the hierarchy it was built against, so
    49	  // changing the entry point resets it rather than leaving a path whose
    50	  // dimensions no longer line up with the new hierarchy's order.
    51	  const handleRootChange = (next: DrillDimension) => {
    52	    if (next === root) return;
    53	    onRootChange(next);
    54	    onPathChange([]);
    55	  };
    56	
    57	  const handleDrill = useCallback(
    58	    (level: DrillLevel) => onPathChange([...path, level]),
    59	    [path, onPathChange]
    60	  );
    61	
    62	  const handleNavigate = useCallback(
    63	    (depth: number) => onPathChange(path.slice(0, depth)),
    64	    [path, onPathChange]
    65	  );
    66	
    67	  // Tier-1/Tier-2 filter changes can invalidate a deep path (the entity you
    68	  // drilled into may no longer be in scope). Trim back to the deepest level
    69	  // that still matches real rows instead of stranding the user on an empty view.
    70	  useEffect(() => {
    71	    if (path.length === 0) return;
    72	    let validDepth = 0;
    73	    for (let depth = 1; depth <= path.length; depth++) {
    74	      const candidate = path.slice(0, depth);
    75	      const hasRows = occurrences.some((occ) =>
    76	        candidate.every((level) =>
    77	          level.dimension === "company"
    78	            ? occ.companyId === level.id
    79	            : level.dimension === "category"
    80	              ? occ.categoryId === level.id
    81	              : occ.catalogItemId === level.id
    82	        )
    83	      );
    84	      if (!hasRows) break;
    85	      validDepth = depth;
    86	    }
    87	    if (validDepth !== path.length) onPathChange(path.slice(0, validDepth));
    88	  }, [occurrences, path, onPathChange]);
    89	
    90	  return (
    91	    <div className="space-y-6">
    92	      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
    93	        <span className="text-xs uppercase text-muted-foreground font-bold tracking-wide">
    94	          {t("startFrom")}
    95	        </span>
    96	        <div className="inline-flex flex-wrap gap-2">
    97	          {ENTRY_POINTS.map(({ key, icon: Icon, labelKey }) => (
    98	            <Button
    99	              key={key}
   100	              variant={root === key ? "default" : "outline"}
   101	              size="sm"
   102	              className="gap-2"
   103	              onClick={() => handleRootChange(key)}
   104	            >
   105	              <Icon className="size-4" />
   106	              {t(labelKey)}
   107	            </Button>
   108	          ))}
   109	        </div>
   110	      </div>
   111	
   112	      <ExplorerPanel
   113	        root={root}
   114	        path={path}
   115	        onDrill={handleDrill}
   116	        onNavigate={handleNavigate}
   117	        occurrences={occurrences}
   118	        invoices={invoices}
   119	        companyMap={companyMap}
   120	        granularity={granularity}
   121	        showCompras={showCompras}
   122	        showVentas={showVentas}
   123	        onRequestAllTypes={onRequestAllTypes}
   124	      />
   125	    </div>
   126	  );
   127	}

--- src/components/dashboard/ap-kpi-tiles.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useMemo } from "react";
     4	import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
     5	import { useLocale, useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     6	import { formatCLP } from "@/lib/dashboard/format";
     7	import type { InvoiceSummary } from "@/lib/dashboard/types";
     8	
     9	interface ApKpiTilesProps {
    10	  /** Already scoped to COMPRAS by the caller. */
    11	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[];
    12	  asOfDate: Date;
    13	}
    14	
    15	export function ApKpiTiles({ invoices, asOfDate }: ApKpiTilesProps) {
    16	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.ap");
    17	  const locale = useLocale();
    18	
    19	  const { totalPayables, overdueTotal, dueSoonTotal } = useMemo(() => {
    20	    let totalPayables = 0;
    21	    let overdueTotal = 0;
    22	    let dueSoonTotal = 0;
    23	
    24	    for (const inv of invoices) {
    25	      const amount = inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
    26	      totalPayables += amount;
    27	
    28	      if (!inv.dueDate) continue;
    29	      const due = new Date(`${inv.dueDate}T00:00:00Z`);
    30	      const diffDays = Math.floor((due.getTime() - asOfDate.getTime()) / 86_400_000);
    31	      if (diffDays < 0) overdueTotal += amount;
    32	      else if (diffDays <= 30) dueSoonTotal += amount;
    33	    }
    34	
    35	    return { totalPayables, overdueTotal, dueSoonTotal };
    36	  }, [invoices, asOfDate]);
    37	
    38	  return (
    39	    <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
    40	      <Card>
    41	        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
    42	          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
    43	            {t("totalPayables")}
    44	          </CardTitle>
    45	        </CardHeader>
    46	        <CardContent>
    47	          <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{formatCLP(totalPayables, locale)}</div>
    48	        </CardContent>
    49	      </Card>
    50	
    51	      <Card className={overdueTotal > 0 ? "border-l-4 border-l-red-500" : undefined}>
    52	        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
    53	          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
    54	            {t("overdueTotal")}
    55	          </CardTitle>
    56	        </CardHeader>
    57	        <CardContent>
    58	          <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{formatCLP(overdueTotal, locale)}</div>
    59	        </CardContent>
    60	      </Card>
    61	
    62	      <Card className={dueSoonTotal > 0 ? "border-l-4 border-l-amber-500" : undefined}>
    63	        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
    64	          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
    65	            {t("dueSoonTotal")}
    66	          </CardTitle>
    67	        </CardHeader>
    68	        <CardContent>
    69	          <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{formatCLP(dueSoonTotal, locale)}</div>
    70	        </CardContent>
    71	      </Card>
    72	    </div>
    73	  );
    74	}

--- src/components/dashboard/data-quality-kpi-tiles.tsx ---
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useMemo } from "react";
     4	import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
     5	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     6	import { formatPercent } from "@/lib/dashboard/format";
     7	import type { DataQualitySummary } from "@/lib/dashboard/types";
     8	import type { ItemOccurrence } from "@/lib/items/types";
     9	
    10	interface DataQualityKpiTilesProps {
    11	  summary: DataQualitySummary;
    12	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[];
    13	}
    14	
    15	export function DataQualityKpiTiles({ summary, occurrences }: DataQualityKpiTilesProps) {
    16	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.quality");
    17	
    18	  const { avgMargin, avgEntropy } = useMemo(() => {
    19	    if (occurrences.length === 0) return { avgMargin: 0, avgEntropy: 0 };
    20	    const marginSum = occurrences.reduce((s, o) => s + o.margin, 0);
    21	    const entropySum = occurrences.reduce((s, o) => s + o.entropy, 0);
    22	    return {
    23	      avgMargin: marginSum / occurrences.length,
    24	      avgEntropy: entropySum / occurrences.length,
    25	    };
    26	  }, [occurrences]);
    27	
    28	  return (
    29	    <div className="grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
    30	      <Card>
    31	        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
    32	          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
    33	            {t("autoAccepted")}
    34	          </CardTitle>
    35	        </CardHeader>
    36	        <CardContent>
    37	          <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{summary.autoAccepted.toLocaleString()}</div>
    38	        </CardContent>
    39	      </Card>
    40

    13	// Entity-level aggregation for the drill-down explorer. Pure functions over
    14	// already-fetched arrays — no Supabase, no i18n, same contract as aggregate.ts.
    15	//
    16	// The invoice- vs. line-level rule from src/lib/dashboard/invoices.ts applies
    17	// here too: anything derived from net/IVA/exempt/total amount, due date or
    18	// payment form must come from InvoiceSummary[], never be summed over
    19	// ItemOccurrence[]. aggregateCompanyProfiles takes `invoices` as a separate
    20	// argument specifically so that can't be got wrong by accident.
    21	
    22	const MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000;
    23	
    24	// Σamount / Σquantity — deliberately NOT a mean of unitPrice. A naive mean
    25	// lets one 1-unit line count as much as a 1000-unit line, which is the
    26	// classic way a "average price" number ends up wrong. Falls back to a plain
    27	// mean only when quantity is unusable, and says so via isUnweighted.
    28	export function computeUnitPriceStats(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): UnitPriceStats {
    29	  const units = new Set<string>();
    30	  let amountSum = 0;
    31	  let quantitySum = 0;
    32	  let priceSum = 0;
    33	  let priceCount = 0;
    34	  let min: number | null = null;
    35	  let max: number | null = null;
    36	
    37	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
    38	    if (occ.unit) units.add(occ.unit);
    39	
    40	    if (occ.quantity !== null && occ.quantity > 0 && occ.amount !== null) {
    41	      amountSum += occ.amount;
    42	      quantitySum += occ.quantity;
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    if (occ.unitPrice !== null && occ.unitPrice > 0) {
    46	      priceSum += occ.unitPrice;
    47	      priceCount += 1;
    48	      if (min === null || occ.unitPrice < min) min = occ.unitPrice;
    49	      if (max === null || occ.unitPrice > max) max = occ.unitPrice;
    50	    }
    51	  }
    52	
    53	  const hasMixedUnits = units.size > 1;
    54	
    55	  let weightedAvg: number | null = null;
    56	  let isUnweighted = false;
    57	  if (quantitySum > 0) {
    58	    weightedAvg = amountSum / quantitySum;
    59	  } else if (priceCount > 0) {
    60	    weightedAvg = priceSum / priceCount;
    61	    isUnweighted = true;
    62	  }
    63	
    64	  // A spread across different units of measure (KG vs UN) compares unlike
    65	  // things and would report a fake several-thousand-percent gap — suppress it
    66	  // rather than publishing a number nobody can act on.
    67	  const spreadPct =
    68	    !hasMixedUnits && min !== null && max !== null && min > 0
    69	      ? ((max - min) / min) * 100
    70	      : null;
    71	
    72	  return {
    73	    weightedAvg,
    74	    min,
    75	    max,
    76	    spreadPct,
    77	    isUnweighted,
    78	    hasMixedUnits,
    79	    units: Array.from(units).sort(),
    80	  };
    81	}

    83	export function aggregateCompanyProfiles(
    84	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
    85	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[],
    86	  companyMap: Map<string, Company>
    87	): CompanyProfile[] {
    88	  interface Acc {
    89	    comprasTotal: number;
    90	    ventasTotal: number;
    91	    lineCount: number;
    92	    itemIds: Set<string>;
    93	    categoryIds: Set<string>;
    94	    discountTotal: number;
    95	    recargoTotal: number;
    96	    needsReviewCount: number;
    97	    firstInvoiceDate: string | null;
    98	    lastInvoiceDate: string | null;
    99	  }
   100	
   101	  const acc = new Map<string, Acc>();
   102	  const ensure = (companyId: string): Acc => {
   103	    let entry = acc.get(companyId);
   104	    if (!entry) {
   105	      entry = {
   106	        comprasTotal: 0,
   107	        ventasTotal: 0,
   108	        lineCount: 0,
   109	        itemIds: new Set(),
   110	        categoryIds: new Set(),
   111	        discountTotal: 0,
   112	        recargoTotal: 0,
   113	        needsReviewCount: 0,
   114	        firstInvoiceDate: null,
   115	        lastInvoiceDate: null,
   116	      };
   117	      acc.set(companyId, entry);
   118	    }
   119	    return entry;
   120	  };
   121	
   122	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   123	    const entry = ensure(occ.companyId);
   124	    const amount = occ.amount ?? 0;
   125	    if (occ.transactionType === "COMPRAS") entry.comprasTotal += amount;
   126	    else entry.ventasTotal += amount;
   127	
   128	    entry.lineCount += 1;
   129	    entry.itemIds.add(occ.catalogItemId);
   130	    if (occ.categoryId) entry.categoryIds.add(occ.categoryId);
   131	    entry.discountTotal += occ.discountAmount ?? 0;
   132	    entry.recargoTotal += occ.recargoAmount ?? 0;
   133	    if (occ.needsReview) entry.needsReviewCount += 1;
   134	
   135	    const date = occ.invoiceDate.slice(0, 10);
   136	    if (entry.firstInvoiceDate === null || date < entry.firstInvoiceDate) {
   137	      entry.firstInvoiceDate = date;
   138	    }
   139	    if (entry.lastInvoiceDate === null || date > entry.lastInvoiceDate) {
   140	      entry.lastInvoiceDate = date;
   141	    }
   142	  }
   143	
   144	  // Invoice-level metrics come from the deduped InvoiceSummary[], so they
   145	  // count each invoice once regardless of how many lines it carries.
   146	  interface InvAcc {
   147	    invoiceCount: number;
   148	    totalSum: number;
   149	    maxTotal: number;
   150	    maxFolio: string | null;
   151	    daysToDueSum: number;
   152	    daysToDueCount: number;
   153	  }
   154	  const invAcc = new Map<string, InvAcc>();
   155	
   156	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   157	    let entry = invAcc.get(inv.companyId);
   158	    if (!entry) {
   159	      entry = {
   160	        invoiceCount: 0,
   161	        totalSum: 0,
   162	        maxTotal: 0,
   163	        maxFolio: null,
   164	        daysToDueSum: 0,
   165	        daysToDueCount: 0,
   166	      };
   167	      invAcc.set(inv.companyId, entry);
   168	    }
   169	
   170	    const total = inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   171	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   172	    entry.totalSum += total;
   173	    if (total > entry.maxTotal) {
   174	      entry.maxTotal = total;
   175	      entry.maxFolio = inv.invoiceFolio;
   176	    }
   177	
   178	    if (inv.dueDate) {
   179	      const issued = new Date(`${inv.invoiceDate.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
   180	      const due = new Date(`${inv.dueDate.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
   181	      if (!Number.isNaN(issued) && !Number.isNaN(due)) {
   182	        entry.daysToDueSum += (due - issued) / MS_PER_DAY;
   183	        entry.daysToDueCount += 1;
   184	      }
   185	    }
   186	  }
   187	
   188	  const profiles: CompanyProfile[] = [];
   189	  for (const [companyId, entry] of acc) {
   190	    const company = companyMap.get(companyId);
   191	    const inv = invAcc.get(companyId);
   192	    const invoiceCount = inv?.invoiceCount ?? 0;
   193	
   194	    profiles.push({
   195	      companyId,
   196	      companyName: company?.company_name ?? companyId,
   197	      companyRut: company?.rut ?? "",
   198	      giro: company?.giro ?? null,
   199	      commune: company?.commune ?? null,
   200	      city: company?.city ?? null,
   201	      isSeller: company?.is_seller ?? false,
   202	      isBuyer: company?.is_buyer ?? false,
   203	      comprasTotal: entry.comprasTotal,
   204	      ventasTotal: entry.ventasTotal,
   205	      invoiceCount,
   206	      lineCount: entry.lineCount,
   207	      distinctItems: entry.itemIds.size,
   208	      distinctCategories: entry.categoryIds.size,
   209	      avgInvoiceValue: invoiceCount > 0 ? (inv?.totalSum ?? 0) / invoiceCount : 0,
   210	      maxInvoiceTotal: inv?.maxTotal ?? 0,
   211	      maxInvoiceFolio: inv?.maxFolio ?? null,
   212	      discountTotal: entry.discountTotal,
   213	      recargoTotal: entry.recargoTotal,
   214	      avgDaysToDue:
   215	        inv && inv.daysToDueCount > 0 ? inv.daysToDueSum / inv.daysToDueCount : null,
   216	      firstInvoiceDate: entry.firstInvoiceDate,
   217	      lastInvoiceDate: entry.lastInvoiceDate,
   218	      needsReviewCount: entry.needsReviewCount,
   219	      needsReviewPct:
   220	        entry.lineCount > 0 ? (entry.needsReviewCount / entry.lineCount) * 100 : 0,
   221	    });
   222	  }
   223	
   224	  return profiles.sort((a, b) => b.comprasTotal + b.ventasTotal - (a.comprasTotal + a.ventasTotal));
   225	}

   229	export function aggregateCategoryProfiles(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): CategoryProfile[] {
   230	  interface Acc {
   231	    categoryId: string | null;
   232	    categoryCode: string | null;
   233	    categoryName: string | null;
   234	    total: number;
   235	    lineCount: number;
   236	    invoiceIds: Set<string>;
   237	    companyIds: Set<string>;
   238	    itemIds: Set<string>;
   239	    occurrences: ItemOccurrence[];
   240	    maxLineAmount: number;
   241	    maxLineItemName: string | null;
   242	    needsReviewCount: number;
   243	  }
   244	
   245	  const acc = new Map<string, Acc>();
   246	  let grandTotal = 0;
   247	
   248	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   249	    const key = occ.categoryId ?? UNCATEGORIZED_KEY;

   253	        categoryId: occ.categoryId,

   261	        occurrences: [],
   262	        maxLineAmount: 0,
   263	        maxLineItemName: null,
   264	        needsReviewCount: 0,
   265	      };
   266	      acc.set(key, entry);
   267	    }

   270	    entry.total += amount;

   282	  }

   287	      categoryCode: entry.categoryCode,
   288	      categoryName: entry.categoryName,
   289	      total: entry.total,
   290	      sharePct: grandTotal > 0 ? (entry.total / grandTotal) * 100 : 0,
   291	      invoiceCount: entry.invoiceIds.size,
   292	      lineCount: entry.lineCount,
   293	      distinctCompanies: entry.companyIds.size,
   294	      distinctItems: entry.itemIds.size,
   295	      unitPrice: computeUnitPriceStats(entry.occurrences),
   296	      maxLineAmount: entry.maxLineAmount,
   297	      maxLineItemName: entry.maxLineItemName,
   298	      needsReviewCount: entry.needsReviewCount,
   299	      needsReviewPct:
   300	        entry.lineCount > 0 ? (entry.needsReviewCount / entry.lineCount) * 100 : 0,
   301	    }))

   369	// One line per supplier for a single item's unit price over time. Capped at
   370	// maxCompanies (most observations first) because a line chart has no sane
   371	// "Other" bucket — you can't average unrelated suppliers into one series.
   372	export function aggregatePriceTrend(
   373	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   374	  maxCompanies = 6
   375	): PriceTrendSeries[] {
   376	  const byCompany = new Map<string, { companyName: string; occurrences: ItemOccurrence[] }>();
   377	
   378	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   379	    if (occ.unitPrice === null) continue;
   380	    let entry = byCompany.get(occ.companyId);
   381	    if (!entry) {
   382	      entry = { companyName: occ.companyName, occurrences: [] };
   383	      byCompany.set(occ.companyId, entry);
   384	    }
   385	    entry.occurrences.push(occ);
   386	  }
   387	
   388	  return Array.from(byCompany.entries())
   389	    .sort((a, b) => b[1].occurrences.length - a[1].occurrences.length)
   390	    .slice(0, maxCompanies)
   391	    .map(([companyId, entry]) => ({
   392	      companyId,
   393	      companyName: entry.companyName,
   394	      points: entry.occurrences
   395	        .map((occ) => ({
   396	          date: occ.invoiceDate.slice(0, 10),
   397	          unitPrice: occ.unitPrice as number,
   398	        }))
   399	        .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)),
   400	    }));
   401	}

   403	// Category x company crosstab. Top-N on both axes is lossy by construction —
   404	// coveredTotal/grandTotal are returned so the UI can state what fraction of
   405	// spend the visible cells actually account for.
   406	export function aggregateCategoryCompanyMatrix(
   407	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   408	  topCategories = 12,
   409	  topCompanies = 10
   410	): MatrixData {
   411	  const categoryTotals = new Map<string, MatrixAxisEntry>();
   412	  const companyTotals = new Map<string, MatrixAxisEntry>();
   413	  const pairTotals = new Map<string, number>();
   414	  let grandTotal = 0;
   415	
   416	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   417	    const amount = occ.amount ?? 0;
   418	    grandTotal += amount;
   419	
   420	    const categoryId = occ.categoryId ?? UNCATEGORIZED_KEY;
   421	    const categoryLabel = occ.categoryName ?? "";
   422	    const category = categoryTotals.get(categoryId);
   423	    if (category) category.total += amount;
   424	    else categoryTotals.set(categoryId, { id: categoryId, label: categoryLabel, total: amount });
   425	
   426	    const company = companyTotals.get(occ.companyId);
   427	    if (company) company.total += amount;
   428	    else
   429	      companyTotals.set(occ.companyId, {
   430	        id: occ.companyId,
   431	        label: occ.companyName,
   432	        total: amount,
   433	      });
   434	
   435	    const pairKey = `${categoryId}?${occ.companyId}`;
   436	    pairTotals.set(pairKey, (pairTotals.get(pairKey) ?? 0) + amount);
   437	  }
   438	
   439	  const rows = Array.from(categoryTotals.values())
   440	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total)
   441	    .slice(0, topCategories);
   442	  const cols = Array.from(companyTotals.values())
   443	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total)
   444	    .slice(0, topCompanies);
   445	
   446	  let maxCell = 0;
   447	  let coveredTotal = 0;
   448	  const cells = rows.map((row) =>
   449	    cols.map((col) => {
   450	      const value = pairTotals.get(`${row.id}?${col.id}`) ?? 0;
   451	      if (value > maxCell) maxCell = value;
   452	      coveredTotal += value;
   453	      return value;
   454	    })
   455	  );
   456	
   457	  return { rows, cols, cells, maxCell, coveredTotal, grandTotal };
   458	}
   459	
   460	// --- Outliers ("max spending") ---
   461	
   462	export function selectLargestInvoices(
   463	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[],
   464	  limit = 10
   465	): InvoiceSummary[] {
   466	  return [...invoices]
   467	    .sort((a, b) => (b.totalAmount ?? 0) - (a.totalAmount ?? 0))
   468	    .slice(0, limit);
   469	}
   470	
   471	export function selectLargestLines(
   472	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   473	  limit = 10
   474	): ItemOccurrence[] {
   475	  return [...occurrences].sort((a, b) => (b.amount ?? 0) - (a.amount ?? 0)).slice(0, limit);
   476	}
   477	
   478	// Only items bought from more than one supplier can have a meaningful spread
   479	// — a single-supplier item's price range is just its own history, not a
   480	// negotiating signal. Mixed-unit items already have spreadPct === null.
   481	export function selectWidestPriceSpreads(profiles: ItemProfile[], limit = 10): ItemProfile[] {
   482	  return profiles
   483	    .filter((p) => p.supplierCount > 1 && p.unitPrice.spreadPct !== null)
   484	    .sort((a, b) => (b.unitPrice.spreadPct ?? 0) - (a.unitPrice.spreadPct ?? 0))
   485	    .slice(0, limit);
   486	}

     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
     4	import { FileSearch, Download, BarChart3, Table2, Loader2, Zap } from "lucide-react";
     5	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     6	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
     7	import { FileUploader } from "@/components/extractor/file-uploader";
     8	import { SecurityConfigPanel } from "@/components/extractor/security-config-panel";
     9	import { ProcessingView } from "@/components/extractor/processing-view";
    10	import { ExtractedDataTable } from "@/components/extractor/extracted-data-table";
    11	import { CorrelationView } from "@/components/extractor/correlation-view";
    12	import { decodeFile, type DecodeResult, type SecurityConfig } from "@/lib/extractor/xml-decoder";
    13	import { parseXmlContent, type ParseResult } from "@/lib/extractor/xml-parser";
    14	import { exportToExcel } from "@/lib/extractor/excel-export";
    15	import { type FileEntry } from "@/lib/extractor/file-scanner";
    16	import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
    17	
    18	type ViewTab = "table" | "correlation";
    19	
    20	interface ProgressItem {
    21	  fileName: string;
    22	  status: "pending" | "decoding" | "parsing" | "done" | "error";
    23	  decodeResult?: DecodeResult;
    24	  rowCount?: number;
    25	  error?: string;
    26	}
    27	
    28	export default function ExtractorPage() {
    29	  const t = useTranslations("Extractor");
    30	
    31	  const [securityConfig, setSecurityConfig] = useState<SecurityConfig>({
    32	    password: "",
    33	    encodingType: "none",
    34	  });
    35	  const [fileEntries, setFileEntries] = useState<FileEntry[]>([]);
    36	  const [results, setResults] = useState<ParseResult[]>([]);
    37	  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
    38	  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ViewTab>("table");
    39	  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<ProgressItem[]>([]);
    40	
    41	  const handleFilesSelected = useCallback((entries: FileEntry[]) => {
    42	    setFileEntries(entries);
    43	  }, []);
    44	
    45	  const processFiles = useCallback(async () => {
    46	    if (fileEntries.length === 0) return;
    47	    setIsProcessing(true);
    48	    setResults([]);
    49	    setProgress(fileEntries.map((e) => ({ fileName: e.file.name, status: "pending" as const })));
    50	
    51	    const parsedResults: ParseResult[] = [];
    52	
    53	    for (let i = 0; i < fileEntries.length; i++) {
    54	      const entry = fileEntries[i];
    55	
    56	      setProgress((prev) =>
    57	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "decoding" as const } : p))
    58	      );
    59	
    60	      const decodeResult = await decodeFile(entry.file, securityConfig);
    61	
    62	      if (!decodeResult.success) {
    63	        setProgress((prev) =>
    64	          prev.map((p, j) =>
    65	            j === i ? { ...p, status: "error" as const, error: decodeResult.error, decodeResult } : p
    66	          )
    67	        );
    68	        parsedResults.push({
    69	          rows: [],
    70	          columns: [],
    71	          fileName: entry.file.name,
    72	          folderPath: entry.folderPath,
    73	          error: decodeResult.error,
    74	        });
    75	        continue;
    76	      }
    77	
    78	      setProgress((prev) =>
    79	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "parsing" as const, decodeResult } : p))
    80	      );
    81	
    82	      const xmlContents = decodeResult.content.split("\n<!-- SEPARATOR -->\n");
    83	
    84	      for (const xmlContent of xmlContents) {
    85	        const parsed = parseXmlContent(xmlContent, entry.file.name, entry.folderPath);
    86	        parsedResults.push(parsed);
    87	      }
    88	
    89	      const totalRows = parsedResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rows.length, 0);
    90	
    91	      setProgress((prev) =>
    92	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "done" as const, decodeResult, rowCount: totalRows } : p))
    93	      );
    94	    }
    95	
    96	    setResults(parsedResults);
    97	    setIsProcessing(false);
    98	  }, [fileEntries, securityConfig]);
    99	
   100	  const handleExport = useCallback(() => {
   101	    const validData = results.filter((r) => r.rows.length > 0);
   102	    if (validData.length === 0) return;
   103	    exportToExcel(validData, {
   104	      includeFileName: true,
   105	      includeFolderPath: true,
   106	      sheetName: "XML Data",
   107	      separateSheets: false,
   108	    });
   109	  }, [results]);
   110	
   111	  const validResults = results.filter((r) => r.rows.length > 0);
   112	  const totalRows = validResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rows.length, 0);
   113	
   114	  return (
   115	    <div className="max-w-full mx-auto py-8 px-4 space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
   116	      {/* Header */}
   117	      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
   118	        <div>
   119	          <h1 className="text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-3">
   120	            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-primary flex items-center justify-center">
   121	              <FileSearch className="w-5 h-5 text-primary-foreground" />
   122	            </div>
   123	            {t("title")}
   124	          </h1>
   125	          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2 text-lg italic">{t("subtitle")}</p>
   126	        </div>
   127	
   128	        {validResults.length > 0 && (
   129	          <Button size="lg" onClick={handleExport} className="gap-2 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300">
   130	            <Download className="size-5" />
   131	            {t("exportExcel")}
   132	          </Button>
   133	        )}
   134	      </div>
   135	
   136	      {/* Upload & Config Row */}
   137	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
   138	        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
   139	          <FileUploader onFilesSelected={handleFilesSelected} isProcessing={isProcessing} />
   140	        </div>
   141	        <div className="space-y-4">
   142	          <SecurityConfigPanel config={securityConfig} onChange={setSecurityConfig} />
   143	
   144	          <button
   145	            onClick={processFiles}
   146	            disabled={fileEntries.length === 0 || isProcessing}
   147	            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-sm"
   148	          >
   149	            {isProcessing ? (
   150	              <>
   151	                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
   152	                {t("processingLabel")}
   153	              </>
   154	            ) : (
   155	              <>
   156	                <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />
   157	                {fileEntries.length > 0
   158	                  ? t("processFilesCount", { count: fileEntries.length })
   159	                  : t("processFiles")}
   160	              </>
   161	            )}
   162	          </button>
   163	
   164	          {validResults.length > 0 && (
   165	            <div className="bg-card border rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
   166	              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
   167	                {t("summary")}
   168	              </h3>
   169	              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
   170	                <div>
   171	                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{validResults.length}</p>
   172	                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("filesParsed")}</p>
   173	                </div>
   174	                <div>
   175	                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{totalRows}</p>
   176	                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("totalRows")}</p>
   177	                </div>
   178	              </div>
   179	            </div>
   180	          )}
   181	        </div>
   182	      </div>
   183	
   184	      {/* Processing Progress */}
   185	      {progress.length > 0 && <ProcessingView progress={progress} isProcessing={isProcessing} />}
   186	
   187	      {/* Results */}
   188	      {validResults.length > 0 && (
   189	        <div className="space-y-4">
   190	          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-card border rounded-xl p-1 w-fit">
   191	            <button
   192	              onClick={() => setActiveTab("table")}
   193	              className={cn(
   194	                "flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all",
   195	                activeTab === "table"
   196	                  ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-sm"
   197	                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
   198	              )}
   199	            >
   200	              <Table2 className="w-4 h-4" />
   201	              {t("tabs.table")}
   202	            </button>
   203	            <button
   204	              onClick={() => setActiveTab("correlation")}
   205	              className={cn(
   206	                "flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all",
   207	                activeTab === "correlation"
   208	                  ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-sm"
   209	                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
   210	              )}
   211	            >
   212	              <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />
   213	              {t("tabs.correlation")}
   214	            </button>
   215	          </div>
   216	
   217	          {activeTab === "table" && <ExtractedDataTable data={validResults} />}
   218	          {activeTab === "correlation" && <CorrelationView data={validResults} />}
   219	        </div>
   220	      )}
   221	
   222	      {/* Empty State */}
   223	      {validResults.length === 0 && progress.length === 0 && (
   224	        <div className="text-center py-16">
   225	          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-muted flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
   226	            <FileSearch className="w-8 h-8 text-muted-foreground" />
   227	          </div>
   228	          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">{t("empty.title")}</h2>
   229	          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto">{t("empty.description")}</p>
   230	        </div>
   231	      )}
   232	    </div>
   233	  );
   234	}

    28	function matchesLevel(occ: ItemOccurrence, level: DrillLevel): boolean {
    29	  switch (level.dimension) {
    30	    case "company":
    31	      return occ.companyId === level.id;
    32	    case "category":
    33	      return occ.categoryId === level.id;
    34	    case "item":
    35	      return occ.catalogItemId === level.id;
    36	  }
    37	}
    38	
    39	// Successively narrows occurrences down the drill path. Order doesn't affect
    40	// the result (it's an intersection of independent predicates), so
    41	// company>category and category>company reach the identical row set — which
    42	// is what makes the two entry points agree, and is worth preserving.
    43	export function applyDrillPath(
    44	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
    45	  path: DrillPath
    46	): ItemOccurrence[] {
    47	  if (path.length === 0) return occurrences;
    48	  return occurrences.filter((occ) => path.every((level) => matchesLevel(occ, level)));
    49	}
    50	
    51	// Which dimension the master table should list at the current depth, or null
    52	// when the path has bottomed out and the leaf (raw invoice lines) is due.
    53	export function nextDimension(
    54	  root: DrillDimension,
    55	  depth: number
    56	): DrillDimension | null {
    57	  const hierarchy = HIERARCHIES[root];
    58	  return depth < hierarchy.length ? hierarchy[depth] : null;
    59	}
    60	
    61	// The id/label pair for one occurrence along a given dimension. Returns null
    62	// for uncategorized rows (categoryId is nullable) so callers can bucket them
    63	// out rather than inventing a synthetic id that would collide across items.
    64	export function entityKeyFor(
    65	  occ: ItemOccurrence,
    66	  dimension: DrillDimension
    67	): { id: string; label: string } | null {
    68	  switch (dimension) {
    69	    case "company":
    70	      return { id: occ.companyId, label: occ.companyName };
    71	    case "category":
    72	      return occ.categoryId === null
    73	        ? null
    74	        : { id: occ.categoryId, label: occ.categoryName ?? occ.categoryId };
    75	    case "item":
    76	      return { id: occ.catalogItemId, label: occ.itemName };
    77	  }
    78	}
    65	  );
    66	
    67	  // Tier-1/Tier-2 filter changes can invalidate a deep path (the entity you
    68	  // drilled into may no longer be in scope). Trim back to the deepest level
    69	  // that still matches real rows instead of stranding the user on an empty view.
    70	  useEffect(() => {
    71	    if (path.length === 0) return;
    72	    let validDepth = 0;
    73	    for (let depth = 1; depth <= path.length; depth++) {
    74	      const candidate = path.slice(0, depth);
    75	      const hasRows = occurrences.some((occ) =>
    76	        candidate.every((level) =>
    77	          level.dimension === "company"
    78	            ? occ.companyId === level.id
    79	            : level.dimension === "category"
    80	              ? occ.categoryId === level.id
    81	              : occ.catalogItemId === level.id
    82	        )
    83	      );
    84	      if (!hasRows) break;
    85	      validDepth = depth;
    86	    }
    87	    if (validDepth !== path.length) onPathChange(path.slice(0, validDepth));
    88	  }, [occurrences, path, onPathChange]);

   115	## What the review rows contain
    18	## D-001 — A dedup key must contain every field the model consumes
    19	
    20	> **Refined by D-013.** The principle stands and is the most important rule in
    21	> the project. The specific tuple below is out of date: the input template now
    22	> includes `transaction_type`, and dedup happens on the *built* string rather
    23	> than a field tuple.
    24	
    25	**Date:** 2026-08-11 · **Decided by:** Afaq + Claude (Opus 5)
    26	
    27	The historical promotion script deduped gold rows on
    28	`(normalized_item_text, category_code)`. The model's input is
    29	`item_text | description | provider`. The key was blind to two fields that are
    30	*inside the model's input*, so 47 genuinely distinct milk-sale training texts
    31	(47 distinct descriptions — different volumes, prices, tanks, farms) collapsed
    32	to a single gold row.
    33	
    34	**Rule going forward:** the dedup key is
    35	`(item_text, description, provider, category_code)`, normalized. If the model's
    36	input template ever changes, this key changes with it, in the same commit.
    37	
    38	**Why not just drop dedup:** exact duplicate records still add nothing to
    39	contrastive learning and skew the LR head's class prior. The problem was never
    40	that dedup existed; it was that the key was narrower than the input.

   851	
   852	**Date:** 2026-08-19 · **Decided by:** Afaq · **Model:** Claude Opus 5
   853	
   854	`file_audit` — a label inferred from the folder the client filed the invoice in —

   861

   864

   870	exists in all of gold. That disagreement *is* the undertraining; treating it as a
   871	second opinion inverts the evidence.

   993	## D-044 — One real product or recurring service gets one canonical catalog ID
   994	
   995	**Date:** 2026-08-25 · **Decided by:** Afaq and colleagues · **Model:** Codex GPT-5.6
   996	
   997	Reuse `item_catalog` as the user-facing canonical catalog. Different spelling,
   998	case, pack/size specification, month or installment number does not create a new
   999	catalog item when the underlying product or recurring service is the same.
  1000	Different grades, actual products, purposes, assets and underlying contracts
  1001	remain separate. Original invoice `item_text` and `description` never change;
  1002	history displays both beneath the canonical name.
  1003	
  1004	Add one `item_aliases` table for true alternate wording such as `G93` →
  1005	`Gasolina 93`. Do not store case-only duplicates, `SEGUN OT 81/82/...`, months,
  1006	dimensions, quantities or generic placeholders as aliases. Future ingestion
  1007	checks exact normalized canonical names, supplier/global aliases, then narrow
  1008	approved patterns; fuzzy similarity only suggests review candidates. Matching
  1009	belongs in the backend ingestion path, not the frontend. No such online writer
  1010	exists in this repository yet, so runtime matching is deferred and documented.
  1011	
  1012	The approved local payload is 11,746 invoice lines, 4,029 canonical rows and 8
  1013	initial aliases. It is not production until Afaq separately approves a fresh
  1014	backup and the guarded transaction. Frontend push/merge is another approval.
  1015	
  1016	## D-045 — The catalog migration ships as three idempotent steps, not one transaction
  1017	
  1018	**Date:** 2026-08-26 · **Decided by:** Afaq · **Model:** Claude Opus 5
  1019	
  1020	`002_apply_canonical_catalog.sql` — the generated single guarded transaction —
  1021	was **not** used. It is 2.6 MB, which the Supabase SQL editor will not accept,
  1022	and this project holds no Postgres connection string: `Temp_Inference/.env.loader`
  1023	carries REST keys only, and every write ever made here has gone through
  1024	PostgREST. The one prior SQL migration was pasted into the SQL editor by hand
  1025	because it was a few lines long.
  1026	
  1027	The migration was therefore split:
  1028	
  1029	- **step A** `003_step_a_schema.sql` — SQL editor. Creates `catalog_normalize_label`
  1030	  and `item_aliases`; drops the old `(item_name, description)` unique constraint.
  1031	- **step B** `scripts/94_apply_canonical_catalog_rest.py` — PostgREST. Insert 16,
  1032	  repoint 2,122, delete 1,398, rename 3,366, insert 8 aliases.
  1033	- **step C** `004_step_c_unique_index.sql` — SQL editor. Unique index on the
  1034	  normalized `item_name`, plus the referential `left join`.
  1035	
  1036	**Why:** atomicity was unavailable, so it was replaced with two weaker
  1037	properties that together cover the same risk. Every phase is **idempotent**
  1038	(upsert merges on the primary key, PATCH sets an already-known value, DELETE of
  1039	an absent row is a no-op), so a failure part-way is resumed by re-running — which
  1040	is exactly what happened when the alias insert failed and phases 1–4 re-applied
  1041	harmlessly. And the phase **order** keeps every intermediate state valid: lines
  1042	are repointed only onto rows that already exist, and rows are deleted only once
  1043	nothing references them. A crash leaves a partly-grouped catalog, never a
  1044	dangling reference.
  1045	
  1046	**The cost, stated plainly:** between step A and step C, `item_catalog` has no
  1047	uniqueness constraint at all. That window must be closed in the same working
  1048	session. It was not — it stayed open for one day. Step C ran on 2026-08-26 and
  1049	returned `4029 | 11746 | 8`, closing the migration.
  1050	
  1051	**Rejected:** pasting the 2.6 MB file (the editor cannot take it); splitting the
  1052	transaction into chunks pasted in sequence (loses atomicity *and* idempotency —
  1053	strictly worse than this); asking Afaq for the database password (avoidable, and
  1054	a credential we do not otherwise need).
