     6	import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
     7	import { EmptyState, useCLP } from "../primitives";
     8	import type { CategoryMetric } from "@/lib/analytics/aggregate";
     9	
    10	interface CategoriesTabProps {
    11	  metrics: CategoryMetric[];
    12	  onSelect: (categoryId: string) => void;
    13	}
    14	
    15	export function CategoriesTab({ metrics, onSelect }: CategoriesTabProps) {
    16	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.categories");
    17	  const clp = useCLP();
    18	
    19	  // Share of classified line value, computed here rather than carried on the
    20	  // metric: it is a property of the current filter, not of the category.
    21	  const grandTotal = useMemo(
    22	    () => metrics.reduce((sum, m) => sum + m.totalAmount, 0),
    23	    [metrics]
    24	  );
    25	
    26	  if (metrics.length === 0) return <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />;
    27	
    28	  return (
    29	    <div className="space-y-4">
    30	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
    31	        {metrics.slice(0, 12).map((m) => {
    32	          const sharePct = grandTotal > 0 ? (m.totalAmount / grandTotal) * 100 : 0;
    33	          return (
    34	            <button
    35	              key={m.categoriesId}
    36	              onClick={() => onSelect(m.categoriesId)}
    37	              className="text-left rounded-lg border p-3 hover:bg-accent/40 transition-colors"
    38	            >
    39	              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
    40	                <div className="min-w-0">
    41	                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 mb-1 font-mono">
    42	                    {m.code}
    43	                  </Badge>
    44	                  <p className="text-sm font-medium leading-snug truncate">{m.name}</p>
    45	                </div>
    46	                <span
    47	                  className="text-sm font-bold shrink-0 tabular-nums"
    48	                  title={clp.full(m.totalAmount)}
    49	                >
    50	                  {clp.compact(m.totalAmount)}
    51	                </span>
    52	              </div>
    53	              <div className="space-y-1.5">
    54	                <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
    55	                  <span>{t("share")}</span>
    56	                  <span className="tabular-nums">{sharePct.toFixed(1)}%</span>
    57	                </div>
    58	                <Progress value={Math.min(100, sharePct)} className="h-1.5" />
    59	                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-0.5">
    60	                  <span>{t("lines", { count: m.itemCount })}</span>
    61	                  <span>·</span>
    62	                  <span>{t("items", { count: m.distinctItems })}</span>
    63	                </div>
    64	              </div>
    65	            </button>
    66	          );
    67	        })}
    68	      </div>
    69	    </div>
    70	  );
    71	}
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
     4	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     5	import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
     6	import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
     7	import {
     8	  Table,
     9	  TableBody,
    10	  TableCell,
    11	  TableHead,
    12	  TableHeader,
    13	  TableRow,
    14	} from "@/components/ui/table";
    15	import { EmptyState, SectionCard, StatCard, useCLP } from "../primitives";
    16	import type { CatalogItem, Category, InvoiceItem } from "@/lib/analytics/types";
    17	import { effectiveCategoryId } from "@/lib/analytics/types";
    18	import { displayItemName } from "@/lib/analytics/aggregate";
    19	
    20	interface ItemsTabProps {
    21	  items: InvoiceItem[];
    22	  categoriesById: Map<string, Category>;
    23	  catalogById: Map<string, CatalogItem>;
    24	}
    25	
    26	interface ItemAggregate {
    27	  catalogItemId: string;
    28	  name: string;
    29	  categoryName: string | null;
    30	  total: number;
    31	  quantity: number;
    32	  lineCount: number;
    33	  units: string[];
    34	  weightedAvg: number | null;
    35	  meterCodes: string[];
    36	  itemCodes: string[];
    37	}
    38	
    39	
    40	export function ItemsTab({ items, categoriesById, catalogById }: ItemsTabProps) {
    41	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.items");
    42	  const clp = useCLP();
    43	  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    44	
    45	  const aggregates = useMemo<ItemAggregate[]>(() => {
    46	    interface Acc {
    47	      name: string;
    48	      categoryId: string;
    49	      total: number;
    50	      quantity: number;
    51	      lineCount: number;
    52	      units: Set<string>;
    53	      meterCodes: Set<string>;
    54	      itemCodes: Set<string>;
    55	      amountForPrice: number;
    56	      qtyForPrice: number;
    57	      priceSum: number;
    58	      priceCount: number;
    59	    }
    60	    const map = new Map<string, Acc>();
    61	
    62	    for (const item of items) {
    63	      let acc = map.get(item.catalog_item_id);
    64	      if (!acc) {
    65	        acc = {
    66	          name: displayItemName(item, catalogById),
    67	          categoryId: effectiveCategoryId(item),
    68	          total: 0,
    69	          quantity: 0,
    70	          lineCount: 0,
    71	          units: new Set(),
    72	          meterCodes: new Set(),
    73	          itemCodes: new Set(),
    74	          amountForPrice: 0,
    75	          qtyForPrice: 0,
    76	          priceSum: 0,
    77	          priceCount: 0,
    78	        };
    79	        map.set(item.catalog_item_id, acc);
    80	      }
    81	
    82	      acc.total += item.amount ?? 0;
    83	      acc.quantity += item.quantity ?? 0;
    84	      acc.lineCount += 1;
    85	      if (item.unit) acc.units.add(item.unit);
    86	      if (item.meter_code) acc.meterCodes.add(item.meter_code);
    87	      for (const code of item.item_codes) acc.itemCodes.add(code);
    88	
    89	      if (item.quantity !== null && item.quantity > 0 && item.amount !== null) {
    90	        acc.amountForPrice += item.amount;
    91	        acc.qtyForPrice += item.quantity;
    92	      }
    93	      if (item.unit_price !== null && item.unit_price > 0) {
    94	        acc.priceSum += item.unit_price;
    95	        acc.priceCount += 1;
    96	      }
    97	    }
    98	
    99	    return Array.from(map.entries())
   100	      .map(([catalogItemId, a]) => {
   101	        // Quantity-weighted, never a plain mean of unit_price — one 1-unit
   102	        // line must not outweigh a 1000-unit line.
   103	        const weightedAvg =
   104	          a.qtyForPrice > 0
   105	            ? a.amountForPrice / a.qtyForPrice
   106	            : a.priceCount > 0
   107	              ? a.priceSum / a.priceCount
   108	              : null;
   109	        return {
   110	          catalogItemId,
   111	          name: a.name,
   112	          categoryName: categoriesById.get(a.categoryId)?.name ?? null,
   113	          total: a.total,
   114	          quantity: a.quantity,
   115	          lineCount: a.lineCount,
   116	          units: Array.from(a.units).sort(),
   117	          weightedAvg,
   118	          meterCodes: Array.from(a.meterCodes).sort(),
   119	          itemCodes: Array.from(a.itemCodes).sort(),
   120	        };
   121	      })
   122	      .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
   123	  }, [items, categoriesById, catalogById]);
   124	
   125	  const visible = useMemo(() => {
   126	    const needle = search.trim().toLowerCase();
   127	    const base = needle
   128	      ? aggregates.filter(
   129	          (a) =>
   130	            a.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
   131	            a.itemCodes.some((c) => c.toLowerCase().includes(needle)) ||
   132	            a.meterCodes.some((c) => c.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
   133	        )
   134	      : aggregates;
   135	    return base.slice(0, 100);
   136	  }, [aggregates, search]);
   137	
   138	  const summary = useMemo(() => {
   139	    const meterTracked = aggregates.filter((a) => a.meterCodes.length > 0).length;
   140	    return {
   141	      distinct: aggregates.length,
   142	      meterTracked,
   143	    };
   144	  }, [aggregates]);
   145	
   146	  if (items.length === 0) return <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />;
   147	
   148	
   149	  return (
   150	    <div className="space-y-4">
   151	      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   152	        <StatCard label={t("distinctItems")} value={clp.num(summary.distinct)} />
   153	        <StatCard label={t("totalLines")} value={clp.num(items.length)} />
   154	        <StatCard
   155	          label={t("meterTracked")}
   156	          value={clp.num(summary.meterTracked)}
   157	          hint={t("meterTrackedHint")}
   158	        />
   159	      </div>
   160	
   161	      <SectionCard
   162	        title={t("catalogTitle")}
   163	        description={t("catalogHint", { shown: visible.length, total: aggregates.length })}
   164	        action={
   165	          <Input
   166	            value={search}
   167	            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
   168	            placeholder={t("searchPlaceholder")}
   169	            className="h-8 w-[220px] text-xs"
   170	          />
   171	        }
   172	      >
   173	        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
   174	          <Table>
   175	            <TableHeader>
   176	              <TableRow>
   177	                <TableHead>{t("item")}</TableHead>
   178	                <TableHead>{t("category")}</TableHead>
   179	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("spend")}</TableHead>
   180	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("quantity")}</TableHead>
   181	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("avgPrice")}</TableHead>
   182	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("lines")}</TableHead>
   183	                <TableHead>{t("codes")}</TableHead>
   184	              </TableRow>
   185	            </TableHeader>
   186	            <TableBody>
   187	              {visible.map((a) => (
   188	                <TableRow key={a.catalogItemId}>
   189	                  <TableCell className="max-w-[240px]">
   190	                    <span className="text-sm font-medium block truncate">{a.name}</span>
   191	                  </TableCell>
   192	                  <TableCell>
   193	                    {a.categoryName ? (
   194	                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{a.categoryName}</span>
   195	                    ) : (
   196	                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">—</span>
   197	                    )}
   198	                  </TableCell>
   199	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm font-semibold">
   200	                    {clp.full(a.total)}
   201	                  </TableCell>
   202	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   203	                    {clp.num(a.quantity, 0)}
   204	                    {a.units.length === 1 && (
   205	                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground ml-1">{a.units[0]}</span>
   206	                    )}
   207	                    {a.units.length > 1 && (
   208	                      <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-1 text-[9px] px-1">
   209	                        {t("mixedUnits")}
   210	                      </Badge>
   211	                    )}
   212	                  </TableCell>
   213	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   214	                    {clp.full(a.weightedAvg)}
   215	                  </TableCell>
   216	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">{a.lineCount}</TableCell>
   217	                  <TableCell className="max-w-[160px]">
   218	                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
   219	                      {/* Index-suffixed keys: even if two normalized codes
   220	                          coincide, the keys stay unique. */}
   221	                      {a.meterCodes.slice(0, 1).map((c, i) => (
   222	                        <Badge
   223	                          key={`${a.catalogItemId}-m${i}`}
   224	                          variant="secondary"
   225	                          className="text-[9px] px-1 font-mono"
   226	                        >
   227	                          {c}
   228	                        </Badge>
   229	                      ))}
   230	                      {a.itemCodes.slice(0, 2).map((c, i) => (
   231	                        <Badge
   232	                          key={`${a.catalogItemId}-c${i}`}
   233	                          variant="outline"
   234	                          className="text-[9px] px-1 font-mono"
   235	                        >
   236	                          {c}
   237	                        </Badge>
   238	                      ))}
   239	                    </div>
   240	                  </TableCell>
   241	                </TableRow>
   242	              ))}
   243	            </TableBody>
   244	          </Table>
   245	        </div>
   246	      </SectionCard>
   247	    </div>
   248	  );
   249	}
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     4	import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, Cell, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
     5	import { Info } from "lucide-react";
     6	import {
     7	  ChartContainer,
     8	  ChartTooltip,
     9	  ChartTooltipContent,
    10	  type ChartConfig,
    11	} from "@/components/ui/chart";
    12	import { EmptyState, MeterRow, SectionCard, StatCard, useCLP } from "../primitives";
    13	import type { AgingBucketKey, PaymentAnalysis } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
    14	
    15	// Aging is a risk signal, not a neutral magnitude ramp — reuse the app's
    16	// green/amber/orange/red attention idiom rather than a sequential palette.
    17	const BUCKET_COLORS: Record<AgingBucketKey, string> = {
    18	  no_due_date: "#94a3b8",
    19	  current: "#22c55e",
    20	  "1-30": "#84cc16",
    21	  "31-60": "#f59e0b",
    22	  "61-90": "#f97316",
    23	  "90+": "#ef4444",
    24	};
    25	
    26	export function PaymentsTab({ analysis }: { analysis: PaymentAnalysis }) {
    27	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.payments");
    28	  const clp = useCLP();
    29	
    30	  const chartData = analysis.agingBuckets.map((b) => ({
    31	    key: b.key,
    32	    label: t(`bucket_${b.key}`),
    33	    amount: b.amount,
    34	    count: b.count,
    35	    fill: BUCKET_COLORS[b.key],
    36	  }));
    37	
    38	  const config: ChartConfig = { amount: { label: t("amount"), color: "#94a3b8" } };
    39	  const maxPayment = analysis.paymentMetrics[0]?.totalAmount ?? 1;
    40	
    41	  return (
    42	    <div className="space-y-4">
    43	      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border bg-muted/30 p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
    44	        <Info className="size-3.5 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
    45	        <p>{t("disclosure")}</p>
    46	      </div>
    47	
    48	      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
    49	        <StatCard
    50	          label={t("total")}
    51	          value={clp.compact(analysis.total)}
    52	          exact={clp.full(analysis.total)}
    53	        />
    54	        <StatCard
    55	          label={t("overdue")}
    56	          value={clp.compact(analysis.totalOverdue)}
    57	          exact={clp.full(analysis.totalOverdue)}
    58	          tone={analysis.totalOverdue > 0 ? "negative" : "default"}
    59	          hint={t("overdueCount", { count: analysis.overdueCount })}
    60	        />
    61	        <StatCard
    62	          label={t("overduePct")}
    63	          value={clp.pct(analysis.overduePct)}
    64	          tone={analysis.overduePct > 20 ? "warning" : "default"}
    65	        />
    66	        <StatCard
    67	          label={t("avgTerms")}
    68	          value={
    69	            analysis.avgTermDays === null
    70	              ? "—"
    71	              : t("days", { days: Math.round(analysis.avgTermDays) })
    72	          }
    73	          hint={t("avgTermsHint")}
    74	        />
    75	      </div>
    76	
    77	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
    78	        <SectionCard title={t("agingTitle")} description={t("agingHint")}>
    79	          <ChartContainer config={config} className="aspect-auto h-[260px] w-full">
    80	            <BarChart data={chartData} margin={{ left: 4, right: 8 }}>
    81	              <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
    82	              <XAxis dataKey="label" tickLine={false} axisLine={false} tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} interval={0} />
    83	              <YAxis
    84	                tickLine={false}
    85	                axisLine={false}
    86	                width={58}
    87	                tick={{ fontSize: 11 }}
    88	                tickFormatter={(v: number) => clp.compact(v)}
    89	              />
    90	              <ChartTooltip
    91	                content={
    92	                  <ChartTooltipContent
    93	                    formatter={(value) => [clp.full(value as number), t("amount")]}
    94	                  />
    95	                }
    96	              />
    97	              <Bar dataKey="amount" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]}>
    98	                {chartData.map((d) => (
    99	                  <Cell key={d.key} fill={d.fill} />
   100	                ))}
   101	              </Bar>
   102	            </BarChart>
   103	          </ChartContainer>
   104	        </SectionCard>
   105	
   106	        <SectionCard title={t("formsTitle")} description={t("formsHint")}>
   107	          {analysis.paymentMetrics.length === 0 ? (
   108	            <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />
   109	          ) : (
   110	            <div className="space-y-1">
   111	              {analysis.paymentMetrics.slice(0, 10).map((m, i) => (
   112	                <MeterRow
   113	                  key={m.paymentForm || `__unspecified-${i}`}
   114	                  rank={i + 1}
   115	                  primary={m.paymentForm || t("unspecified")}
   116	                  secondary={`${t("invoices", { count: m.count })} · ${t("avg", {
   117	                    value: clp.compact(m.avgAmount),
   118	                  })}`}
   119	                  value={clp.compact(m.totalAmount)}
   120	                  exact={clp.full(m.totalAmount)}
   121	                  fraction={maxPayment > 0 ? m.totalAmount / maxPayment : 0}
   122	                />
   123	              ))}
   124	            </div>
   125	          )}
   126	        </SectionCard>
   127	      </div>
   128	    </div>
   129	  );
   130	}
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
     4	import { Bar, ComposedChart, CartesianGrid, Line, XAxis, YAxis } from "recharts";
     5	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     6	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
     7	import {
     8	  Table,
     9	  TableBody,
    10	  TableCell,
    11	  TableHead,
    12	  TableHeader,
    13	  TableRow,
    14	} from "@/components/ui/table";
    15	import {
    16	  ChartContainer,
    17	  ChartTooltip,
    18	  ChartTooltipContent,
    19	  type ChartConfig,
    20	} from "@/components/ui/chart";
    21	import { CHART_SERIES } from "@/lib/dashboard/colors";
    22	import { EmptyState, SectionCard, StatCard, useCLP } from "../primitives";
    23	import { analyzePareto } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
    24	import type { NetworkEdge, ParetoDimension } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
    25	import type { Category, Invoice, InvoiceItem } from "@/lib/analytics/types";
    26	
    27	interface ConcentrationTabProps {
    28	  invoices: Invoice[];
    29	  items: InvoiceItem[];
    30	  categoriesById: Map<string, Category>;
    31	  network: NetworkEdge[];
    32	}
    33	
    34	const DIMENSIONS: ParetoDimension[] = ["seller", "buyer", "category", "city", "item"];
    35	
    36	/** HHI thresholds follow the standard antitrust reading: under 1500 is
    37	 *  unconcentrated, 1500–2500 moderate, above 2500 highly concentrated. */
    38	function hhiTone(hhi: number): "positive" | "warning" | "negative" {
    39	  if (hhi < 1500) return "positive";
    40	  if (hhi < 2500) return "warning";
    41	  return "negative";
    42	}
    43	
    44	export function ConcentrationTab({
    45	  invoices,
    46	  items,
    47	  categoriesById,
    48	  network,
    49	}: ConcentrationTabProps) {
    50	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.concentration");
    51	  const clp = useCLP();
    52	  const [dimension, setDimension] = useState<ParetoDimension>("seller");
    53	
    54	  const pareto = useMemo(
    55	    () => analyzePareto(invoices, items, dimension, categoriesById),
    56	    [invoices, items, dimension, categoriesById]
    57	  );
    58	
    59	  const chartData = useMemo(
    60	    () =>
    61	      pareto.entries.slice(0, 15).map((e) => ({
    62	        name: e.name.length > 16 ? `${e.name.slice(0, 14)}…` : e.name,
    63	        amount: e.amount,
    64	        cumulative: e.cumulativePct,
    65	      })),
    66	    [pareto.entries]
    67	  );
    68	
    69	  const config: ChartConfig = {
    70	    amount: { label: t("amount"), theme: CHART_SERIES[0] },
    71	    cumulative: { label: t("cumulative"), theme: CHART_SERIES[1] },
    72	  };
    73	
    74	  const maxNetwork = network[0]?.amount ?? 1;
    75	
    76	  return (
    77	    <div className="space-y-4">
    78	      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
    79	        {DIMENSIONS.map((d) => (
    80	          <Button
    81	            key={d}
    82	            size="sm"
    83	            variant={dimension === d ? "default" : "outline"}
    84	            className="h-7 text-xs"
    85	            onClick={() => setDimension(d)}
    86	          >
    87	            {t(`dim_${d}`)}
    88	          </Button>
    89	        ))}
    90	      </div>
    91	
    92	      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
    93	        <StatCard
    94	          label={t("hhi")}
    95	          value={pareto.hhi.toFixed(0)}
    96	          tone={hhiTone(pareto.hhi)}
    97	          hint={t(
    98	            pareto.hhi < 1500 ? "hhiLow" : pareto.hhi < 2500 ? "hhiModerate" : "hhiHigh"
    99	          )}
   100	        />
   101	        <StatCard
   102	          label={t("paretoCount")}
   103	          value={clp.num(pareto.paretoCount)}
   104	          hint={t("paretoHint", {
   105	            pct: pareto.paretoPct.toFixed(0),
   106	            total: pareto.entries.length,
   107	          })}
   108	        />
   109	        <StatCard
   110	          label={t("topShare")}
   111	          value={clp.pct(pareto.topShare)}
   112	          tone={pareto.topShare > 40 ? "warning" : "default"}
   113	          hint={pareto.entries[0]?.name}
   114	        />
   115	        <StatCard label={t("totalEntities")} value={clp.num(pareto.entries.length)} />
   116	      </div>
   117	
   118	      <SectionCard title={t("paretoTitle")} description={t("paretoDescription")}>
   119	        {chartData.length === 0 ? (

   121	        ) : (

   136	                  anti-pattern: a Pareto chart's cumulative line is a fixed

   139	              <YAxis

   168	          </ChartContainer>
   169	        )}
   170	      </SectionCard>
   171	
   172	      <SectionCard title={t("networkTitle")} description={t("networkHint")}>

   174	          <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />
   175	        ) : (

   177	            <Table>

   179	                <TableRow>

   203	                    </TableCell>

   219	              </TableBody>
   220	            </Table>
   221	          </div>

   223	      </SectionCard>
   224	    </div>

    62	interface DashboardViewProps {
    63	  categories: Category[];

    71	
    72	function getErrorMessage(err: unknown): string {
    73	  if (err instanceof Error) return err.message;
    74	  if (err && typeof err === "object") {
    75	    const { message, details, hint, code } = err as Record<string, unknown>;
    76	    const parts = [message, details, hint, code].filter(
    77	      (v): v is string => typeof v === "string" && v.length > 0
    78	    );
    79	    if (parts.length > 0) return parts.join(" — ");
    80	  }
    81	  return String(err);
    82	}
    83	
    84	export function DashboardView({
    85	  categories,
    86	  companies,
    87	  catalog,
    88	  initialInvoices,
    89	  initialRange,
    90	  dateBounds,
    91	  error: initialError,
    92	}: DashboardViewProps) {
    93	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard");
    94	
    95	  const baseFilters = useMemo<AnalyticsFilters>(
    96	    () => ({ ...DEFAULT_FILTERS, dateFrom: initialRange.from, dateTo: initialRange.to }),
    97	    [initialRange.from, initialRange.to]
    98	  );
    99	
   100	  const [filters, setFilters] = useState<AnalyticsFilters>(baseFilters);
   101	  const [invoices, setInvoices] = useState(initialInvoices);
   102	  // Lines are NOT server-rendered. They are the largest and slowest part of
   103	  // the payload, and seven of the ten tabs render without them, so waiting on
   104	  // them would hold back the whole page for content most views never use.
   105	  const [items, setItems] = useState<InvoiceItem[]>([]);
   106	  const [linesReady, setLinesReady] = useState(false);
   107	  const [loadedRange, setLoadedRange] = useState(initialRange);
   108	  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
   109	  const [error, setError] = useState(initialError);
   110	  const [linesError, setLinesError] = useState<string | null>(null);
   111	  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("overview");
   112	
   113	  useEffect(() => {
   114	    setInvoices(initialInvoices);
   115	    setError(initialError);
   116	  }, [initialInvoices, initialError]);
   117	
   118	  /**
   119	   * Streams the line items in once the shell is on screen.
   120	   *
   121	   * Scoped by date rather than by invoice id, so it has no dependency on the
   122	   * invoice fetch and starts immediately.
   123	   *
   124	   * Staleness is guarded with a monotonic request id rather than an effect
   125	   * cleanup: the fetch is async, so a cleanup function would only run after it
   126	   * resolved — far too late to prevent a superseded response from overwriting
   127	   * newer data. Comparing the id on return is what actually makes a fast
   128	   * second range change safe.

   130	  const lineRequestId = useRef(0);
   131	
   132	  useEffect(() => {
   133	    if (!loadedRange.from || !loadedRange.to) return;

   143	          endDate: loadedRange.to,

   146	        setItems(lines);
   147	        setLinesReady(true);
   148	      } catch (err) {

   150	        if (lineRequestId.current !== requestId) return;
   151	        // Surface it, but leave the invoice-only tabs fully working.
   152	        setLinesError(getErrorMessage(err));
   153	        setLinesReady(true);
   154	      }
   155	    })();
   156	  }, [loadedRange.from, loadedRange.to]);
   157	
   158	  const setFilter = useCallback(
   159	    <K extends keyof AnalyticsFilters>(key: K, value: AnalyticsFilters[K]) => {
   160	      setFilters((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
   161	    },
   162	    []
   163	  );
   164	
   165	  const resetFilters = useCallback(() => setFilters(baseFilters), [baseFilters]);

   168	  const clearFilter = useCallback(

   172	    []
   173	  );
   174	
   175	  // Clicking the same entity again steps back out, so a chart mark toggles
   176	  // rather than being a one-way trip in.

   180	    },
   181	    []
   182	  );
   183	
   184	  // Only the date range needs a round trip — it changes which rows exist at
   185	  // all. Every other filter narrows what's already in memory.
   186	  const isDirtyRange =
   187	    filters.dateFrom !== loadedRange.from || filters.dateTo !== loadedRange.to;
   188

   195	        startDate: filters.dateFrom,

   197	      });

   199	      // Changing loadedRange re-triggers the line stream for the new window.
   200	      setLoadedRange({ from: filters.dateFrom, to: filters.dateTo });
   201	    } catch (err) {
   202	      console.log("[dashboard] range refetch failed:", err);
   203	      setError(getErrorMessage(err));
   204	    } finally {
   205	      setIsLoading(false);
   206	    }
   207	  }, [filters.dateFrom, filters.dateTo]);
   208	
   209	  // --- Derived data. Every tab reads from this one filtered pair. ---

   211	  const filtered = useMemo(

   347	                {tabs.map((tab) => (
   348	                  <TabsTrigger key={tab.value} value={tab.value} className="text-xs gap-1.5 px-3">
   349	                    <tab.icon className="size-3.5" />
   350	                    <span className="hidden sm:inline">{tab.label}</span>
   351	                  </TabsTrigger>
   352	                ))}
   353	              </TabsList>
   354	
   355	              <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   356	                <InsightsPanel insights={insights} />
   357	                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
   358	                  <RevenueChart data={timeSeries} />
   359	                  <VolumeChart data={timeSeries} />
   360	                </div>
   361	                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
   362	                  <div className="lg:col-span-2">
   363	                    <CounterpartyPanel
   364	                      metrics={topSellers}
   365	                      role="seller"
   366	                      onSelect={(id) => toggleFilter("companyId", id)}
   367	                    transactionType={filters.transactionType}
   368	                    />
   369	                  </div>
   370	                  <FiscalBreakdown kpis={kpis} linesReady={linesReady} />
   371	                </div>
   372	              </TabsContent>
   373	
   374	              <TabsContent value="companies" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   375	                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
   376	                  <CounterpartyPanel
   377	                    metrics={topSellers}
   378	                    role="seller"
   379	                    onSelect={(id) => toggleFilter("companyId", id)}
   380	                  transactionType={filters.transactionType}
   381	                  />
   382	                  <CounterpartyPanel
   383	                    metrics={topBuyers}
   384	                    role="buyer"
   385	                    onSelect={(id) => toggleFilter("companyId", id)}
   386	                  transactionType={filters.transactionType}
   387	                  />
   388	                </div>
   389	              </TabsContent>
   390	
   391	              <TabsContent value="categories" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   392	                {!linesReady ? (
   393	                  <PendingLines error={linesError} variant="cards" />
   394	                ) : (
   395	                <CategoriesTab
   396	                  metrics={categoryMetrics}
   397	                  onSelect={(id) => toggleFilter("categoryId", id)}
   398	                />
   399	                )}
   400	              </TabsContent>
   401	
   402	              <TabsContent value="items" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   403	                {!linesReady ? (
   404	                  <PendingLines error={linesError} variant="cards" />
   405	                ) : (
   406	                <ItemsTab
   407	                  items={filtered.items}
   408	                  categoriesById={categoriesById}
   409	                  catalogById={catalogById}
   410	                />
   411	                )}
   412	              </TabsContent>
   413	
   414	              {/* Risk tab temporarily disabled.
   415	                  Re-enable by uncommenting the import, the tabs[] entry and this
   416	                  block. `anomalies` below still feeds the Overview insights, so it
   417	                  stays computed.
   418	                  <TabsContent value="risk" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   419	                  {!linesReady ? (
   420	                  <PendingLines error={linesError} variant="cards" />
   421	                  ) : (
   422	                  <RiskTab anomalies={anomalies} />
   423	                  )}
   424	                  </TabsContent>
   425	              */}
   426	
   427	              <TabsContent value="payments" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   428	                <PaymentsTab analysis={payments} />
   429	              </TabsContent>
   430	
   431	              <TabsContent value="concentration" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   432	                <ConcentrationTab
   433	                  invoices={filtered.invoices}
   434	                  items={filtered.items}
   435	                  categoriesById={categoriesById}
   436	                  network={network}
   437	                />
   438	              </TabsContent>
   439	
   440	              <TabsContent value="geography" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   441	                <GeographyTab entries={geography} onSelectCity={(c) => toggleFilter("city", c)} />
   442	              </TabsContent>
   443	
   444	              <TabsContent value="explorer" className="space-y-4 mt-4">
   445	                {!linesReady ? (
   446	                  <PendingLines error={linesError} variant="cards" />
   447	                ) : (
   448	                <ExplorerTab
   449	                  invoices={filtered.invoices}
   450	                  items={filtered.items}
   451	                  categoriesById={categoriesById}
   452	                  companiesById={companiesById}
   453	                  catalogById={catalogById}
   454	                />
   455	                )}
   456	              </TabsContent>
   457	            </Tabs>
   458	          </>
   459	        )}
   460	      </main>
   461	    </div>
   462	  );
   463	}

    69	/** The period key used for every time series: "YYYY-MM", straight off the
    70	 *  generated invoice_period column, falling back to slicing invoice_date if
    71	 *  the generated value ever arrives null. */
    72	export function periodOf(invoice: Invoice): string {
    73	  return invoice.invoice_period ?? invoice.invoice_date.slice(0, 7);
    74	}

    76	export function aggregateKpis(invoices: Invoice[], items: InvoiceItem[]): KpiData {
    77	  let totalRevenue = 0;
    78	  let totalSales = 0;
    79	  let totalPurchases = 0;
    80	  let netAmount = 0;
    81	  let ivaAmount = 0;
    82	  let exemptAmount = 0;
    83	  const counterparties = new Set<string>();
    84	
    85	  for (const inv of invoices) {
    86	    const total = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
    87	    totalRevenue += total;
    88	    if (inv.transaction_type === "VENTAS") totalSales += total;
    89	    else totalPurchases += total;
    90	    netAmount += inv.net_amount ?? 0;
    91	    ivaAmount += inv.iva_amount ?? 0;
    92	    exemptAmount += inv.exempt_amount ?? 0;
    93	    counterparties.add(counterpartyOf(inv).rut);
    94	  }
    95	
    96	  let needsReviewCount = 0;
    97	  let autoAcceptCount = 0;
    98	  let discountTotal = 0;
    99	  let recargoTotal = 0;
   100	  const catalogItems = new Set<string>();
   101	
   102	  for (const item of items) {
   103	    if (item.needs_review) needsReviewCount++;
   104	    if (item.decision === "auto_accept") autoAcceptCount++;
   105	    discountTotal += item.discount_amount ?? 0;
   106	    recargoTotal += item.recargo_amount ?? 0;
   107	    catalogItems.add(item.catalog_item_id);
   108	  }
   109	
   110	  const totalInvoices = invoices.length;
   111	
   112	  return {
   113	    totalRevenue,
   114	    totalPurchases,
   115	    totalSales,
   116	    netAmount,
   117	    ivaAmount,
   118	    exemptAmount,
   119	    totalInvoices,
   120	    totalLines: items.length,
   121	    avgInvoiceValue: totalInvoices > 0 ? totalRevenue / totalInvoices : 0,
   122	    needsReviewPct: items.length > 0 ? (needsReviewCount / items.length) * 100 : 0,
   123	    autoAcceptPct: items.length > 0 ? (autoAcceptCount / items.length) * 100 : 0,
   124	    distinctCounterparties: counterparties.size,
   125	    distinctItems: catalogItems.size,
   126	    discountTotal,
   127	    recargoTotal,
   128	  };
   129	}
   130	
   131	export function aggregateTimeSeries(
   132	  invoices: Invoice[],
   133	  items: InvoiceItem[]
   134	): TimeSeriesPoint[] {
   135	  const linesByInvoice = new Map<string, number>();
   136	  for (const item of items) {
   137	    linesByInvoice.set(item.invoice_id, (linesByInvoice.get(item.invoice_id) ?? 0) + 1);
   138	  }
   139	
   140	  const map = new Map<string, TimeSeriesPoint>();
   141	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   142	    const period = periodOf(inv);
   143	    let point = map.get(period);
   144	    if (!point) {
   145	      point = { period, ventas: 0, compras: 0, total: 0, invoiceCount: 0, lineCount: 0 };
   146	      map.set(period, point);
   147	    }
   148	    const total = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   149	    if (inv.transaction_type === "VENTAS") point.ventas += total;
   150	    else point.compras += total;
   151	    point.total += total;
   152	    point.invoiceCount += 1;
   153	    point.lineCount += linesByInvoice.get(inv.invoice_id) ?? 0;
   154	  }
   155	
   156	  return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => a.period.localeCompare(b.period));
   157	}
   158	
   159	/**
   160	 * Top counterparties on the given side, keyed by RUT.
   161	 *
   162	 * RUT is the right key rather than company_id: company_id points at *our*
   163	 * organisation's row on the invoice, so grouping by it would collapse every
   164	 * counterparty together. The denormalized seller/buyer columns carry the
   165	 * other party, and RUT is unique per company in this schema.
   166	 */
   167	export function aggregateTopCounterparties(
   168	  invoices: Invoice[],
   169	  role: "seller" | "buyer",
   170	  companiesByRut: Map<string, Company>,
   171	  limit = 10
   172	): CounterpartyMetric[] {
   173	  const map = new Map<string, CounterpartyMetric>();
   174	
   175	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   176	    const rut = role === "seller" ? inv.seller_rut : inv.buyer_rut;
   177	    const name = role === "seller" ? inv.seller_name : inv.buyer_name;
   178	    const city = role === "seller" ? inv.seller_city : inv.buyer_city;
   179	    const giro = role === "seller" ? inv.seller_giro : inv.buyer_giro;
   180	
   181	    let entry = map.get(rut);
   182	    if (!entry) {
   183	      entry = {
   184	        companyId: companiesByRut.get(rut)?.company_id ?? null,
   185	        rut,
   186	        name,
   187	        city,
   188	        giro,
   189	        totalAmount: 0,
   190	        invoiceCount: 0,
   191	        avgAmount: 0,
   192	        role,
   193	      };
   194	      map.set(rut, entry);
   195	    }
   196	    entry.totalAmount += inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   197	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   198	  }
   199	
   200	  return Array.from(map.values())
   201	    .map((m) => ({ ...m, avgAmount: m.invoiceCount > 0 ? m.totalAmount / m.invoiceCount : 0 }))
   202	    .sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount)
   203	    .slice(0, limit);
   204	}

   206	export function aggregateCategoryMetrics(
   207	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   208	  categoriesById: Map<string, Category>
   209	): CategoryMetric[] {
   210	  interface Acc extends Omit<CategoryMetric, "avgScore" | "distinctItems"> {
   211	    scoreSum: number;
   212	    catalogIds: Set<string>;
   213	  }
   214	  const map = new Map<string, Acc>();
   215	
   216	  for (const item of items) {
   217	    const categoryId = effectiveCategoryId(item);
   218	    let entry = map.get(categoryId);
   219	    if (!entry) {
   220	      const category = categoriesById.get(categoryId);
   221	      entry = {
   222	        categoriesId: categoryId,
   223	        // Fall back to the row's own denormalized code/name rather than
   224	        // dropping the line when a category lookup misses — the reference
   225	        // dashboard skipped such lines entirely, which silently understated
   226	        // totals whenever a category was missing from the lookup table.
   227	        code: category?.code ?? item.final_code ?? item.predicted_code,
   228	        name: category?.name ?? item.predicted_name ?? item.predicted_code,
   229	        totalAmount: 0,
   230	        itemCount: 0,
   231	        autoAcceptCount: 0,
   232	        reviewCount: 0,
   233	        correctedCount: 0,
   234	        scoreSum: 0,
   235	        catalogIds: new Set(),
   236	      };
   237	      map.set(categoryId, entry);
   238	    }
   239	
   240	    entry.totalAmount += item.amount ?? 0;
   241	    entry.itemCount += 1;
   242	    entry.scoreSum += item.top1_score;
   243	    entry.catalogIds.add(item.catalog_item_id);
   244	    if (item.decision === "auto_accept") entry.autoAcceptCount += 1;
   245	    else entry.reviewCount += 1;
   246	    // A reviewer moved this line off the model's prediction.
   247	    if (item.final_categories_id && item.final_categories_id !== item.predicted_categories_id) {
   248	      entry.correctedCount += 1;
   249	    }
   250	  }
   251	
   252	  return Array.from(map.values())
   253	    .map(({ scoreSum, catalogIds, ...rest }) => ({
   254	      ...rest,
   255	      avgScore: rest.itemCount > 0 ? scoreSum / rest.itemCount : 0,
   256	      distinctItems: catalogIds.size,
   257	    }))
   258	    .sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount);
   259	}

   261	export function aggregateAiSourceMetrics(items: InvoiceItem[]): AiSourceMetric[] {
   262	  interface Acc {
   263	    source: string;
   264	    count: number;
   265	    scoreSum: number;
   266	    entropySum: number;
   267	    marginSum: number;
   268	    autoAccepted: number;
   269	  }
   270	  const map = new Map<string, Acc>();
   271	
   272	  for (const item of items) {
   273	    let entry = map.get(item.prediction_source);
   274	    if (!entry) {
   275	      entry = {
   276	        source: item.prediction_source,
   277	        count: 0,
   278	        scoreSum: 0,
   279	        entropySum: 0,
   280	        marginSum: 0,
   281	        autoAccepted: 0,
   282	      };
   283	      map.set(item.prediction_source, entry);
   284	    }
   285	    entry.count += 1;
   286	    entry.scoreSum += item.top1_score;
   287	    entry.entropySum += item.entropy;
   288	    entry.marginSum += item.margin;
   289	    if (item.decision === "auto_accept") entry.autoAccepted += 1;
   290	  }
   291	
   292	  return Array.from(map.values())
   293	    .map((m) => ({
   294	      source: m.source,
   295	      count: m.count,
   296	      avgScore: m.count > 0 ? m.scoreSum / m.count : 0,
   297	      avgEntropy: m.count > 0 ? m.entropySum / m.count : 0,
   298	      avgMargin: m.count > 0 ? m.marginSum / m.count : 0,
   299	      autoAcceptRate: m.count > 0 ? (m.autoAccepted / m.count) * 100 : 0,
   300	    }))
   301	    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
   302	}
   303	
   304	export interface ScoreBucket {
   305	  bucket: string;
   306	  bucketStart: number;
   307	  count: number;
   308	}
   309	
   310	/**
   311	 * Confidence distribution over the full 0–1 range in fixed 0.1 bins.
   312	 *
   313	 * The reference version bucketed everything below 0.6 into a bin labelled
   314	 * "0.5-0.6", which mislabels genuinely low-confidence predictions — the exact
   315	 * rows a reviewer most needs to see. Ten honest bins instead.
   316	 */
   317	export function aggregateScoreDistribution(items: InvoiceItem[], binSize = 0.1): ScoreBucket[] {
   318	  const binCount = Math.round(1 / binSize);
   319	  const counts = new Array<number>(binCount).fill(0);
   320	
   321	  // Bin on integers, not floats. `0.6 / 0.1` is 5.999999999999999 in IEEE-754,
   322	  // so flooring it files a score of exactly 0.60 into the "0.5-0.6" bucket —
   323	  // one bucket too low. The same happens at 0.3, 0.7 and 0.95; only 0.8 is
   324	  // exactly representable. Scaling both sides to integers first removes the
   325	  // whole class of boundary error.
   326	  const SCALE = 10_000;
   327	  const binScaled = Math.round(binSize * SCALE);
   328	
   329	  for (const item of items) {
   330	    const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(item.top1_score, 0), 1);
   331	    const index = Math.min(
   332	      Math.floor(Math.round(clamped * SCALE) / binScaled),
   333	      binCount - 1
   334	    );
   335	    counts[index] += 1;
   336	  }
   337	
   338	  return counts.map((count, index) => {
   339	    const start = index * binSize;
   340	    return {
   341	      bucket: `${start.toFixed(1)}–${(start + binSize).toFixed(1)}`,
   342	      bucketStart: start,
   343	      count,
   344	    };
   345	  });
   346	}

   348	export interface ReviewQueueEntry {
   349	  item: InvoiceItem;
   350	  invoice: Invoice | undefined;
   351	}
   352	
   353	/**
   354	 * The manual-triage worklist: unreviewed lines the model flagged, most
   355	 * uncertain first. Sorted by entropy (spread across all candidates) with
   356	 * margin as the tiebreaker — two lines can share an entropy while one has a
   357	 * much closer runner-up, and that one deserves attention first.
   358	 */
   359	export function selectReviewQueue(
   360	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   361	  invoicesById: Map<string, Invoice>,
   362	  limit = 50
   363	): ReviewQueueEntry[] {
   364	  return items
   365	    .filter((item) => item.needs_review)
   366	    .sort((a, b) => b.entropy - a.entropy || a.margin - b.margin)
   367	    .slice(0, limit)
   368	    .map((item) => ({ item, invoice: invoicesById.get(item.invoice_id) }));
   369	}

   403	export function analyzePareto(
   404	  invoices: Invoice[],
   405	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   406	  dimension: ParetoDimension,
   407	  categoriesById: Map<string, Category>
   408	): ParetoResult {
   409	  const map = new Map<string, { name: string; amount: number; count: number }>();
   410	  const add = (key: string, name: string, amount: number) => {
   411	    let entry = map.get(key);
   412	    if (!entry) {
   413	      entry = { name, amount: 0, count: 0 };
   414	      map.set(key, entry);
   415	    }
   416	    entry.amount += amount;
   417	    entry.count += 1;
   418	  };
   419	
   420	  if (dimension === "seller") {
   421	    for (const inv of invoices) add(inv.seller_rut, inv.seller_name, inv.total_amount ?? 0);
   422	  } else if (dimension === "buyer") {
   423	    for (const inv of invoices) add(inv.buyer_rut, inv.buyer_name, inv.total_amount ?? 0);
   424	  } else if (dimension === "city") {
   425	    // Attribute to the counterparty's city rather than always the seller's:
   426	    // on a VENTAS invoice the seller is us, so the reference's seller-only
   427	    // rule collapsed every sale into our own city.
   428	    for (const inv of invoices) {
   429	      const city =
   430	        (inv.transaction_type === "COMPRAS" ? inv.seller_city : inv.buyer_city) ?? "";
   431	      add(city || "__unknown__", city, inv.total_amount ?? 0);
   432	    }
   433	  } else if (dimension === "category") {
   434	    // Uses the EFFECTIVE category. The reference matched final_categories_id
   435	    // only, so every unreviewed line — the majority — fell into "Sin
   436	    // categoría" and understated every real category.
   437	    for (const item of items) {
   438	      const id = effectiveCategoryId(item);
   439	      const category = categoriesById.get(id);
   440	      add(id, category?.name ?? item.predicted_name ?? item.predicted_code, item.amount ?? 0);
   441	    }
   442	  } else {
   443	    for (const item of items) add(item.catalog_item_id, item.item_text, item.amount ?? 0);
   444	  }
   445	
   446	  const sorted = Array.from(map.entries())
   447	    .map(([key, v]) => ({ key, ...v }))
   448	    .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount);
   449	
   450	  const total = sorted.reduce((s, v) => s + v.amount, 0);
   451	
   452	  let cumulative = 0;
   453	  let paretoCount = 0;
   454	  let reachedPareto = false;
   455	  const entries: ParetoEntry[] = sorted.map((v) => {
   456	    const pct = total > 0 ? (v.amount / total) * 100 : 0;
   457	    cumulative += pct;
   458	    if (!reachedPareto) {
   459	      paretoCount += 1;
   460	      if (cumulative >= 80) reachedPareto = true;
   461	    }
   462	    return { ...v, pct, cumulativePct: cumulative };
   463	  });
   464	
   465	  const hhi = entries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.pct ** 2, 0);
   466	
   467	  return {
   468	    entries,
   469	    total,
   470	    paretoCount,
   471	    paretoPct: entries.length > 0 ? (paretoCount / entries.length) * 100 : 0,
   472	    hhi,
   473	    topShare: entries[0]?.pct ?? 0,
   474	  };
   475	}
   476	
   477	// --- Payment analysis ---
   478	
   479	export interface PaymentMetric {
   480	  paymentForm: string;
   481	  count: number;
   482	  totalAmount: number;
   483	  avgAmount: number;
   484	  pct: number;
   485	}
   486	
   487	export type AgingBucketKey = "no_due_date" | "current" | "1-30" | "31-60" | "61-90" | "90+";
   488	
   489	export interface AgingBucket {
   490	  key: AgingBucketKey;
   491	  count: number;
   492	  amount: number;
   493	}
   494	
   495	export interface PaymentAnalysis {
   496	  paymentMetrics: PaymentMetric[];
   497	  agingBuckets: AgingBucket[];
   498	  totalOverdue: number;
   499	  overdueCount: number;
   500	  overduePct: number;
   501	  total: number;
   502	  avgTermDays: number | null;
   503	}
   504	
   505	const AGING_ORDER: AgingBucketKey[] = [
   506	  "no_due_date",
   507	  "current",
   508	  "1-30",
   509	  "31-60",
   510	  "61-90",
   511	  "90+",
   512	];
   513	
   514	/**
   515	 * Payment-form mix and due-date aging.
   516	 *
   517	 * Three corrections against the reference:
   518	 *  - `asOf` is a parameter, not a hardcoded `new Date('2024-10-31')`.
   519	 *  - Invoices with no due_date get their own bucket. The reference did
   520	 *    `new Date(null)` → Invalid Date → NaN comparisons, which fell through
   521	 *    every branch into "90+ days overdue" and silently invented overdue debt.
   522	 *  - No hardcoded 'Contado' skip. That literal only existed in the mock's
   523	 *    payment_form values; real values are unconstrained, so cash invoices are
   524	 *    identified by simply having no due date.
   525	 *
   526	 * As with the AP tab, this schema has no paid/settled flag, so "overdue"
   527	 * means past due date, not necessarily unpaid.
   528	 */
   529	export function analyzePayments(invoices: Invoice[], asOf: Date): PaymentAnalysis {
   530	  const payMap = new Map<string, PaymentMetric>();
   531	  const buckets = new Map<AgingBucketKey, AgingBucket>(
   532	    AGING_ORDER.map((key) => [key, { key, count: 0, amount: 0 }])
   533	  );
   534	
   535	  let total = 0;
   536	  let totalOverdue = 0;
   537	  let overdueCount = 0;
   538	  let termSum = 0;
   539	  let termCount = 0;
   540	
   541	  const asOfMs = asOf.getTime();
   542	
   543	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   544	    const amount = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   545	    total += amount;
   546	
   547	    const form = inv.payment_form ?? "";
   548	    let metric = payMap.get(form);
   549	    if (!metric) {
   550	      metric = { paymentForm: form, count: 0, totalAmount: 0, avgAmount: 0, pct: 0 };
   551	      payMap.set(form, metric);
   552	    }
   553	    metric.count += 1;
   554	    metric.totalAmount += amount;
   555	
   556	    if (!inv.due_date) {
   557	      const bucket = buckets.get("no_due_date")!;
   558	      bucket.count += 1;
   559	      bucket.amount += amount;
   560	      continue;
   561	    }
   562	
   563	    const dueMs = new Date(`${inv.due_date}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
   564	    const issuedMs = new Date(`${inv.invoice_date}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
   565	    if (Number.isFinite(dueMs) && Number.isFinite(issuedMs)) {
   566	      termSum += (dueMs - issuedMs) / 86_400_000;
   567	      termCount += 1;
   568	    }
   569	
   570	    const overdueDays = Math.floor((asOfMs - dueMs) / 86_400_000);
   571	    const key: AgingBucketKey =
   572	      overdueDays <= 0
   573	        ? "current"
   574	        : overdueDays <= 30
   575	          ? "1-30"
   576	          : overdueDays <= 60
   577	            ? "31-60"
   578	            : overdueDays <= 90
   579	              ? "61-90"
   580	              : "90+";
   581	
   582	    const bucket = buckets.get(key)!;
   583	    bucket.count += 1;
   584	    bucket.amount += amount;
   585	
   586	    if (key !== "current") {
   587	      totalOverdue += amount;
   588	      overdueCount += 1;
   589	    }
   590	  }
   591	
   592	  const paymentMetrics = Array.from(payMap.values())
   593	    .map((m) => ({
   594	      ...m,
   595	      avgAmount: m.count > 0 ? m.totalAmount / m.count : 0,
   596	      pct: total > 0 ? (m.totalAmount / total) * 100 : 0,
   597	    }))
   598	    .sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount);
   599	
   600	  return {
   601	    paymentMetrics,
   602	    agingBuckets: AGING_ORDER.map((key) => buckets.get(key)!),
   603	    totalOverdue,
   604	    overdueCount,
   605	    overduePct: invoices.length > 0 ? (overdueCount / invoices.length) * 100 : 0,
   606	    total,
   607	    avgTermDays: termCount > 0 ? termSum / termCount : null,
   608	  };
   609	}

   611	// --- Geography ---
   612	
   613	export interface GeoEntry {
   614	  city: string;
   615	  totalAmount: number;
   616	  ventas: number;
   617	  compras: number;
   618	  invoiceCount: number;
   619	  counterparties: number;
   620	}
   621	
   622	export function analyzeGeography(invoices: Invoice[]): GeoEntry[] {
   623	  const map = new Map<string, GeoEntry & { rutSet: Set<string> }>();
   624	
   625	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   626	    // Attribute to the counterparty's city — theirs is the location that
   627	    // varies; ours is the same on every row and would swamp the chart.
   628	    const isPurchase = inv.transaction_type === "COMPRAS";
   629	    const city = (isPurchase ? inv.seller_city : inv.buyer_city) ?? "";
   630	    const rut = isPurchase ? inv.seller_rut : inv.buyer_rut;
   631	    const key = city || "__unknown__";
   632	
   633	    let entry = map.get(key);
   634	    if (!entry) {
   635	      entry = {
   636	        city,
   637	        totalAmount: 0,
   638	        ventas: 0,
   639	        compras: 0,
   640	        invoiceCount: 0,
   641	        counterparties: 0,
   642	        rutSet: new Set(),
   643	      };
   644	      map.set(key, entry);
   645	    }
   646	
   647	    const amount = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   648	    entry.totalAmount += amount;
   649	    if (isPurchase) entry.compras += amount;
   650	    else entry.ventas += amount;
   651	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   652	    entry.rutSet.add(rut);
   653	  }
   654	
   655	  return Array.from(map.values())
   656	    .map(({ rutSet, ...rest }) => ({ ...rest, counterparties: rutSet.size }))
   657	    .sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount);
   658	}

   660	// --- Trading network ---
   661	
   662	export interface NetworkEdge {
   663	  sellerRut: string;
   664	  sellerName: string;
   665	  buyerRut: string;
   666	  buyerName: string;
   667	  amount: number;
   668	  invoiceCount: number;
   669	}
   670	
   671	/**
   672	 * Seller→buyer trading pairs. Both sides are real here because the schema
   673	 * denormalizes them onto every invoice, so this is a genuine two-sided graph
   674	 * rather than a star centred on our own organisation.
   675	 */
   676	export function analyzeNetwork(invoices: Invoice[], limit = 30): NetworkEdge[] {
   677	  const map = new Map<string, NetworkEdge>();
   678	
   679	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   680	    const key = `${inv.seller_rut}>${inv.buyer_rut}`;
   681	    let edge = map.get(key);
   682	    if (!edge) {
   683	      edge = {
   684	        sellerRut: inv.seller_rut,
   685	        sellerName: inv.seller_name,
   686	        buyerRut: inv.buyer_rut,
   687	        buyerName: inv.buyer_name,
   688	        amount: 0,
   689	        invoiceCount: 0,
   690	      };
   691	      map.set(key, edge);
   692	    }
   693	    edge.amount += inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   694	    edge.invoiceCount += 1;
   695	  }
   696	
   697	  return Array.from(map.values())
   698	    .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount)
   699	    .slice(0, limit);
   700	}

   702	// --- Generated insights ---
   703	
   704	export type InsightTone = "positive" | "negative" | "neutral" | "warning";
   705	
   706	export interface Insight {
   707	  id: string;
   708	  tone: InsightTone;
   709	  /** Translation key under Dashboard.insights.*; values fill its ICU params. */
   710	  messageKey: string;
   711	  values: Record<string, string | number>;
   712	  priority: number;
   713	}
   714	
   715	/**
   716	 * Builds the narrative summary shown at the top of the Overview tab.
   717	 *
   718	 * Returns translation keys plus values rather than assembled Spanish strings
   719	 * (as the reference did), so the same logic serves both locales.
   720	 */
   721	/**
   722	 * The narrative summary on the Overview tab.
   723	 *
   724	 * Deliberately excludes two families the client-facing dashboard does not
   725	 * carry: extrapolated trend/forecast statements, and classifier throughput
   726	 * (auto-accept rate). What remains is grounded in invoices actually issued
   727	 * and received — concentration, net position, and flagged anomalies.
   728	 */
   729	export function generateInsights(
   730	  invoices: Invoice[],
   731	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   732	  anomalies: Anomaly[],
   733	  pareto: ParetoResult
   734	): Insight[] {
   735	  const insights: Insight[] = [];
   736	
   737	  if (pareto.entries.length > 0) {
   738	    insights.push({
   739	      id: "concentration",
   740	      tone: pareto.topShare > 40 ? "warning" : "neutral",
   741	      messageKey: "concentration",
   742	      values: {
   743	        count: pareto.paretoCount,
   744	        totalEntities: pareto.entries.length,
   745	        topName: pareto.entries[0].name,
   746	        topShare: pareto.topShare.toFixed(1),
   747	      },
   748	      priority: pareto.topShare > 40 ? 2 : 5,
   749	    });
   750	  }
   751	
   752	  const critical = anomalies.filter((a) => a.severity === "critical").length;
   753	  if (critical > 0) {
   754	    insights.push({
   755	      id: "critical-anomalies",
   756	      tone: "negative",
   757	      messageKey: "criticalAnomalies",
   758	      values: { count: critical },
   759	      priority: 0,
   760	    });
   761	  }
   762	
   763	  const ventas = invoices
   764	    .filter((i) => i.transaction_type === "VENTAS")
   765	    .reduce((s, i) => s + (i.total_amount ?? 0), 0);
   766	  const compras = invoices
   767	    .filter((i) => i.transaction_type === "COMPRAS")
   768	    .reduce((s, i) => s + (i.total_amount ?? 0), 0);
   769	  if (ventas > 0 && compras > 0) {
   770	    insights.push({
   771	      id: "margin",
   772	      tone: ventas > compras ? "positive" : "warning",
   773	      messageKey: ventas > compras ? "netPositive" : "netNegative",
   774	      values: { net: Math.round(Math.abs(ventas - compras)) },
   775	      priority: 4,
   776	    });
   777	  }
   778	
   779	  return insights.sort((a, b) => a.priority - b.priority);
   780	}

    69	/** The period key used for every time series: "YYYY-MM", straight off the
    70	 *  generated invoice_period column, falling back to slicing invoice_date if
    71	 *  the generated value ever arrives null. */
    72	export function periodOf(invoice: Invoice): string {
    73	  return invoice.invoice_period ?? invoice.invoice_date.slice(0, 7);

    76	export function aggregateKpis(invoices: Invoice[], items: InvoiceItem[]): KpiData {
    77	  let totalRevenue = 0;
    78	  let totalSales = 0;
    79	  let totalPurchases = 0;
    80	  let netAmount = 0;
    81	  let ivaAmount = 0;
    82	  let exemptAmount = 0;
    83	  const counterparties = new Set<string>();
    84	
    85	  for (const inv of invoices) {
    86	    const total = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
    87	    totalRevenue += total;
    88	    if (inv.transaction_type === "VENTAS") totalSales += total;
    89	    else totalPurchases += total;
    90	    netAmount += inv.net_amount ?? 0;
    91	    ivaAmount += inv.iva_amount ?? 0;
    92	    exemptAmount += inv.exempt_amount ?? 0;
    93	    counterparties.add(counterpartyOf(inv).rut);
    94	  }
    95	
    96	  let needsReviewCount = 0;
    97	  let autoAcceptCount = 0;
    98	  let discountTotal = 0;
    99	  let recargoTotal = 0;
   100	  const catalogItems = new Set<string>();
   101	
   102	  for (const item of items) {
   103	    if (item.needs_review) needsReviewCount++;
   104	    if (item.decision === "auto_accept") autoAcceptCount++;
   105	    discountTotal += item.discount_amount ?? 0;
   106	    recargoTotal += item.recargo_amount ?? 0;
   107	    catalogItems.add(item.catalog_item_id);
   108	  }
   109	
   110	  const totalInvoices = invoices.length;
   111	
   112	  return {
   113	    totalRevenue,
   114	    totalPurchases,
   115	    totalSales,
   116	    netAmount,
   117	    ivaAmount,
   118	    exemptAmount,
   119	    totalInvoices,
   120	    totalLines: items.length,
   121	    avgInvoiceValue: totalInvoices > 0 ? totalRevenue / totalInvoices : 0,
   122	    needsReviewPct: items.length > 0 ? (needsReviewCount / items.length) * 100 : 0,
   123	    autoAcceptPct: items.length > 0 ? (autoAcceptCount / items.length) * 100 : 0,
   124	    distinctCounterparties: counterparties.size,
   125	    distinctItems: catalogItems.size,
   126	    discountTotal,
   127	    recargoTotal,
   128	  };
   129	}

   131	export function aggregateTimeSeries(
   132	  invoices: Invoice[],
   133	  items: InvoiceItem[]
   134	): TimeSeriesPoint[] {
   135	  const linesByInvoice = new Map<string, number>();
   136	  for (const item of items) {
   137	    linesByInvoice.set(item.invoice_id, (linesByInvoice.get(item.invoice_id) ?? 0) + 1);
   138	  }
   139	
   140	  const map = new Map<string, TimeSeriesPoint>();
   141	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   142	    const period = periodOf(inv);
   143	    let point = map.get(period);
   144	    if (!point) {
   145	      point = { period, ventas: 0, compras: 0, total: 0, invoiceCount: 0, lineCount: 0 };
   146	      map.set(period, point);
   147	    }
   148	    const total = inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   149	    if (inv.transaction_type === "VENTAS") point.ventas += total;
   150	    else point.compras += total;
   151	    point.total += total;
   152	    point.invoiceCount += 1;
   153	    point.lineCount += linesByInvoice.get(inv.invoice_id) ?? 0;
   154	  }
   155	
   156	  return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => a.period.localeCompare(b.period));
   157	}

   159	/**
   160	 * Top counterparties on the given side, keyed by RUT.
   161	 *
   162	 * RUT is the right key rather than company_id: company_id points at *our*
   163	 * organisation's row on the invoice, so grouping by it would collapse every
   164	 * counterparty together. The denormalized seller/buyer columns carry the
   165	 * other party, and RUT is unique per company in this schema.
   166	 */
   167	export function aggregateTopCounterparties(
   168	  invoices: Invoice[],
   169	  role: "seller" | "buyer",
   170	  companiesByRut: Map<string, Company>,
   171	  limit = 10
   172	): CounterpartyMetric[] {
   173	  const map = new Map<string, CounterpartyMetric>();
   174	
   175	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   176	    const rut = role === "seller" ? inv.seller_rut : inv.buyer_rut;
   177	    const name = role === "seller" ? inv.seller_name : inv.buyer_name;
   178	    const city = role === "seller" ? inv.seller_city : inv.buyer_city;
   179	    const giro = role === "seller" ? inv.seller_giro : inv.buyer_giro;
   180	
   181	    let entry = map.get(rut);
   182	    if (!entry) {
   183	      entry = {
   184	        companyId: companiesByRut.get(rut)?.company_id ?? null,
   185	        rut,
   186	        name,
   187	        city,
   188	        giro,
   189	        totalAmount: 0,
   190	        invoiceCount: 0,
   191	        avgAmount: 0,
   192	        role,
   193	      };
   194	      map.set(rut, entry);
   195	    }
   196	    entry.totalAmount += inv.total_amount ?? 0;
   197	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   198	  }
   199	
   200	  return Array.from(map.values())
   201	    .map((m) => ({ ...m, avgAmount: m.invoiceCount > 0 ? m.totalAmount / m.invoiceCount : 0 }))
   202	    .sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount)
   203	    .slice(0, limit);
   204	}

   206	export function aggregateCategoryMetrics(
   207	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   208	  categoriesById: Map<string, Category>
   209	): CategoryMetric[] {
   210	  interface Acc extends Omit<CategoryMetric, "avgScore" | "distinctItems"> {
   211	    scoreSum: number;
   212	    catalogIds: Set<string>;
   213	  }
   214	  const map = new Map<string, Acc>();
   215	
   216	  for (const item of items) {
   217	    const categoryId = effectiveCategoryId(item);
   218	    let entry = map.get(categoryId);
   219	    if (!entry) {
   220	      const category = categoriesById.get(categoryId);
   221	      entry = {
   222	        categoriesId: categoryId,
   223	        // Fall back to the row's own denormalized code/name rather than
   224	        // dropping the line when a category lookup misses — the reference
   225	        // dashboard skipped such lines entirely, which silently understated
   226	        // totals whenever a category was missing from the lookup table.
   227	        code: category?.code ?? item.final_code ?? item.predicted_code,
   228	        name: category?.name ?? item.predicted_name ?? item.predicted_code,
   229	        totalAmount: 0,
   230	        itemCount: 0,
   231	        autoAcceptCount: 0,
   232	        reviewCount: 0,
   233	        correctedCount: 0,
   234	        scoreSum: 0,
   235	        catalogIds: new Set(),
   236	      };
   237	      map.set(categoryId, entry);
   238	    }
   239	
   240	    entry.totalAmount += item.amount ?? 0;
   241	    entry.itemCount += 1;
   242	    entry.scoreSum += item.top1_score;
   243	    entry.catalogIds.add(item.catalog_item_id);
   244	    if (item.decision === "auto_accept") entry.autoAcceptCount += 1;
   245	    else entry.reviewCount += 1;
   246	    // A reviewer moved this line off the model's prediction.
   247	    if (item.final_categories_id && item.final_categories_id !== item.predicted_categories_id) {
   248	      entry.correctedCount += 1;
   249	    }
   250	  }
   251	
   252	  return Array.from(map.values())
   253	    .map(({ scoreSum, catalogIds, ...rest }) => ({
   254	      ...rest,
   255	      avgScore: rest.itemCount > 0 ? scoreSum / rest.itemCount : 0,
   256	      distinctItems: catalogIds.size,
   257	    }))
   258	    .sort((a, b) => b.totalAmount - a.totalAmount);
   259	}

   264	    count: number;
   265	    scoreSum: number;

     7	export interface AnalyticsFilters {
     8	  /** Inclusive "YYYY-MM-DD". */
     9	  dateFrom: string;
    10	  /** Inclusive "YYYY-MM-DD". */
    11	  dateTo: string;
    12	  transactionType: TransactionTypeFilter;
    13	  /** companies.company_id, "" for no filter. */
    14	  companyId: string;
    15	  /** categories.categories_id, "" for no filter. */
    16	  categoryId: string;
    17	  /** Matches either side's city, "" for no filter. */
    18	  city: string;
    19	  reviewStatus: ReviewStatusFilter;
    20	  /** invoices.payment_form, "" for no filter. */
    21	  paymentForm: string;
    22	  /** invoice_items.prediction_source, "" for no filter. */

    28	export const DEFAULT_FILTERS: AnalyticsFilters = {
    29	  dateFrom: "",
    30	  dateTo: "",
    31	  transactionType: "ALL",
    32	  companyId: "",
    33	  categoryId: "",
    34	  city: "",
    35	  reviewStatus: "ALL",
    36	  paymentForm: "",

    40	
    41	/**
    42	 * Invoice-level predicates. Date and transaction type are also pushed down to
    43	 * Postgres on fetch; re-applying them here is intentional, so that narrowing
    44	 * the range in the UI takes effect immediately over already-loaded rows
    45	 * rather than requiring a round trip.
    46	 *
    47	 * `city` matches either side of the invoice: a company can appear as the
    48	 * seller on one document and the buyer on another, and a user filtering to
    49	 * "Santiago" means "anything touching Santiago", not one specific role.
    50	 */
    51	export function invoiceMatches(invoice: Invoice, filters: AnalyticsFilters): boolean {
    52	  if (filters.dateFrom && invoice.invoice_date < filters.dateFrom) return false;
    53	  if (filters.dateTo && invoice.invoice_date > filters.dateTo) return false;
    54	
    55	  if (filters.transactionType !== "ALL" && invoice.transaction_type !== filters.transactionType) {
    56	    return false;
    57	  }
    58	
    59	  if (filters.companyId && invoice.company_id !== filters.companyId) return false;
    60	
    61	  if (
    62	    filters.city &&
    63	    invoice.seller_city !== filters.city &&
    64	    invoice.buyer_city !== filters.city
    65	  ) {
    66	    return false;
    67	  }
    68	
    69	  if (filters.paymentForm && invoice.payment_form !== filters.paymentForm) return false;
    70	  if (filters.documentType && invoice.document_type !== filters.documentType) return false;
    71	
    72	  return true;
    73	}
    74	
    75	/**
    76	 * Line-level predicates, applied on top of an already-filtered invoice set.
    77	 *
    78	 * Category matches the EFFECTIVE category (human's final choice when present,
    79	 * else the model's prediction) rather than either column alone — matching
    80	 * both would double-count a line whose reviewer moved it between categories,
    81	 * and matching only the prediction would misreport corrected data.
    82	 */
    83	export function itemMatches(
    84	  item: InvoiceItem,
    85	  filters: AnalyticsFilters,
    86	  allowedInvoiceIds: Set<string>
    87	): boolean {
    88	  if (!allowedInvoiceIds.has(item.invoice_id)) return false;
    89	
    90	  if (filters.categoryId && effectiveCategoryId(item) !== filters.categoryId) return false;
    91	
    92	  if (filters.predictionSource && item.prediction_source !== filters.predictionSource) {
    93	    return false;
    94	  }
    95	
    96	  switch (filters.reviewStatus) {
    97	    case "NEEDS_REVIEW":
    98	      if (!item.needs_review) return false;
    99	      break;
   100	    case "REVIEWED":
   101	      if (!item.reviewed) return false;
   102	      break;
   103	    case "AUTO_ACCEPT":
   104	      if (item.decision !== "auto_accept") return false;
   105	      break;
   106	    case "ALL":
   107	      break;
   108	  }
   109	
   110	  return true;
   111	}
   112	
   113	export interface FilteredData {
   114	  invoices: Invoice[];
   115	  items: InvoiceItem[];
   116	  invoiceIds: Set<string>;
   117	}
   118	
   119	/**
   120	 * Applies both tiers in the correct order and returns them together.
   121	 *
   122	 * When a line-level filter is active the invoice set is narrowed a second
   123	 * time to only those invoices that still have a surviving line — otherwise
   124	 * filtering to, say, "needs review" would leave invoice-level KPIs counting
   125	 * invoices with no matching lines at all, and the headline totals would
   126	 * disagree with the table underneath them.
   127	 */
   128	export function applyFilters(
   129	  invoices: Invoice[],
   130	  items: InvoiceItem[],
   131	  filters: AnalyticsFilters
   132	): FilteredData {
   133	  const matchedInvoices = invoices.filter((inv) => invoiceMatches(inv, filters));
   134	  const candidateIds = new Set(matchedInvoices.map((inv) => inv.invoice_id));
   135	
   136	  const matchedItems = items.filter((item) => itemMatches(item, filters, candidateIds));
   137	
   138	  const hasLineFilter =
   139	    filters.categoryId !== "" ||
   140	    filters.predictionSource !== "" ||
   141	    filters.reviewStatus !== "ALL";
   142	
   143	  if (!hasLineFilter) {
   144	    return { invoices: matchedInvoices, items: matchedItems, invoiceIds: candidateIds };
   145	  }
   146	
   147	  const survivingIds = new Set(matchedItems.map((item) => item.invoice_id));
   148	  return {
   149	    invoices: matchedInvoices.filter((inv) => survivingIds.has(inv.invoice_id)),
   150	    items: matchedItems,
   151	    invoiceIds: survivingIds,
   152	  };
   153	}
   154	
   155	export function hasActiveFilters(filters: AnalyticsFilters, defaults: AnalyticsFilters): boolean {
   156	  return (
   157	    filters.transactionType !== defaults.transactionType ||
   158	    filters.companyId !== "" ||
   159	    filters.categoryId !== "" ||
   160	    filters.city !== "" ||
   161	    filters.reviewStatus !== "ALL" ||
   162	    filters.paymentForm !== "" ||
   163	    filters.predictionSource !== "" ||
   164	    filters.documentType !== "" ||
   165	    filters.dateFrom !== defaults.dateFrom ||
   166	    filters.dateTo !== defaults.dateTo
   167	  );
   168	}

    11	function getErrorMessage(err: unknown): string {
    12	  if (err instanceof Error) return err.message;
    13	  if (err && typeof err === "object") {
    14	    // Supabase/PostgREST errors are plain objects: { message, details, hint, code }
    15	    const { message, details, hint, code } = err as Record<string, unknown>;
    16	    const parts = [message, details, hint, code].filter(
    17	      (v): v is string => typeof v === "string" && v.length > 0
    18	    );
    19	    if (parts.length > 0) return parts.join(" — ");
    20	  }
    21	  return String(err);
    22	}

   276	                            <div className="flex flex-col">
   277	                              <span className="font-medium">{occ.companyName}</span>
   278	                              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">
   279	                                {occ.companyRut}
   280	                              </span>
   281	                            </div>

   284	                            {occ.categoryName
   285	                              ? `${occ.categoryCode} · ${occ.categoryName}`
   286	                              : t("table.noCategory")}
   287	                          </TableCell>
   288	                          <TableCell className="text-xs py-2 text-right font-mono">
   289	                            {formatQuantity(occ.quantity, occ.unit)}
   290	                          </TableCell>
   291	                          <TableCell className="text-xs py-2 text-right font-mono font-bold text-primary">
   292	                            {formatPrice(occ.unitPrice)}
   293	                          </TableCell>
   294	                          <TableCell className="text-xs py-2 text-muted-foreground">
   295	                            {formatDate(occ.invoiceDate)}
   296	                          </TableCell>
   297	                        </TableRow>
   298	                      ))}
   299	                    </TableBody>
   300	                  </Table>
   301	                </div>
   302	              </div>
   303	            );
   304	          }}
   305	        />
   306	      )}
   307	    </div>
   308	  );

     1	import type { SupabaseClient } from "@supabase/supabase-js";
     2	import type { Category, Company, ItemOccurrence, TransactionType } from "./types";

     4	// PostgREST caps any single request's rows, so fetching "everything" means
     5	// paging through in batches rather than trusting one big .limit(). This is a
     6	// per-request page size, not a ceiling on total rows returned.
     7	const OCCURRENCE_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
     8	
     9	// A last-resort circuit breaker so a misconfiguration (e.g. an infinite loop
    10	// bug, or invoice_items growing into the hundreds of thousands) can't hang a
    11	// request forever. This is NOT meant to be hit in normal operation — if it
    12	// ever fires, invoice_items has grown large enough that this page needs
    13	// real server-side pagination/aggregation instead of loading everything.
    14	const HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT = 100_000;
    15	
    16	export async function fetchCategories(supabase: SupabaseClient): Promise<Category[]> {
    17	  const { data, error } = await supabase
    18	    .from("categories")
    19	    .select("categories_id, code, name")
    20	    .order("name");
    21	
    22	  if (error) {
    23	    console.log("[items] fetchCategories failed:", error);
    24	    throw error;
    25	  }
    26	  console.log(`[items] fetchCategories: ${data?.length ?? 0} rows`);
    27	  return data ?? [];
    28	}
