    46	interface RawCategoryRef {
    47	  categories_id: string;
    48	  code: string;
    49	  name: string;
    50	}
    51	
    52	interface RawOccurrenceRow {
    53	  item_id: string;
    54	  catalog_item_id: string;
    55	  item_text: string;
    56	  description: string | null;
    57	  quantity: number | null;
    58	  unit: string | null;
    59	  unit_price: number | null;
    60	  amount: number | null;
    61	  decision: string;
    62	  needs_review: boolean;
    63	  discount_pct: number | null;
    64	  discount_amount: number | null;
    65	  recargo_amount: number | null;
    66	  tax_exempt: boolean;
    67	  prediction_source: string;
    68	  top1_score: number;
    69	  margin: number;
    70	  entropy: number;
    71	  reviewed: boolean;
    72	  item_catalog: { item_name: string; description: string | null } | null;
    73	  predicted_category: RawCategoryRef | null;
    74	  final_category: RawCategoryRef | null;
    75	  invoice: {
    76	    invoice_id: string;
    77	    invoice_date: string;
    78	    transaction_type: "COMPRAS" | "VENTAS";
    79	    document_type: string;
    80	    invoice_folio: string;
    81	    net_amount: number | null;
    82	    iva_amount: number | null;
    83	    exempt_amount: number | null;
    84	    total_amount: number | null;
    85	    due_date: string | null;
    86	    payment_form: string | null;
    87	    company: { company_id: string; company_name: string; rut: string } | null;
    88	  } | null;
    89	}
    90	
    91	// Shared field list for both OCCURRENCE_SELECT and OCCURRENCE_SELECT_RANGE —
    92	// kept as one constant so the two (which differ only in the invoice embed's
    93	// join type) can't drift out of sync when new columns are added.
    94	const OCCURRENCE_FIELDS = `
    95	  item_id,
    96	  catalog_item_id,
    97	  item_text,
    98	  description,
    99	  quantity,
   100	  unit,
   101	  unit_price,
   102	  amount,
   103	  decision,
   104	  needs_review,
   105	  discount_pct,
   106	  discount_amount,
   107	  recargo_amount,
   108	  tax_exempt,
   109	  prediction_source,
   110	  top1_score,
   111	  margin,
   112	  entropy,
   113	  reviewed,
   114	  item_catalog:catalog_item_id ( item_name, description ),
   115	  predicted_category:categories!invoice_items_predicted_categories_id_fkey ( categories_id, code, name ),
   116	  final_category:categories!invoice_items_final_categories_id_fkey ( categories_id, code, name )
   117	`;
   118	
   119	const INVOICE_FIELDS = `
   120	  invoice_id, invoice_date, transaction_type, document_type, invoice_folio,
   121	  net_amount, iva_amount, exempt_amount, total_amount, due_date, payment_form,
   122	  company:companies!invoices_company_id_fkey ( company_id, company_name, rut )
   123	`;
   124	
   125	const OCCURRENCE_SELECT = `
   126	  ${OCCURRENCE_FIELDS},
   127	  invoice:invoices!invoice_items_invoice_id_fkey (
   128	    ${INVOICE_FIELDS}
   129	  )
   130	`;
   131	
   132	// Shapes the raw joined rows into ItemOccurrence[], dropping (and logging) any
   133	// row whose join came back empty — orphaned FK or RLS blocking a related table.
   134	function mapOccurrenceRows(rows: RawOccurrenceRow[], context: string): ItemOccurrence[] {
   135	  console.log(`[items] ${context}: ${rows.length} rows`);
   136	
   137	  const dropped = rows.filter(
   138	    (row) => !row.item_catalog || !row.invoice || !row.invoice.company
   139	  );
   140	  if (dropped.length > 0) {
   141	    console.log(
   142	      `[items] ${context}: dropping ${dropped.length} row(s) with a missing join ` +
   143	        "(item_catalog / invoice / company) — check for orphaned rows or RLS blocking the related table:",
   144	      dropped.map((row) => ({
   145	        item_id: row.item_id,
   146	        missing_item_catalog: !row.item_catalog,
   147	        missing_invoice: !row.invoice,
   148	        missing_company: !!row.invoice && !row.invoice.company,
   149	      }))
   150	    );
   151	  }
   152	
   153	  return rows
   154	    .filter((row) => row.item_catalog && row.invoice && row.invoice.company)
   155	    .map((row) => {
   156	      const category = row.final_category ?? row.predicted_category;
   157	
   158	      return {
   159	        itemId: row.item_id,
   160	        catalogItemId: row.catalog_item_id,
   161	        itemName: row.item_catalog!.item_name,
   162	        description: row.item_catalog!.description,
   163	        itemText: row.item_text,
   164	        itemDescription: row.description,
   165	        quantity: row.quantity,
   166	        unit: row.unit,
   167	        unitPrice: row.unit_price,
   168	        amount: row.amount,
   169	        decision: row.decision,
   170	        needsReview: row.needs_review,
   171	        invoiceId: row.invoice!.invoice_id,
   172	        invoiceDate: row.invoice!.invoice_date,
   173	        transactionType: row.invoice!.transaction_type,
   174	        documentType: row.invoice!.document_type,
   175	        companyId: row.invoice!.company!.company_id,
   176	        companyName: row.invoice!.company!.company_name,
   177	        companyRut: row.invoice!.company!.rut,
   178	        categoryId: category?.categories_id ?? null,
   179	        categoryCode: category?.code ?? null,
   180	        categoryName: category?.name ?? null,
   181	        invoiceFolio: row.invoice!.invoice_folio,
   182	        netAmount: row.invoice!.net_amount,
   183	        ivaAmount: row.invoice!.iva_amount,
   184	        exemptAmount: row.invoice!.exempt_amount,
   185	        totalAmount: row.invoice!.total_amount,
   186	        dueDate: row.invoice!.due_date,
   187	        paymentForm: row.invoice!.payment_form,
   188	        discountPct: row.discount_pct,
   189	        discountAmount: row.discount_amount,
   190	        recargoAmount: row.recargo_amount,
   191	        taxExempt: row.tax_exempt,
   192	        predictionSource: row.prediction_source,
   193	        top1Score: row.top1_score,
   194	        margin: row.margin,
   195	        entropy: row.entropy,
   196	        reviewed: row.reviewed,
   197	      } satisfies ItemOccurrence;
   198	    });
   199	}
   200	
   201	// Every invoice line, joined out to its item, effective category (final if reviewed,
   202	// otherwise the model's prediction), and the invoice/company it came from.
   203	//
   204	// Pages through invoice_items in batches instead of a single .limit() — a
   205	// fixed cap silently truncates once the table outgrows it (which it did:
   206	// 3000 was hiding ~9000 real rows). item_id is added as a secondary sort key
   207	// purely for pagination correctness: invoice_date alone has many ties, and
   208	// .range() pagination over a non-unique sort can skip or repeat rows at page
   209	// boundaries. This still fetches the whole table into memory for now — fine
   210	// at tens of thousands of rows, but worth revisiting with real server-side
   211	// aggregation if invoice_items grows an order of magnitude further.
   212	export async function fetchItemOccurrences(
   213	  supabase: SupabaseClient
   214	): Promise<ItemOccurrence[]> {
   215	  const rows: RawOccurrenceRow[] = [];
   216	  let from = 0;
   217	
   218	  while (rows.length < HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT) {
   219	    const { data, error } = await supabase
   220	      .from("invoice_items")
   221	      .select(OCCURRENCE_SELECT)
   222	      .order("invoice_date", { referencedTable: "invoice", ascending: false })
   223	      .order("item_id", { ascending: true })
   224	      .range(from, from + OCCURRENCE_PAGE_SIZE - 1)
   225	      .returns<RawOccurrenceRow[]>();
   226	
   227	    if (error) {
   228	      console.log("[items] fetchItemOccurrences failed:", error);
   229	      throw error;
   230	    }
   231	
   232	    const page = data ?? [];
   233	    rows.push(...page);
   234	
   235	    if (page.length < OCCURRENCE_PAGE_SIZE) break; // last page reached
   236	    from += OCCURRENCE_PAGE_SIZE;
   237	  }
   238	
   239	  if (rows.length >= HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT) {
   240	    console.log(
   241	      `[items] fetchItemOccurrences: hit the hard safety limit of ${HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT} rows — ` +
   242	        "invoice_items has grown large enough that this needs real server-side pagination, not a full fetch."
   243	    );
   244	  }
   245	
   246	  return mapOccurrenceRows(rows, "fetchItemOccurrences");
   247	}

     1	import type { ItemGroup, ItemOccurrence } from "./types";
     2	
     3	// Collapses repeated invoice occurrences of the same catalog item into one row,
     4	// keeping the most recent occurrence (by invoice date) as the representative snapshot.
     5	// Call this AFTER any occurrence-level filtering (company/category/transaction type)
     6	// so "latest" reflects the latest occurrence that matches the active filters.
     7	export function groupOccurrencesByItem(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): ItemGroup[] {
     8	  const groups = new Map<string, ItemOccurrence[]>();
     9	
    10	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
    11	    const list = groups.get(occ.catalogItemId);
    12	    if (list) {
    13	      list.push(occ);
    14	    } else {
    15	      groups.set(occ.catalogItemId, [occ]);
    16	    }
    17	  }
    18	
    19	  const result: ItemGroup[] = [];
    20	  for (const [catalogItemId, list] of groups) {
    21	    const sorted = [...list].sort(
    22	      (a, b) => new Date(b.invoiceDate).getTime() - new Date(a.invoiceDate).getTime()
    23	    );
    24	    const latest = sorted[0];
    25	
    26	    result.push({
    27	      catalogItemId,
    28	      itemName: latest.itemName,
    29	      description: latest.description,
    30	      latest,
    31	      occurrences: sorted,
    32	      occurrenceCount: sorted.length,
    33	      companyCount: new Set(sorted.map((o) => o.companyId)).size,
    34	      categoryCount: new Set(sorted.map((o) => o.categoryId).filter(Boolean)).size,
    35	    });
    36	  }
    37	
    38	  return result.sort((a, b) => a.itemName.localeCompare(b.itemName));
    39	}
    40	
    41	// Given every occurrence of one item, collapses each company down to its own
    42	// most recent occurrence — so a buyer can compare "what did I last pay each
    43	// of my suppliers for this item" without wading through the full invoice log.
    44	// Assumes `occurrences` is already sorted newest-first (groupOccurrencesByItem
    45	// guarantees this), so the first occurrence seen per company is its latest.
    46	export function getLatestOccurrencePerCompany(
    47	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]
    48	): ItemOccurrence[] {
    49	  const latestByCompany = new Map<string, ItemOccurrence>();
    50	
    51	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
    52	    if (!latestByCompany.has(occ.companyId)) {
    53	      latestByCompany.set(occ.companyId, occ);
    54	    }
    55	  }
    56	
    57	  return Array.from(latestByCompany.values()).sort(
    58	    (a, b) => (a.unitPrice ?? Infinity) - (b.unitPrice ?? Infinity)
    59	  );
    60	}

    12	function getErrorMessage(err: unknown): string {
    13	  if (err instanceof Error) return err.message;
    14	  if (err && typeof err === "object") {
    15	    // Supabase/PostgREST errors are plain objects: { message, details, hint, code }
    16	    const { message, details, hint, code } = err as Record<string, unknown>;
    17	    const parts = [message, details, hint, code].filter(
    18	      (v): v is string => typeof v === "string" && v.length > 0
    19	    );
    20	    if (parts.length > 0) return parts.join(" — ");
    21	  }
    22	  return String(err);
    23	}

    25	/** Months of history loaded on first paint. Wide enough that the trend
    26	 *  regression and month-over-month growth have something to work with (both
    27	 *  need 3+ periods), narrow enough to keep the initial payload sane. */
    28	const DEFAULT_MONTHS = 12;
    29	
    30	function defaultRange(bounds: { min: string; max: string } | null) {
    31	  // Anchor to the newest invoice in the data rather than today's date: this
    32	  // dataset is loaded in batches and "today" can sit well past the last
    33	  // invoice, which would open the dashboard on an empty range.
    34	  const anchor = bounds ? new Date(`${bounds.max}T00:00:00Z`) : new Date();
    35	  const from = new Date(anchor);
    36	  from.setUTCMonth(from.getUTCMonth() - DEFAULT_MONTHS);
    37	
    38	  const floor = bounds ? new Date(`${bounds.min}T00:00:00Z`) : from;
    39	  const start = from < floor ? floor : from;
    40	
    41	  return {
    42	    from: start.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    43	    to: anchor.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    44	  };
    45	}

    47	export default async function DashboardPage() {
    48	  const supabase = await createClient();
    49	
    50	  let categories: Category[] = [];
    51	  let companies: Company[] = [];
    52	  let catalog: CatalogItem[] = [];
    53	  let invoices: Invoice[] = [];
    54	  let bounds: { min: string; max: string } | null = null;
    55	  let range = { from: "", to: "" };
    56	  let error: string | null = null;
    57	
    58	  try {
    59	    // Only the date bounds gate anything — they decide the default range, and
    60	    // the range decides which invoices to ask for. Two cheap LIMIT 1 queries.
    61	    bounds = await fetchInvoiceDateBounds(supabase);
    62	    range = defaultRange(bounds);
    63	
    64	    // Everything else is independent, so it all goes out at once. The wall
    65	    // time is the slowest single branch rather than the sum: paging the item
    66	    // catalogue and paging invoices now overlap instead of queueing.
    67	    const [cats, comps, catalogItems, invs] = await Promise.all([
    68	      fetchCategories(supabase),
    69	      fetchCompanies(supabase),
    70	      fetchCatalogItems(supabase),
    71	      fetchInvoices(supabase, { startDate: range.from, endDate: range.to }),
    72	    ]);
    73	    categories = cats;
    74	    companies = comps;
    75	    catalog = catalogItems;
    76	    invoices = invs;
    77	
    78	    console.log(
    79	      `[dashboard] server-rendered ${invoices.length} invoices for ${range.from}..${range.to}; ` +
    80	        "lines stream in client-side"
    81	    );
    82	  } catch (err) {
    83	    console.log("[dashboard] server fetch failed:", err);
    84	    error = getErrorMessage(err);
    85	  }
    86	
    87	  return (
    88	    <DashboardView
    89	      categories={categories}
    90	      companies={companies}
    91	      catalog={catalog}
    92	      initialInvoices={invoices}
    93	      initialRange={range}
    94	      dateBounds={bounds}
    95	      error={error}
    96	    />
    97	  );
    98	}

    14	// invites invoice-level double counting; the analytics layer keeps them

    20	// PostgREST caps rows per request, so "fetch everything" means paging.
    21	const PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
    22	
    23	// Circuit breaker: not expected to fire in normal operation. If it does, the
    24	// table has outgrown load-everything-then-aggregate and needs server-side
    25	// aggregation (a Postgres view or RPC) instead.
    26	const HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT = 200_000;
    27

    50	interface RangeParams {
    51	  /** Inclusive "YYYY-MM-DD". */
    52	  startDate?: string;
    53	  /** Inclusive "YYYY-MM-DD". */
    54	  endDate?: string;
    55	  transactionTypes?: TransactionType[];
    56	}
    57	
    58	/**
    59	 * Pages through a query in PAGE_SIZE batches until exhausted.
    60	 *
    61	 * `orderColumn` must be unique (or paired with a unique tiebreaker) — .range()
    62	 * pagination over a non-unique sort can skip or duplicate rows at page
    63	 * boundaries, which is exactly the truncation class of bug that bit the items
    64	 * page earlier. Every caller here orders by a primary key.
    65	 */
    66	async function fetchAllPages<T>(
    67	  label: string,
    68	  build: () => {
    69	    range: (from: number, to: number) => PromiseLike<{ data: unknown; error: unknown }>;
    70	  }
    71	): Promise<T[]> {
    72	  const rows: T[] = [];
    73	  let from = 0;
    74	
    75	  while (rows.length < HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT) {
    76	    const { data, error } = await build().range(from, from + PAGE_SIZE - 1);
    77	
    78	    if (error) {
    79	      console.log(`[analytics] ${label} failed:`, error);
    80	      throw error;
    81	    }
    82	
    83	    const page = (data ?? []) as T[];
    84	    rows.push(...page);
    85	
    86	    if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE) break;
    87	    from += PAGE_SIZE;
    88	  }
    89	
    90	  if (rows.length >= HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT) {
    91	    console.log(
    92	      `[analytics] ${label}: hit the hard safety limit of ${HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT} rows — ` +
    93	        "results are truncated; this table now needs server-side aggregation."
    94	    );
    95	  }
    96	
    97	  console.log(`[analytics] ${label}: ${rows.length} rows`);
    98	  return rows;
    99	}

   138	export async function fetchInvoices(
   139	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   140	  params: RangeParams = {}
   141	): Promise<Invoice[]> {
   142	  const rows = await fetchAllPages<Record<string, unknown>>("fetchInvoices", () => {
   143	    let query = supabase.from("invoices").select(INVOICE_COLUMNS).order("invoice_id");
   144	
   145	    if (params.startDate) query = query.gte("invoice_date", params.startDate);
   146	    if (params.endDate) query = query.lte("invoice_date", params.endDate);
   147	    if (params.transactionTypes && params.transactionTypes.length > 0) {
   148	      query = query.in("transaction_type", params.transactionTypes);
   149	    }
   150	    return query;
   151	  });
   152	
   153	  return rows.map(normalizeInvoice);
   154	}

   156	/**
   157	 * Invoice lines for a date range, scoped through the parent invoice.
   158	 *
   159	 * invoice_items has no date of its own — it inherits the invoice's — so the
   160	 * range has to be applied across the relationship. `!inner` makes the embed an
   161	 * inner join, which is what lets PostgREST filter on `invoices.invoice_date`;
   162	 * with a plain embed the filter is ignored and every line comes back.
   163	 *
   164	 * This replaces an earlier version that chunked by invoice_id, 200 UUIDs at a
   165	 * time to stay under URL length limits. That cost ~42 sequential round trips
   166	 * on a year of data (21 chunks, ~2 pages each) and, worse, forced the invoice
   167	 * fetch to complete first so its ids were available. Filtering by date instead
   168	 * takes ~11 pages and has no dependency on the invoice query, so the two can
   169	 * run concurrently.
   170	 */
   171	export async function fetchInvoiceItemsInRange(
   172	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   173	  params: RangeParams = {}
   174	): Promise<InvoiceItem[]> {
   175	  const rows = await fetchAllPages<Record<string, unknown>>("fetchInvoiceItemsInRange", () => {
   176	    // The embedded selection is deliberately minimal — the join exists to
   177	    // filter, not to carry data. Invoice fields are read from the separate
   178	    // invoices fetch and correlated in memory by invoice_id.
   179	    let query = supabase
   180	      .from("invoice_items")
   181	      .select(`${INVOICE_ITEM_COLUMNS}, invoices!inner(invoice_id)`)
   182	      .order("item_id");
   183	
   184	    if (params.startDate) query = query.gte("invoices.invoice_date", params.startDate);
   185	    if (params.endDate) query = query.lte("invoices.invoice_date", params.endDate);
   186	    if (params.transactionTypes && params.transactionTypes.length > 0) {
   187	      query = query.in("invoices.transaction_type", params.transactionTypes);
   188	    }
   189	    return query;
   190	  });
   191	
   192	  return rows.map(normalizeInvoiceItem);
   193	}

   195	/**
   196	 * Lines for an explicit set of invoices. Retained for callers that already
   197	 * hold ids and want exactly those lines; chunked because PostgREST puts
   198	 * `in.(...)` in the URL and a few thousand UUIDs would exceed length limits.
   199	 * Prefer fetchInvoiceItemsInRange for the dashboard's own loading path.
   200	 */
   201	export async function fetchInvoiceItemsForInvoices(
   202	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   203	  invoiceIds: string[]
   204	): Promise<InvoiceItem[]> {
   205	  if (invoiceIds.length === 0) return [];
   206	
   207	  const ID_CHUNK = 200;
   208	  const all: InvoiceItem[] = [];
   209	
   210	  for (let offset = 0; offset < invoiceIds.length; offset += ID_CHUNK) {
   211	    const chunk = invoiceIds.slice(offset, offset + ID_CHUNK);
   212	    const rows = await fetchAllPages<Record<string, unknown>>(
   213	      `fetchInvoiceItems[${offset / ID_CHUNK}]`,
   214	      () =>
   215	        supabase
   216	          .from("invoice_items")
   217	          .select(INVOICE_ITEM_COLUMNS)
   218	          .in("invoice_id", chunk)
   219	          .order("item_id")
   220	    );

   132	// Shapes the raw joined rows into ItemOccurrence[], dropping (and logging) any
   133	// row whose join came back empty — orphaned FK or RLS blocking a related table.
   134	function mapOccurrenceRows(rows: RawOccurrenceRow[], context: string): ItemOccurrence[] {
   135	  console.log(`[items] ${context}: ${rows.length} rows`);
   136	
   137	  const dropped = rows.filter(
   138	    (row) => !row.item_catalog || !row.invoice || !row.invoice.company
   139	  );
   140	  if (dropped.length > 0) {
   141	    console.log(
   142	      `[items] ${context}: dropping ${dropped.length} row(s) with a missing join ` +
   143	        "(item_catalog / invoice / company) — check for orphaned rows or RLS blocking the related table:",
   144	      dropped.map((row) => ({
   145	        item_id: row.item_id,
   146	        missing_item_catalog: !row.item_catalog,
   147	        missing_invoice: !row.invoice,
   148	        missing_company: !!row.invoice && !row.invoice.company,
   149	      }))
   150	    );
   151	  }
   152	
   153	  return rows
   154	    .filter((row) => row.item_catalog && row.invoice && row.invoice.company)
   155	    .map((row) => {
   156	      const category = row.final_category ?? row.predicted_category;
   157	
   158	      return {
   159	        itemId: row.item_id,
   160	        catalogItemId: row.catalog_item_id,
   161	        itemName: row.item_catalog!.item_name,
   162	        description: row.item_catalog!.description,
   163	        itemText: row.item_text,
   164	        itemDescription: row.description,
   165	        quantity: row.quantity,
   166	        unit: row.unit,
   167	        unitPrice: row.unit_price,
   168	        amount: row.amount,
   169	        decision: row.decision,
   170	        needsReview: row.needs_review,
   171	        invoiceId: row.invoice!.invoice_id,
   172	        invoiceDate: row.invoice!.invoice_date,
   173	        transactionType: row.invoice!.transaction_type,
   174	        documentType: row.invoice!.document_type,
   175	        companyId: row.invoice!.company!.company_id,
   176	        companyName: row.invoice!.company!.company_name,
   177	        companyRut: row.invoice!.company!.rut,
   178	        categoryId: category?.categories_id ?? null,
   179	        categoryCode: category?.code ?? null,
   180	        categoryName: category?.name ?? null,
   181	        invoiceFolio: row.invoice!.invoice_folio,
   182	        netAmount: row.invoice!.net_amount,
   183	        ivaAmount: row.invoice!.iva_amount,
   184	        exemptAmount: row.invoice!.exempt_amount,
   185	        totalAmount: row.invoice!.total_amount,
   186	        dueDate: row.invoice!.due_date,
   187	        paymentForm: row.invoice!.payment_form,
   188	        discountPct: row.discount_pct,
   189	        discountAmount: row.discount_amount,
   190	        recargoAmount: row.recargo_amount,
   191	        taxExempt: row.tax_exempt,
   192	        predictionSource: row.prediction_source,
   193	        top1Score: row.top1_score,
   194	        margin: row.margin,
   195	        entropy: row.entropy,
   196	        reviewed: row.reviewed,
   197	      } satisfies ItemOccurrence;
   198	    });
   199	}

     3	import createIntlMiddleware from "next-intl/middleware";
     4	import { routing } from "./i18n/routing";

     6	
     7	const intlMiddleware = createIntlMiddleware(routing);
     8	
     9	const LOCALE_PATTERN = routing.locales.join("|");
    10	
    11	function localeAndPath(pathname: string) {
    12	  const match = pathname.match(new RegExp(`^/(${LOCALE_PATTERN})(/.*)?$`));
    13	  const locale = match?.[1] ?? routing.defaultLocale;
    14	  const path = match?.[2] || "/";
    15	  return { locale, path };
    16	}
    17	
    18	// Copies any Set-Cookie the Supabase middleware client wrote onto `source`
    19	// (e.g. a refreshed session) onto `target` — needed because a fresh
    20	// NextResponse.redirect(...) doesn't carry over cookies set on another
    21	// response object.
    22	function withCookies(target: NextResponse, source: NextResponse) {
    23	  source.cookies.getAll().forEach((cookie) => target.cookies.set(cookie));
    24	  return target;
    25	}
    26	
    27	export default async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
    28	  const response = intlMiddleware(request);
    29	
    30	  // next-intl already issued a redirect (e.g. "/" -> "/es") — let it through as-is.
    31	  if (response.headers.get("location")) {
    32	    return response;
    33	  }
    34	
    35	  const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req: request, res: response });
    36	
    37	  const {
    38	    data: { session },
    39	  } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    40	  const user = session?.user ?? null;
    41	
    42	  const { locale, path } = localeAndPath(request.nextUrl.pathname);
    43	  const isPublic = isPublicPath(path);
    44	
    45	  if (!user && !isPublic) {
    46	    const loginUrl = new URL(`/${locale}/login`, request.url);
    47	    return withCookies(NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl), response);
    48	  }
    49	
    50	  // Already signed in and asking for the login page — send them where a fresh
    51	  // sign-in would have landed them, so there is one post-login destination
    52	  // rather than two that can drift apart.
    53	  if (user && isPublic) {
    54	    const homeUrl = new URL(`/${locale}${POST_LOGIN_PATH}`, request.url);
    55	    return withCookies(NextResponse.redirect(homeUrl), response);
    56	  }
    57	
    58	  return response;
    59	}

     1	import { createServerComponentClient } from "@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs";
     2	import { cookies } from "next/headers";
     3	
     4	export async function createClient() {
     5	  // auth-helpers-nextjs@0.10.0 calls `context.cookies()` synchronously and
     6	  // expects a cookie store with .get()/.set() back immediately. Next.js 16's
     7	  // `cookies()` is async, so we resolve it once up front and hand back a
     8	  // closure that returns the already-resolved store — cookie writes from here
     9	  // are still no-ops in this adapter either way (Server Components can't set
    10	  // cookies), which is why middleware is what actually refreshes the session.
    11	  // The package's bundled types still declare `cookies` as returning the raw
    12	  // `next/headers` async type, which no longer matches how it's actually used
    13	  // at runtime — hence the cast.
    14	  const cookieStore = await cookies();
    15	
    16	  return createServerComponentClient({
    17	    cookies: (() => cookieStore) as unknown as typeof cookies,
    18	  });
    19	}

    34	// Merges two per-period series (already bucketed by aggregateSpendByPeriod,
    35	// one per transaction type) into one row per period for a stacked/grouped
    36	// chart. valueKey picks which field to merge — "total" for spend,
    37	// "invoiceCount" for volume — so this one function serves both time-series
    38	// charts.
    39	export function mergeSpendPeriods(
    40	  comprasPoints: SpendPeriodPoint[],
    41	  ventasPoints: SpendPeriodPoint[],
    42	  valueKey: "total" | "invoiceCount"
    43	): MergedPeriodPoint[] {
    44	  const map = new Map<string, MergedPeriodPoint>();
    45	
    46	  for (const p of comprasPoints) {
    47	    map.set(p.period, { period: p.period, compras: p[valueKey], ventas: 0 });
    48	  }
    49	  for (const p of ventasPoints) {
    50	    const existing = map.get(p.period);
    51	    if (existing) {
    52	      existing.ventas = p[valueKey];
    53	    } else {
    54	      map.set(p.period, { period: p.period, compras: 0, ventas: p[valueKey] });
    55	    }
    56	  }
    57	
    58	  return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => a.period.localeCompare(b.period));
    59	}

    61	export function aggregateKPIs(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): DashboardKpis {
    62	  const invoiceIds = new Set<string>();
    63	  const companyIds = new Set<string>();
    64	  const itemIds = new Set<string>();

    85	    avgInvoiceValue: invoiceCount > 0 ? totalSpend / invoiceCount : 0,
    86	  };

    89	// day <=31 days span, week <=180 days, else month — keeps the point count on
    90	// a spend-over-time chart in a readable range regardless of how wide the
    91	// selected date range is.
    92	export function pickGranularity(start: Date, end: Date): SpendGranularity {
    93	  const days = Math.max(1, Math.round((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 86_400_000));
    94	  if (days <= 31) return "day";
    95	  if (days <= 180) return "week";
    96	  return "month";
    97	}
    98	
    99	function isoWeekStart(dateStr: string): string {
   100	  const d = new Date(`${dateStr}T00:00:00Z`);
   101	  const day = d.getUTCDay(); // 0 (Sun) .. 6 (Sat)
   102	  const diffToMonday = (day === 0 ? -6 : 1) - day;
   103	  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + diffToMonday);
   104	  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   105	}
   106	
   107	function periodKeyFor(dateStr: string, granularity: SpendGranularity): string {
   108	  const day = dateStr.slice(0, 10);
   109	  if (granularity === "day") return day;
   110	  if (granularity === "month") return day.slice(0, 7);
   111	  return isoWeekStart(day);
   112	}

   117	// Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale) at render time.
   118	export function aggregateSpendByPeriod(
   119	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   120	  granularity: SpendGranularity
   121	): SpendPeriodPoint[] {
   122	  const buckets = new Map<string, { total: number; invoiceIds: Set<string> }>();
   123	
   124	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   125	    const key = periodKeyFor(occ.invoiceDate, granularity);
   126	    let bucket = buckets.get(key);
   127	    if (!bucket) {
   128	      bucket = { total: 0, invoiceIds: new Set() };
   129	      buckets.set(key, bucket);
   130	    }
   131	    bucket.total += occ.amount ?? 0;
   132	    bucket.invoiceIds.add(occ.invoiceId);
   133	  }
   134	
   135	  return Array.from(buckets.entries())
   136	    .map(([period, { total, invoiceIds }]) => ({
   137	      period,
   138	      periodLabel: period,
   139	      total,
   140	      invoiceCount: invoiceIds.size,
   141	    }))
   142	    .sort((a, b) => a.period.localeCompare(b.period));
   143	}
   144	
   145	// categoryLabel is left as "" for the two synthetic buckets (categoryId ===
   146	// null): the render layer decides between "Uncategorized" (isOther: false)
   147	// and "Other" (isOther: true) via translation, since this is a pure lib
   148	// function with no i18n access.
   149	export function aggregateSpendByCategory(
   150	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   151	  topN = 10
   152	): CategorySpend[] {
   153	  const buckets = new Map<
   154	    string,
   155	    { categoryLabel: string; total: number; occurrenceCount: number }
   156	  >();
   157	
   158	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   159	    const key = occ.categoryId ?? "__uncategorized__";
   160	    let bucket = buckets.get(key);
   161	    if (!bucket) {
   162	      bucket = { categoryLabel: occ.categoryName ?? "", total: 0, occurrenceCount: 0 };
   163	      buckets.set(key, bucket);
   164	    }
   165	    bucket.total += occ.amount ?? 0;
   166	    bucket.occurrenceCount += 1;
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  const sorted: CategorySpend[] = Array.from(buckets.entries())
   170	    .map(([key, b]) => ({
   171	      categoryId: key === "__uncategorized__" ? null : key,
   172	      categoryLabel: b.categoryLabel,
   173	      total: b.total,
   174	      occurrenceCount: b.occurrenceCount,
   175	      isOther: false,
   176	    }))
   177	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
   178	
   179	  if (sorted.length <= topN) return sorted;
   180	
   181	  const top = sorted.slice(0, topN);
   182	  const rest = sorted.slice(topN);
   183	
   184	  top.push({
   185	    categoryId: null,
   186	    categoryLabel: "",
   187	    total: rest.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.total, 0),
   188	    occurrenceCount: rest.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.occurrenceCount, 0),
   189	    isOther: true,
   190	  });
   191	
   192	  return top;
   193	}

   240	// Always returns both COMPRAS and VENTAS, zero-filled when absent, so the
   241	// split chart doesn't reshape itself as the data changes.
   242	export function aggregateTransactionTypeSplit(
   243	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]
   244	): TransactionSplit[] {
   245	  const totals: Record<TransactionType, { total: number; count: number }> = {
   246	    COMPRAS: { total: 0, count: 0 },
   247	    VENTAS: { total: 0, count: 0 },
   248	  };
   249	
   250	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   251	    totals[occ.transactionType].total += occ.amount ?? 0;
   252	    totals[occ.transactionType].count += 1;
   253	  }
   254	
   255	  return (["COMPRAS", "VENTAS"] as const).map((transactionType) => ({
   256	    transactionType,
   257	    total: totals[transactionType].total,
   258	    count: totals[transactionType].count,
   259	  }));
   260	}

   474	// --- Data Quality tab ---
   475	
   476	export function aggregateDataQualitySummary(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): DataQualitySummary {
   477	  let autoAccepted = 0;
   478	  let needsReview = 0;
   479	  let reviewedManually = 0;
   480	
   481	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   482	    if (occ.decision === "auto_accept") autoAccepted++;
   483	    else if (occ.needsReview) needsReview++;
   484	    // decision === "review_required" && !needsReview means reviewed === true
   485	    // per the generated-column definition (needs_review = review_required AND !reviewed).
   486	    else reviewedManually++;
   487	  }
   488	
   489	  return { autoAccepted, needsReview, reviewedManually, total: occurrences.length };
   490	}
   491	
   492	export function aggregatePredictionSourceSplit(
   493	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]
   494	): PredictionSourceSplit[] {
   495	  const buckets = new Map<string, { count: number; scoreSum: number }>();
   496	
   497	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   498	    let bucket = buckets.get(occ.predictionSource);
   499	    if (!bucket) {
   500	      bucket = { count: 0, scoreSum: 0 };
   501	      buckets.set(occ.predictionSource, bucket);
   502	    }
   503	    bucket.count += 1;
   504	    bucket.scoreSum += occ.top1Score;
   505	  }
   506	
   507	  return Array.from(buckets.entries())
   508	    .map(([predictionSource, b]) => ({
   509	      predictionSource,
   510	      count: b.count,
   511	      avgTop1Score: b.count > 0 ? b.scoreSum / b.count : 0,
   512	    }))
   513	    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
   514	}
   515	
   516	// Fixed 10 bins over top1_score (0.0-1.0), ASCENDING order — a confidence
   517	// histogram reads left-to-right by increasing confidence, not by which bin
   518	// happens to have the most rows.
   519	export function aggregateConfidenceHistogram(
   520	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   521	  bucketSize = 0.1
   522	): ConfidenceBucket[] {
   523	  const bucketCount = Math.round(1 / bucketSize);
   524	  const counts = new Array(bucketCount).fill(0) as number[];
   525	
   526	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   527	    const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(occ.top1Score, 0), 1);
   528	    const index = Math.min(Math.floor(clamped / bucketSize), bucketCount - 1);
   529	    counts[index] += 1;
   530	  }
   531	
   532	  return counts.map((count, index) => {
   533	    const start = index * bucketSize;
   534	    const end = start + bucketSize;
   535	    return {
   536	      bucketLabel: `${start.toFixed(1)}–${end.toFixed(1)}`,
   537	      bucketStart: start,
   538	      count,
   539	    };
   540	  });
   541	}

   543	// Lowest-margin (most ambiguous between top1/top2 category) unreviewed
   544	// predictions first — a worklist for whoever triages the review queue.
   545	export function selectAmbiguousPredictions(
   546	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   547	  limit = 20
   548	): ItemOccurrence[] {
   549	  return [...occurrences]
   550	    .filter((occ) => !occ.reviewed)
   551	    .sort((a, b) => a.margin - b.margin)
   552	    .slice(0, limit);
   553	}
     1	import type { ItemOccurrence } from "@/lib/items/types";
     2	import type {
     3	  ApAgingBucket,
     4	  ApAgingBucketKey,
     5	  DocumentTypeSpend,
     6	  InvoiceSummary,
     7	  PaymentFormSplit,
     8	  TaxTotals,
     9	} from "./types";
    10	
    11	// Every function in this file consumes InvoiceSummary[], never raw
    12	// ItemOccurrence[] — invoice-level fields (net/IVA/exempt/total amount, due
    13	// date, payment form) live once per invoice, not once per line, so summing
    14	// them over ItemOccurrence[] directly would multiply-count every invoice by
    15	// its line count. Always go through deriveInvoiceSummaries first.
    16	
    17	// Groups occurrences by invoiceId, taking one representative per group —
    18	// invoice-level fields are identical across every line of the same invoice
    19	// by construction of the join, so "first occurrence encountered" is a safe,
    20	// cheap pick. Logs a warning (dev-only signal, not a thrown error) if two
    21	// occurrences sharing an invoiceId disagree on a supposedly invoice-level
    22	// field, since that would indicate a query/join bug rather than legitimate
    23	// data variation.
    24	export function deriveInvoiceSummaries(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): InvoiceSummary[] {
    25	  const map = new Map<string, InvoiceSummary>();
    26	
    27	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
    28	    const existing = map.get(occ.invoiceId);
    29	    if (existing) {
    30	      existing.lineItemCount += 1;
    31	      if (
    32	        existing.totalAmount !== occ.totalAmount ||
    33	        existing.dueDate !== occ.dueDate ||
    34	        existing.documentType !== occ.documentType
    35	      ) {
    36	        console.log(
    37	          `[dashboard] deriveInvoiceSummaries: invoice ${occ.invoiceId} has disagreeing ` +
    38	            "invoice-level fields across its lines — possible join bug:",
    39	          { existing, occurrence: occ }
    40	        );
    41	      }
    42	      continue;
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    map.set(occ.invoiceId, {
    46	      invoiceId: occ.invoiceId,
    47	      invoiceDate: occ.invoiceDate,
    48	      transactionType: occ.transactionType,
    49	      documentType: occ.documentType,
    50	      invoiceFolio: occ.invoiceFolio,
    51	      companyId: occ.companyId,
    52	      companyName: occ.companyName,
    53	      companyRut: occ.companyRut,
    54	      netAmount: occ.netAmount,
    55	      ivaAmount: occ.ivaAmount,
    56	      exemptAmount: occ.exemptAmount,
    57	      totalAmount: occ.totalAmount,
    58	      dueDate: occ.dueDate,
    59	      paymentForm: occ.paymentForm,
    60	      lineItemCount: 1,
    61	    });
    62	  }
    63	
    64	  return Array.from(map.values());
    65	}

    67	// HEURISTIC, unverified against real document_type values — RLS blocks this
    68	// environment from reading the DB outside an authenticated session (same
    69	// wall hit earlier this project trying to smoke-test other queries), so this
    70	// couldn't be confirmed against live data. Deliberately excludes a bare "nc"
    71	// hint since it's too easy to false-positive as a substring of unrelated
    72	// words. Replace with an exact-match allowlist once real values are visible
    73	// via the Tax & Documents tab's document-type breakdown chart (which shows
    74	// every raw value, unfiltered, specifically so this can be verified).
    75	export const CREDIT_NOTE_DOCUMENT_TYPE_HINTS = [
    76	  "nota de crédito",
    77	  "nota de credito",
    78	  "credit note",
    79	];
    80	
    81	export function isCreditNote(documentType: string): boolean {
    82	  const normalized = documentType.toLowerCase();
    83	  return CREDIT_NOTE_DOCUMENT_TYPE_HINTS.some((hint) => normalized.includes(hint));
    84	}

    86	export function aggregateCreditNoteSummary(
    87	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[]
    88	): { total: number; count: number } {
    89	  const creditNotes = invoices.filter((inv) => isCreditNote(inv.documentType));
    90	  return {
    91	    total: creditNotes.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + (inv.totalAmount ?? 0), 0),
    92	    count: creditNotes.length,
    93	  };
    94	}
    95	
    96	const AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER: ApAgingBucketKey[] = [
    97	  "no_due_date",
    98	  "current",
    99	  "1-30",
   100	  "31-60",
   101	  "61-90",
   102	  "90+",
   103	];
   104	
   105	function apAgingBucketFor(dueDate: string | null, asOfDate: Date): ApAgingBucketKey {
   106	  if (!dueDate) return "no_due_date";
   107	  const due = new Date(`${dueDate}T00:00:00Z`);
   108	  const diffDays = Math.floor((asOfDate.getTime() - due.getTime()) / 86_400_000);
   109	  if (diffDays <= 0) return "current"; // due today or still in the future
   110	  if (diffDays <= 30) return "1-30";
   111	  if (diffDays <= 60) return "31-60";
   112	  if (diffDays <= 90) return "61-90";
   113	  return "90+";
   114	}
   115	
   116	// Fixed, ORDERED buckets (not sorted by value) — an aging report reads
   117	// left-to-right by increasing risk, not by which bucket happens to be
   118	// largest. Caller should filter `invoices` to COMPRAS only first — AP
   119	// conceptually only applies to purchases.
   120	export function aggregateApAging(invoices: InvoiceSummary[], asOfDate: Date): ApAgingBucket[] {
   121	  const totals = new Map<ApAgingBucketKey, { total: number; invoiceCount: number }>();
   122	  for (const key of AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER) totals.set(key, { total: 0, invoiceCount: 0 });
   123	
   124	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   125	    const bucket = apAgingBucketFor(inv.dueDate, asOfDate);
   126	    const entry = totals.get(bucket)!;
   127	    entry.total += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   128	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   129	  }
   130	
   131	  return AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER.map((bucket) => ({
   132	    bucket,
   133	    total: totals.get(bucket)!.total,
   134	    invoiceCount: totals.get(bucket)!.invoiceCount,
   135	  }));
   136	}

   138	export function aggregatePaymentFormSplit(
   139	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[],
   140	  topN = 8
   141	): PaymentFormSplit[] {
   142	  const buckets = new Map<string, { label: string; total: number; invoiceCount: number }>();
   143	
   144	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   145	    const key = inv.paymentForm ?? "__unspecified__";
   146	    let bucket = buckets.get(key);
   147	    if (!bucket) {
   148	      bucket = { label: inv.paymentForm ?? "", total: 0, invoiceCount: 0 };
   149	      buckets.set(key, bucket);
   150	    }
   151	    bucket.total += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   152	    bucket.invoiceCount += 1;
   153	  }
   154	
   155	  const sorted: PaymentFormSplit[] = Array.from(buckets.entries())
   156	    .map(([key, b]) => ({
   157	      paymentForm: key === "__unspecified__" ? "" : key,
   158	      paymentFormLabel: b.label,
   159	      total: b.total,
   160	      invoiceCount: b.invoiceCount,
   161	      isOther: false,
   162	    }))
   163	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
   164	
   165	  if (sorted.length <= topN) return sorted;
   166	
   167	  const top = sorted.slice(0, topN);
   168	  const rest = sorted.slice(topN);
   169	  top.push({
   170	    paymentForm: "",
   171	    paymentFormLabel: "",
   172	    total: rest.reduce((s, r) => s + r.total, 0),
   173	    invoiceCount: rest.reduce((s, r) => s + r.invoiceCount, 0),
   174	    isOther: true,
   175	  });
   176	  return top;
   177	}

   179	// Computed on the credit-note-EXCLUDED subset — headline tax totals should
   180	// reflect real invoices, with credit notes surfaced separately via
   181	// aggregateCreditNoteSummary (see cross-cutting rules in the plan).
   182	export function aggregateTaxTotals(invoices: InvoiceSummary[]): TaxTotals {
   183	  const nonCreditNotes = invoices.filter((inv) => !isCreditNote(inv.documentType));
   184	
   185	  let netTotal = 0;
   186	  let ivaTotal = 0;
   187	  let exemptTotal = 0;
   188	  let grandTotal = 0;
   189	
   190	  for (const inv of nonCreditNotes) {
   191	    netTotal += inv.netAmount ?? 0;
   192	    ivaTotal += inv.ivaAmount ?? 0;
   193	    exemptTotal += inv.exemptAmount ?? 0;
   194	    grandTotal += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   195	  }
   196	
   197	  return { netTotal, ivaTotal, exemptTotal, grandTotal, invoiceCount: nonCreditNotes.length };
   198	}

    13	// Entity-level aggregation for the drill-down explorer. Pure functions over
    14	// already-fetched arrays — no Supabase, no i18n, same contract as aggregate.ts.
    15	//
    16	// The invoice- vs. line-level rule from src/lib/dashboard/invoices.ts applies
    17	// here too: anything derived from net/IVA/exempt/total amount, due date or
    18	// payment form must come from InvoiceSummary[], never be summed over
    19	// ItemOccurrence[]. aggregateCompanyProfiles takes `invoices` as a separate
    20	// argument specifically so that can't be got wrong by accident.
    21	
    22	const MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000;
    23	
    24	// Σamount / Σquantity — deliberately NOT a mean of unitPrice. A naive mean
    25	// lets one 1-unit line count as much as a 1000-unit line, which is the
    26	// classic way a "average price" number ends up wrong. Falls back to a plain
    27	// mean only when quantity is unusable, and says so via isUnweighted.
    28	export function computeUnitPriceStats(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): UnitPriceStats {
    29	  const units = new Set<string>();
    30	  let amountSum = 0;
    31	  let quantitySum = 0;
    32	  let priceSum = 0;
    33	  let priceCount = 0;
    34	  let min: number | null = null;
    35	  let max: number | null = null;
    36	
    37	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
    38	    if (occ.unit) units.add(occ.unit);
    39	
    40	    if (occ.quantity !== null && occ.quantity > 0 && occ.amount !== null) {
    41	      amountSum += occ.amount;
    42	      quantitySum += occ.quantity;
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    if (occ.unitPrice !== null && occ.unitPrice > 0) {
    46	      priceSum += occ.unitPrice;
    47	      priceCount += 1;
    48	      if (min === null || occ.unitPrice < min) min = occ.unitPrice;
    49	      if (max === null || occ.unitPrice > max) max = occ.unitPrice;
    50	    }
    51	  }
    52	
    53	  const hasMixedUnits = units.size > 1;
    54	
    55	  let weightedAvg: number | null = null;
    56	  let isUnweighted = false;
    57	  if (quantitySum > 0) {
    58	    weightedAvg = amountSum / quantitySum;
    59	  } else if (priceCount > 0) {
    60	    weightedAvg = priceSum / priceCount;
    61	    isUnweighted = true;
    62	  }
    63	
    64	  // A spread across different units of measure (KG vs UN) compares unlike
    65	  // things and would report a fake several-thousand-percent gap — suppress it
    66	  // rather than publishing a number nobody can act on.
    67	  const spreadPct =
    68	    !hasMixedUnits && min !== null && max !== null && min > 0
    69	      ? ((max - min) / min) * 100
    70	      : null;
    71	
    72	  return {
    73	    weightedAvg,
    74	    min,
    75	    max,
    76	    spreadPct,
    77	    isUnweighted,
    78	    hasMixedUnits,
    79	    units: Array.from(units).sort(),
    80	  };
    81	}

    83	export function aggregateCompanyProfiles(
    84	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
    85	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[],
    86	  companyMap: Map<string, Company>
    87	): CompanyProfile[] {
    88	  interface Acc {
    89	    comprasTotal: number;
    90	    ventasTotal: number;
    91	    lineCount: number;
    92	    itemIds: Set<string>;
    93	    categoryIds: Set<string>;
    94	    discountTotal: number;
    95	    recargoTotal: number;
    96	    needsReviewCount: number;
    97	    firstInvoiceDate: string | null;
    98	    lastInvoiceDate: string | null;
    99	  }
   100	
   101	  const acc = new Map<string, Acc>();
   102	  const ensure = (companyId: string): Acc => {
   103	    let entry = acc.get(companyId);
   104	    if (!entry) {
   105	      entry = {
   106	        comprasTotal: 0,
   107	        ventasTotal: 0,
   108	        lineCount: 0,
   109	        itemIds: new Set(),
   110	        categoryIds: new Set(),
   111	        discountTotal: 0,
   112	        recargoTotal: 0,
   113	        needsReviewCount: 0,
   114	        firstInvoiceDate: null,
   115	        lastInvoiceDate: null,
   116	      };
   117	      acc.set(companyId, entry);
   118	    }
   119	    return entry;
   120	  };
   121	
   122	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   123	    const entry = ensure(occ.companyId);
   124	    const amount = occ.amount ?? 0;
   125	    if (occ.transactionType === "COMPRAS") entry.comprasTotal += amount;
   126	    else entry.ventasTotal += amount;
   127	
   128	    entry.lineCount += 1;
   129	    entry.itemIds.add(occ.catalogItemId);
   130	    if (occ.categoryId) entry.categoryIds.add(occ.categoryId);
   131	    entry.discountTotal += occ.discountAmount ?? 0;
   132	    entry.recargoTotal += occ.recargoAmount ?? 0;
   133	    if (occ.needsReview) entry.needsReviewCount += 1;
   134	
   135	    const date = occ.invoiceDate.slice(0, 10);
   136	    if (entry.firstInvoiceDate === null || date < entry.firstInvoiceDate) {
   137	      entry.firstInvoiceDate = date;
   138	    }
   139	    if (entry.lastInvoiceDate === null || date > entry.lastInvoiceDate) {
   140	      entry.lastInvoiceDate = date;
   141	    }
   142	  }
   143	
   144	  // Invoice-level metrics come from the deduped InvoiceSummary[], so they
   145	  // count each invoice once regardless of how many lines it carries.
   146	  interface InvAcc {
   147	    invoiceCount: number;
   148	    totalSum: number;
   149	    maxTotal: number;
   150	    maxFolio: string | null;
   151	    daysToDueSum: number;
   152	    daysToDueCount: number;
   153	  }
   154	  const invAcc = new Map<string, InvAcc>();
   155	
   156	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   157	    let entry = invAcc.get(inv.companyId);
   158	    if (!entry) {
   159	      entry = {
   160	        invoiceCount: 0,
   161	        totalSum: 0,
   162	        maxTotal: 0,
   163	        maxFolio: null,
   164	        daysToDueSum: 0,
   165	        daysToDueCount: 0,
   166	      };
   167	      invAcc.set(inv.companyId, entry);
   168	    }
   169	
   170	    const total = inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   171	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   172	    entry.totalSum += total;
   173	    if (total > entry.maxTotal) {
   174	      entry.maxTotal = total;
   175	      entry.maxFolio = inv.invoiceFolio;
   176	    }
   177	
   178	    if (inv.dueDate) {
   179	      const issued = new Date(`${inv.invoiceDate.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
   180	      const due = new Date(`${inv.dueDate.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
   181	      if (!Number.isNaN(issued) && !Number.isNaN(due)) {
   182	        entry.daysToDueSum += (due - issued) / MS_PER_DAY;
   183	        entry.daysToDueCount += 1;
   184	      }
   185	    }
   186	  }
   187	
   188	  const profiles: CompanyProfile[] = [];
   189	  for (const [companyId, entry] of acc) {
   190	    const company = companyMap.get(companyId);
   191	    const inv = invAcc.get(companyId);
   192	    const invoiceCount = inv?.invoiceCount ?? 0;
   193	
   194	    profiles.push({
   195	      companyId,
   196	      companyName: company?.company_name ?? companyId,
   197	      companyRut: company?.rut ?? "",
   198	      giro: company?.giro ?? null,
   199	      commune: company?.commune ?? null,
   200	      city: company?.city ?? null,
   201	      isSeller: company?.is_seller ?? false,
   202	      isBuyer: company?.is_buyer ?? false,
   203	      comprasTotal: entry.comprasTotal,
   204	      ventasTotal: entry.ventasTotal,
   205	      invoiceCount,
   206	      lineCount: entry.lineCount,
   207	      distinctItems: entry.itemIds.size,
   208	      distinctCategories: entry.categoryIds.size,
   209	      avgInvoiceValue: invoiceCount > 0 ? (inv?.totalSum ?? 0) / invoiceCount : 0,
   210	      maxInvoiceTotal: inv?.maxTotal ?? 0,
   211	      maxInvoiceFolio: inv?.maxFolio ?? null,
   212	      discountTotal: entry.discountTotal,
   213	      recargoTotal: entry.recargoTotal,
   214	      avgDaysToDue:
   215	        inv && inv.daysToDueCount > 0 ? inv.daysToDueSum / inv.daysToDueCount : null,
   216	      firstInvoiceDate: entry.firstInvoiceDate,
   217	      lastInvoiceDate: entry.lastInvoiceDate,
   218	      needsReviewCount: entry.needsReviewCount,
   219	      needsReviewPct:
   220	        entry.lineCount > 0 ? (entry.needsReviewCount / entry.lineCount) * 100 : 0,
   221	    });
   222	  }
   223	
   224	  return profiles.sort((a, b) => b.comprasTotal + b.ventasTotal - (a.comprasTotal + a.ventasTotal));
   225	}

   229	export function aggregateCategoryProfiles(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): CategoryProfile[] {
   230	  interface Acc {
   231	    categoryId: string | null;
   232	    categoryCode: string | null;
   233	    categoryName: string | null;
   234	    total: number;
   235	    lineCount: number;
   236	    invoiceIds: Set<string>;
   237	    companyIds: Set<string>;
   238	    itemIds: Set<string>;
   239	    occurrences: ItemOccurrence[];
   240	    maxLineAmount: number;
   241	    maxLineItemName: string | null;
   242	    needsReviewCount: number;
   243	  }
   244	
   245	  const acc = new Map<string, Acc>();
   246	  let grandTotal = 0;
   247	
   248	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   249	    const key = occ.categoryId ?? UNCATEGORIZED_KEY;
   250	    let entry = acc.get(key);
   251	    if (!entry) {
   252	      entry = {
   253	        categoryId: occ.categoryId,
   254	        categoryCode: occ.categoryCode,
   255	        categoryName: occ.categoryName,
   256	        total: 0,
   257	        lineCount: 0,
   258	        invoiceIds: new Set(),
   259	        companyIds: new Set(),
   260	        itemIds: new Set(),
   261	        occurrences: [],
   262	        maxLineAmount: 0,
   263	        maxLineItemName: null,
   264	        needsReviewCount: 0,
   265	      };
   266	      acc.set(key, entry);
   267	    }
   268	
   269	    const amount = occ.amount ?? 0;
   270	    entry.total += amount;
   271	    grandTotal += amount;
   272	    entry.lineCount += 1;
   273	    entry.invoiceIds.add(occ.invoiceId);
   274	    entry.companyIds.add(occ.companyId);
   275	    entry.itemIds.add(occ.catalogItemId);
   276	    entry.occurrences.push(occ);
   277	    if (amount > entry.maxLineAmount) {
   278	      entry.maxLineAmount = amount;
   279	      entry.maxLineItemName = occ.itemName;
   280	    }
   281	    if (occ.needsReview) entry.needsReviewCount += 1;
   282	  }
   283	
   284	  return Array.from(acc.values())
   285	    .map((entry) => ({
   286	      categoryId: entry.categoryId,
   287	      categoryCode: entry.categoryCode,
   288	      categoryName: entry.categoryName,
   289	      total: entry.total,
   290	      sharePct: grandTotal > 0 ? (entry.total / grandTotal) * 100 : 0,
   291	      invoiceCount: entry.invoiceIds.size,
   292	      lineCount: entry.lineCount,
   293	      distinctCompanies: entry.companyIds.size,
   294	      distinctItems: entry.itemIds.size,
   295	      unitPrice: computeUnitPriceStats(entry.occurrences),
   296	      maxLineAmount: entry.maxLineAmount,
   297	      maxLineItemName: entry.maxLineItemName,
   298	      needsReviewCount: entry.needsReviewCount,
   299	      needsReviewPct:
   300	        entry.lineCount > 0 ? (entry.needsReviewCount / entry.lineCount) * 100 : 0,
   301	    }))
   302	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
   303	}

   305	export function aggregateItemProfiles(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): ItemProfile[] {
   306	  interface Acc {

   308	    description: string | null;
   309	    categoryId: string | null;
   310	    categoryName: string | null;

   369	// One line per supplier for a single item's unit price over time. Capped at
   370	// maxCompanies (most observations first) because a line chart has no sane
   371	// "Other" bucket — you can't average unrelated suppliers into one series.
   372	export function aggregatePriceTrend(
   373	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   374	  maxCompanies = 6
   375	): PriceTrendSeries[] {
   376	  const byCompany = new Map<string, { companyName: string; occurrences: ItemOccurrence[] }>();
   377	
   378	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   379	    if (occ.unitPrice === null) continue;
   380	    let entry = byCompany.get(occ.companyId);
   381	    if (!entry) {
   382	      entry = { companyName: occ.companyName, occurrences: [] };
   383	      byCompany.set(occ.companyId, entry);
   384	    }
   385	    entry.occurrences.push(occ);
   386	  }
   387	
   388	  return Array.from(byCompany.entries())
   389	    .sort((a, b) => b[1].occurrences.length - a[1].occurrences.length)
   390	    .slice(0, maxCompanies)
   391	    .map(([companyId, entry]) => ({
   392	      companyId,
   393	      companyName: entry.companyName,
   394	      points: entry.occurrences
   395	        .map((occ) => ({
   396	          date: occ.invoiceDate.slice(0, 10),
   397	          unitPrice: occ.unitPrice as number,
   398	        }))
   399	        .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)),
   400	    }));
   401	}

   403	// Category x company crosstab. Top-N on both axes is lossy by construction —
   404	// coveredTotal/grandTotal are returned so the UI can state what fraction of
   405	// spend the visible cells actually account for.
   406	export function aggregateCategoryCompanyMatrix(
   407	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   408	  topCategories = 12,
   409	  topCompanies = 10
   410	): MatrixData {
   411	  const categoryTotals = new Map<string, MatrixAxisEntry>();
   412	  const companyTotals = new Map<string, MatrixAxisEntry>();
   413	  const pairTotals = new Map<string, number>();
   414	  let grandTotal = 0;
   415	
   416	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   417	    const amount = occ.amount ?? 0;
   418	    grandTotal += amount;
   419	
   420	    const categoryId = occ.categoryId ?? UNCATEGORIZED_KEY;
   421	    const categoryLabel = occ.categoryName ?? "";
   422	    const category = categoryTotals.get(categoryId);
   423	    if (category) category.total += amount;
   424	    else categoryTotals.set(categoryId, { id: categoryId, label: categoryLabel, total: amount });
   425	
   426	    const company = companyTotals.get(occ.companyId);
   427	    if (company) company.total += amount;
   428	    else
   429	      companyTotals.set(occ.companyId, {
   430	        id: occ.companyId,
   431	        label: occ.companyName,
   432	        total: amount,
   433	      });
   434	
   435	    const pairKey = `${categoryId}␀${occ.companyId}`;
   436	    pairTotals.set(pairKey, (pairTotals.get(pairKey) ?? 0) + amount);
   437	  }
   438	
   439	  const rows = Array.from(categoryTotals.values())
   440	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total)
   441	    .slice(0, topCategories);
   442	  const cols = Array.from(companyTotals.values())
   443	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total)
   444	    .slice(0, topCompanies);
   445	
   446	  let maxCell = 0;
   447	  let coveredTotal = 0;
   448	  const cells = rows.map((row) =>
   449	    cols.map((col) => {
   450	      const value = pairTotals.get(`${row.id}␀${col.id}`) ?? 0;
   451	      if (value > maxCell) maxCell = value;
   452	      coveredTotal += value;
   453	      return value;
   454	    })
   455	  );
   456	
   457	  return { rows, cols, cells, maxCell, coveredTotal, grandTotal };
   458	}

     8	  TaxTotals,
     9	} from "./types";
    10	
    11	// Every function in this file consumes InvoiceSummary[], never raw
    12	// ItemOccurrence[] — invoice-level fields (net/IVA/exempt/total amount, due
    13	// date, payment form) live once per invoice, not once per line, so summing
    14	// them over ItemOccurrence[] directly would multiply-count every invoice by
    15	// its line count. Always go through deriveInvoiceSummaries first.
    16	
    17	// Groups occurrences by invoiceId, taking one representative per group —
    18	// invoice-level fields are identical across every line of the same invoice
    19	// by construction of the join, so "first occurrence encountered" is a safe,
    20	// cheap pick. Logs a warning (dev-only signal, not a thrown error) if two
    21	// occurrences sharing an invoiceId disagree on a supposedly invoice-level
    22	// field, since that would indicate a query/join bug rather than legitimate
    23	// data variation.
    24	export function deriveInvoiceSummaries(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): InvoiceSummary[] {
    25	  const map = new Map<string, InvoiceSummary>();
    26	
    27	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
    28	    const existing = map.get(occ.invoiceId);
    29	    if (existing) {
    30	      existing.lineItemCount += 1;
    31	      if (
    32	        existing.totalAmount !== occ.totalAmount ||
    33	        existing.dueDate !== occ.dueDate ||
    34	        existing.documentType !== occ.documentType
    35	      ) {
    36	        console.log(
    37	          `[dashboard] deriveInvoiceSummaries: invoice ${occ.invoiceId} has disagreeing ` +
    38	            "invoice-level fields across its lines — possible join bug:",
    39	          { existing, occurrence: occ }
    40	        );
    41	      }
    42	      continue;
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    map.set(occ.invoiceId, {
    46	      invoiceId: occ.invoiceId,
    47	      invoiceDate: occ.invoiceDate,
    48	      transactionType: occ.transactionType,
    49	      documentType: occ.documentType,
    50	      invoiceFolio: occ.invoiceFolio,
    51	      companyId: occ.companyId,
    52	      companyName: occ.companyName,
    53	      companyRut: occ.companyRut,
    54	      netAmount: occ.netAmount,
    55	      ivaAmount: occ.ivaAmount,
    56	      exemptAmount: occ.exemptAmount,
    57	      totalAmount: occ.totalAmount,
    58	      dueDate: occ.dueDate,
    59	      paymentForm: occ.paymentForm,
    60	      lineItemCount: 1,
    61	    });
    62	  }
    63	
    64	  return Array.from(map.values());
    65	}
    66	
    67	// HEURISTIC, unverified against real document_type values — RLS blocks this
    68	// environment from reading the DB outside an authenticated session (same
    69	// wall hit earlier this project trying to smoke-test other queries), so this
    70	// couldn't be confirmed against live data. Deliberately excludes a bare "nc"
    71	// hint since it's too easy to false-positive as a substring of unrelated
    72	// words. Replace with an exact-match allowlist once real values are visible
    73	// via the Tax & Documents tab's document-type breakdown chart (which shows
    74	// every raw value, unfiltered, specifically so this can be verified).
    75	export const CREDIT_NOTE_DOCUMENT_TYPE_HINTS = [
    76	  "nota de crédito",
    77	  "nota de credito",
    78	  "credit note",
    79	];
    80	
    81	export function isCreditNote(documentType: string): boolean {
    82	  const normalized = documentType.toLowerCase();
    83	  return CREDIT_NOTE_DOCUMENT_TYPE_HINTS.some((hint) => normalized.includes(hint));
    84	}
    85	
    86	export function aggregateCreditNoteSummary(
    87	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[]
    88	): { total: number; count: number } {
    89	  const creditNotes = invoices.filter((inv) => isCreditNote(inv.documentType));
    90	  return {
    91	    total: creditNotes.reduce((sum, inv) => sum + (inv.totalAmount ?? 0), 0),
    92	    count: creditNotes.length,
    93	  };
    94	}
    95	
    96	const AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER: ApAgingBucketKey[] = [
    97	  "no_due_date",
    98	  "current",
    99	  "1-30",
   100	  "31-60",
   101	  "61-90",
   102	  "90+",
   103	];
   104	
   105	function apAgingBucketFor(dueDate: string | null, asOfDate: Date): ApAgingBucketKey {
   106	  if (!dueDate) return "no_due_date";
   107	  const due = new Date(`${dueDate}T00:00:00Z`);
   108	  const diffDays = Math.floor((asOfDate.getTime() - due.getTime()) / 86_400_000);
   109	  if (diffDays <= 0) return "current"; // due today or still in the future
   110	  if (diffDays <= 30) return "1-30";
   111	  if (diffDays <= 60) return "31-60";
   112	  if (diffDays <= 90) return "61-90";
   113	  return "90+";
   114	}
   115	
   116	// Fixed, ORDERED buckets (not sorted by value) — an aging report reads
   117	// left-to-right by increasing risk, not by which bucket happens to be
   118	// largest. Caller should filter `invoices` to COMPRAS only first — AP
   119	// conceptually only applies to purchases.
   120	export function aggregateApAging(invoices: InvoiceSummary[], asOfDate: Date): ApAgingBucket[] {
   121	  const totals = new Map<ApAgingBucketKey, { total: number; invoiceCount: number }>();
   122	  for (const key of AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER) totals.set(key, { total: 0, invoiceCount: 0 });
   123	
   124	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   125	    const bucket = apAgingBucketFor(inv.dueDate, asOfDate);
   126	    const entry = totals.get(bucket)!;
   127	    entry.total += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   128	    entry.invoiceCount += 1;
   129	  }
   130	
   131	  return AP_AGING_BUCKET_ORDER.map((bucket) => ({
   132	    bucket,
   133	    total: totals.get(bucket)!.total,
   134	    invoiceCount: totals.get(bucket)!.invoiceCount,
   135	  }));
   136	}
   137	
   138	export function aggregatePaymentFormSplit(
   139	  invoices: InvoiceSummary[],
   140	  topN = 8
   141	): PaymentFormSplit[] {
   142	  const buckets = new Map<string, { label: string; total: number; invoiceCount: number }>();
   143	
   144	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   145	    const key = inv.paymentForm ?? "__unspecified__";
   146	    let bucket = buckets.get(key);
   147	    if (!bucket) {
   148	      bucket = { label: inv.paymentForm ?? "", total: 0, invoiceCount: 0 };
   149	      buckets.set(key, bucket);
   150	    }
   151	    bucket.total += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   152	    bucket.invoiceCount += 1;
   153	  }
   154	
   155	  const sorted: PaymentFormSplit[] = Array.from(buckets.entries())
   156	    .map(([key, b]) => ({
   157	      paymentForm: key === "__unspecified__" ? "" : key,
   158	      paymentFormLabel: b.label,
   159	      total: b.total,
   160	      invoiceCount: b.invoiceCount,
   161	      isOther: false,
   162	    }))
   163	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
   164	
   165	  if (sorted.length <= topN) return sorted;
   166	
   167	  const top = sorted.slice(0, topN);
   168	  const rest = sorted.slice(topN);
   169	  top.push({
   170	    paymentForm: "",
   171	    paymentFormLabel: "",
   172	    total: rest.reduce((s, r) => s + r.total, 0),
   173	    invoiceCount: rest.reduce((s, r) => s + r.invoiceCount, 0),
   174	    isOther: true,
   175	  });
   176	  return top;
   177	}
   178	
   179	// Computed on the credit-note-EXCLUDED subset — headline tax totals should
   180	// reflect real invoices, with credit notes surfaced separately via
   181	// aggregateCreditNoteSummary (see cross-cutting rules in the plan).
   182	export function aggregateTaxTotals(invoices: InvoiceSummary[]): TaxTotals {
   183	  const nonCreditNotes = invoices.filter((inv) => !isCreditNote(inv.documentType));
   184	
   185	  let netTotal = 0;
   186	  let ivaTotal = 0;
   187	  let exemptTotal = 0;
   188	  let grandTotal = 0;
   189	
   190	  for (const inv of nonCreditNotes) {
   191	    netTotal += inv.netAmount ?? 0;
   192	    ivaTotal += inv.ivaAmount ?? 0;
   193	    exemptTotal += inv.exemptAmount ?? 0;
   194	    grandTotal += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   195	  }
   196	
   197	  return { netTotal, ivaTotal, exemptTotal, grandTotal, invoiceCount: nonCreditNotes.length };
   198	}
   199	
   200	// Groups by the RAW, unfiltered document_type string — safe by construction
   201	// (no guessing), and this is the one chart that deliberately includes credit
   202	// notes rather than excluding them, since its whole job is composition.
   203	export function aggregateDocumentTypeBreakdown(invoices: InvoiceSummary[]): DocumentTypeSpend[] {
   204	  const buckets = new Map<string, { total: number; invoiceCount: number }>();
   205	
   206	  for (const inv of invoices) {
   207	    let bucket = buckets.get(inv.documentType);
   208	    if (!bucket) {
   209	      bucket = { total: 0, invoiceCount: 0 };
   210	      buckets.set(inv.documentType, bucket);
   211	    }
   212	    bucket.total += inv.totalAmount ?? 0;
   213	    bucket.invoiceCount += 1;
   214	  }
   215	
   216	  return Array.from(buckets.entries())
   217	    .map(([documentType, b]) => ({
   218	      documentType,
   219	      total: b.total,
   220	      invoiceCount: b.invoiceCount,
   221	      isCreditNote: isCreditNote(documentType),
   222	    }))
   223	    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
   224	}
   474	// --- Data Quality tab ---
   475	
   476	export function aggregateDataQualitySummary(occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]): DataQualitySummary {
   477	  let autoAccepted = 0;
   478	  let needsReview = 0;
   479	  let reviewedManually = 0;
   480	
   481	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   482	    if (occ.decision === "auto_accept") autoAccepted++;
   483	    else if (occ.needsReview) needsReview++;
   484	    // decision === "review_required" && !needsReview means reviewed === true
   485	    // per the generated-column definition (needs_review = review_required AND !reviewed).
   486	    else reviewedManually++;
   487	  }
   488	
   489	  return { autoAccepted, needsReview, reviewedManually, total: occurrences.length };
   490	}
   491	
   492	export function aggregatePredictionSourceSplit(
   493	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[]
   494	): PredictionSourceSplit[] {
   495	  const buckets = new Map<string, { count: number; scoreSum: number }>();
   496	
   497	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   498	    let bucket = buckets.get(occ.predictionSource);
   499	    if (!bucket) {
   500	      bucket = { count: 0, scoreSum: 0 };
   501	      buckets.set(occ.predictionSource, bucket);
   502	    }
   503	    bucket.count += 1;
   504	    bucket.scoreSum += occ.top1Score;
   505	  }
   506	
   507	  return Array.from(buckets.entries())
   508	    .map(([predictionSource, b]) => ({
   509	      predictionSource,
   510	      count: b.count,
   511	      avgTop1Score: b.count > 0 ? b.scoreSum / b.count : 0,
   512	    }))
   513	    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
   514	}
   515	
   516	// Fixed 10 bins over top1_score (0.0-1.0), ASCENDING order — a confidence
   517	// histogram reads left-to-right by increasing confidence, not by which bin
   518	// happens to have the most rows.
   519	export function aggregateConfidenceHistogram(
   520	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   521	  bucketSize = 0.1
   522	): ConfidenceBucket[] {
   523	  const bucketCount = Math.round(1 / bucketSize);
   524	  const counts = new Array(bucketCount).fill(0) as number[];
   525	
   526	  for (const occ of occurrences) {
   527	    const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(occ.top1Score, 0), 1);
   528	    const index = Math.min(Math.floor(clamped / bucketSize), bucketCount - 1);
   529	    counts[index] += 1;
   530	  }
   531	
   532	  return counts.map((count, index) => {
   533	    const start = index * bucketSize;
   534	    const end = start + bucketSize;
   535	    return {
   536	      bucketLabel: `${start.toFixed(1)}–${end.toFixed(1)}`,
   537	      bucketStart: start,
   538	      count,
   539	    };
   540	  });
   541	}
   542	
   543	// Lowest-margin (most ambiguous between top1/top2 category) unreviewed
   544	// predictions first — a worklist for whoever triages the review queue.
   545	export function selectAmbiguousPredictions(
   546	  occurrences: ItemOccurrence[],
   547	  limit = 20
   548	): ItemOccurrence[] {
   549	  return [...occurrences]
   550	    .filter((occ) => !occ.reviewed)
   551	    .sort((a, b) => a.margin - b.margin)
   552	    .slice(0, limit);
   553	}

    15	export function ApKpiTiles({ invoices, asOfDate }: ApKpiTilesProps) {
    16	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.ap");
    17	  const locale = useLocale();
    18	
    19	  const { totalPayables, overdueTotal, dueSoonTotal } = useMemo(() => {
    20	    let totalPayables = 0;
    21	    let overdueTotal = 0;
    22	    let dueSoonTotal = 0;

    48	        </CardContent>

    51	      <Card className={overdueTotal > 0 ? "border-l-4 border-l-red-500" : undefined}>
    52	        <CardHeader className="pb-2">

    54	            {t("overdueTotal")}
    55	          </CardTitle>

    59	        </CardContent>
    60	      </Card>
    61	
    62	      <Card className={dueSoonTotal > 0 ? "border-l-4 border-l-amber-500" : undefined}>
    63	        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
    64	          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
    65	            {t("dueSoonTotal")}
    66	          </CardTitle>

    38	        </CardContent>

    43	          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
    44	            {t("needsReview")}
    45	          </CardTitle>
    46	        </CardHeader>
    47	        <CardContent>
    48	          <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{summary.needsReview.toLocaleString()}</div>
    49	        </CardContent>
    50	      </Card>
    51	
    52	      <Card>
    53	        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
    54	          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
    55	            {t("reviewedManually")}
    56	          </CardTitle>
    57	        </CardHeader>
    58	        <CardContent>
    59	          <div className="text-3xl font-bold">{summary.reviewedManually.toLocaleString()}</div>
    60	        </CardContent>
    61	      </Card>
    62	
    63	      <Card>
    64	        <CardHeader className="pb-2">
    65	          <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">

     8	const SWATCHES = ["bg-blue-500", "bg-purple-500", "bg-emerald-500"];
     9	
    10	/**
    11	 * Net + IVA + exempt composition of invoice totals.
    12	 *
    13	 * These three are invoice-level columns, so they're summed over invoices, not
    14	 * lines. Percentages are taken against the summed total_amount; if the source
    15	 * documents don't balance exactly the parts simply won't reach 100%, which is
    16	 * shown rather than normalized away.
    17	 */
    18	export function FiscalBreakdown({ kpis, linesReady }: { kpis: KpiData; linesReady: boolean }) {
    19	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.fiscal");
    20	  const clp = useCLP();
    21	
    22	  const rows = [
    23	    { label: t("net"), value: kpis.netAmount },
    24	    { label: t("iva"), value: kpis.ivaAmount },
    25	    { label: t("exempt"), value: kpis.exemptAmount },
    26	  ];
    27	
    28	  return (
    29	    <SectionCard title={t("title")} description={t("subtitle")}>
    30	      <div className="space-y-4">
    31	        {rows.map((row, index) => {
    32	          const pct = kpis.totalRevenue > 0 ? (row.value / kpis.totalRevenue) * 100 : 0;
    33	          return (
    34	            <div key={row.label}>
    35	              <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 mb-1.5">
    36	                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
    37	                  <span className={`size-2 rounded-full shrink-0 ${SWATCHES[index]}`} />
    38	                  <span className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{row.label}</span>
    39	                </div>
    40	                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 ml-auto">
    41	                  <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">
    42	                    {clp.full(row.value)}
    43	                  </span>
    44	                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums shrink-0">
    45	                    {pct.toFixed(1)}%
    46	                  </span>
    47	                </div>
    48	              </div>
    49	              <Progress value={Math.min(100, pct)} className="h-2" />
    50	            </div>
    51	          );
    52	        })}
    53	
    54	        <div className="pt-3 border-t flex flex-wrap justify-between items-baseline gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5">
    55	          <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{t("total")}</span>
    56	          <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap ml-auto">
    57	            {clp.full(kpis.totalRevenue)}
    58	          </span>
    59	        </div>
    60	
    61	        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-1">
    62	          <MiniStat label={t("invoices")} value={clp.num(kpis.totalInvoices)} />
    63	          <MiniStat
    64	            label={t("avg")}
    65	            value={clp.compact(kpis.avgInvoiceValue)}
    66	            exact={clp.full(kpis.avgInvoiceValue)}
    67	          />
    68	          <MiniStat label={t("lines")} value={linesReady ? clp.num(kpis.totalLines) : "—"} />
    69	        </div>
    70	
    71	        {linesReady && (kpis.discountTotal > 0 || kpis.recargoTotal > 0) && (
    72	          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
    73	            <MiniStat
    74	              label={t("discounts")}
    75	              value={clp.compact(kpis.discountTotal)}

    96	function MiniStat({ label, value, exact }: { label: string; value: string; exact?: string }) {

     2	
     3	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
