     5	import { EmptyState, MeterRow, SectionCard, useCLP } from "./primitives";
     6	import type { CounterpartyMetric } from "@/lib/analytics/aggregate";
     7	import type { TransactionTypeFilter } from "@/lib/analytics/filters";
     8	
     9	interface CounterpartyPanelProps {
    10	  metrics: CounterpartyMetric[];
    11	  role: "seller" | "buyer";
    12	  /** Selects that company in the global filter, when we can resolve its id. */
    13	  onSelect?: (companyId: string) => void;
    14	  /** The active global Type filter, which changes what this panel contains. */
    15	  transactionType: TransactionTypeFilter;
    16	}
    17	
    18	/**
    19	 * Resolves the heading and caption from the role AND the active Type filter.
    20	 *
    21	 * "Seller" is not a stable concept: on a purchase invoice it is a supplier, on
    22	 * a sales invoice it is our own organisation. A fixed heading over content
    23	 * that changes with the filter is what made this panel read as wrong — it was
    24	 * ranking our own revenue against our suppliers' invoices in one column and
    25	 * calling the whole thing "Top Sellers".
    26	 */
    27	function resolveScope(role: "seller" | "buyer", type: TransactionTypeFilter) {
    28	  if (type === "COMPRAS") {
    29	    return role === "seller"
    30	      ? { title: "topSuppliers", hint: "hintSuppliers" }
    31	      : { title: "topBuyersSelf", hint: "hintBuyersSelf" };
    32	  }
    33	  if (type === "VENTAS") {
    34	    return role === "seller"
    35	      ? { title: "topSellersSelf", hint: "hintSellersSelf" }
    36	      : { title: "topCustomers", hint: "hintCustomers" };
    37	  }
    38	  // Type = All pools both directions, so each side necessarily contains our
    39	  // own organisation. Name it for what it literally is and say so.
    40	  return role === "seller"
    41	    ? { title: "topIssuers", hint: "hintIssuersAll" }
    42	    : { title: "topRecipients", hint: "hintRecipientsAll" };
    43	}
    44	
    45	export function CounterpartyPanel({
    46	  metrics,
    47	  role,
    48	  onSelect,
    49	  transactionType,
    50	}: CounterpartyPanelProps) {
    51	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.counterparties");
    52	  const clp = useCLP();
    53	
    54	  const max = metrics.length > 0 ? metrics[0].totalAmount : 1;
    55	  const scope = resolveScope(role, transactionType);
    56	
    57	  return (
    58	    <SectionCard title={t(scope.title)} description={t(scope.hint)}>
    59	      {metrics.length === 0 ? (
    60	        <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />
    61	      ) : (
    62	        <div className="space-y-1">
    63	          {metrics.map((m, index) => (
    64	            <MeterRow
    65	              key={m.rut}
    66	              rank={index + 1}
    67	              primary={m.name}
    68	              secondary={[
    69	                t("invoices", { count: m.invoiceCount }),
    70	                t("avg", { value: clp.compact(m.avgAmount) }),
    71	                m.giro ?? "",
    72	              ]
    73	                .filter(Boolean)
    74	                .join(" · ")}
    75	              value={clp.compact(m.totalAmount)}
    76	              exact={clp.full(m.totalAmount)}
    77	              fraction={max > 0 ? m.totalAmount / max : 0}
    78	              badge={
    79	                m.city ? (
    80	                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 font-normal">
    81	                    {m.city}
    82	                  </Badge>
    83	                ) : undefined
    84	              }
    85	              onClick={m.companyId && onSelect ? () => onSelect(m.companyId as string) : undefined}
    86	            />
    87	          ))}
    88	        </div>
    89	      )}
    90	    </SectionCard>
    91	  );
    92	}

    28	function formatPeriod(period: string, locale: string): string {
    29	  // period is "YYYY-MM" straight off the generated column.
    30	  const [year, month] = period.split("-");
    31	  if (!year || !month) return period;
    32	  return new Date(Number(year), Number(month) - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString(locale, {
    33	    month: "short",
    34	    year: "2-digit",
    35	  });
    36	}

    39

    42	      ? `${(e.city || t("unknown")).slice(0, 12)}…`

    46	    const map = new Map<string, InvoiceItem[]>();

    46	export function ModelTab({
    47	  items,
    48	  sourceMetrics,
    49	  invoicesById,
    50	  categoriesById,
    51	  catalogById,
    52	}: ModelTabProps) {
    53	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.model");
    54	  const clp = useCLP();
    55	
    56	  const distribution = useMemo(() => aggregateScoreDistribution(items), [items]);
    57	  const queue = useMemo(
    58	    () => selectReviewQueue(items, invoicesById, 30),
    59	    [items, invoicesById]
    60	  );
    61	
    62	  const modelVersions = useMemo(() => {
    63	    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    64	    for (const item of items) {
    65	      if (!item.model_version) continue;
    66	      counts.set(item.model_version, (counts.get(item.model_version) ?? 0) + 1);
    67	    }
    68	    return Array.from(counts.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
    69	  }, [items]);
    70	
    71	  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    72	    let reviewed = 0;
    73	    let corrected = 0;
    74	    let scoreSum = 0;
    75	    for (const item of items) {
    76	      if (item.reviewed) reviewed += 1;
    77	      if (item.final_categories_id && item.final_categories_id !== item.predicted_categories_id) {
    78	        corrected += 1;
    79	      }
    80	      scoreSum += item.top1_score;
    81	    }
    82	    return {
    83	      reviewed,
    84	      corrected,
    85	      // Of the lines a human actually looked at, how many did the model get
    86	      // wrong — the only honest accuracy signal available here, since
    87	      // unreviewed lines have no ground truth.
    88	      correctionRate: reviewed > 0 ? (corrected / reviewed) * 100 : null,
    89	      avgScore: items.length > 0 ? scoreSum / items.length : 0,
    90	    };
    91	  }, [items]);
    92	
    93	  const config: ChartConfig = { count: { label: t("lines"), theme: CHART_SERIES[0] } };
    94	
    95	  if (items.length === 0) return <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />;
    96	
    97	  return (
    98	    <div className="space-y-4">
    99	      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   100	        <StatCard label={t("avgConfidence")} value={clp.pct(summary.avgScore * 100)} />
   101	        <StatCard label={t("reviewedLines")} value={clp.num(summary.reviewed)} />
   102	        <StatCard
   103	          label={t("correctionRate")}
   104	          value={summary.correctionRate === null ? "—" : clp.pct(summary.correctionRate)}
   105	          tone={summary.correctionRate !== null && summary.correctionRate > 20 ? "warning" : "default"}
   106	          hint={t("correctionRateHint")}
   107	        />
   108	        <StatCard
   109	          label={t("modelVersion")}
   110	          value={modelVersions[0]?.[0] ?? "—"}
   111	          hint={
   112	            modelVersions.length > 1 ? t("multipleVersions", { count: modelVersions.length }) : undefined
   113	          }
   114	        />
   115	      </div>
   116	
   117	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
   118	        <SectionCard title={t("confidenceTitle")} description={t("confidenceHint")}>
   119	          <ChartContainer config={config} className="aspect-auto h-[240px] w-full">
   120	            <BarChart data={distribution} margin={{ left: 4, right: 8 }}>
   121	              <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
   122	              <XAxis
   123	                dataKey="bucket"
   124	                tickLine={false}
   125	                axisLine={false}
   126	                tick={{ fontSize: 9 }}
   127	                interval={0}
   128	              />
   129	              <YAxis tickLine={false} axisLine={false} width={44} tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} allowDecimals={false} />
   130	              <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
   131	              <Bar dataKey="count" fill="var(--color-count)" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} />
   132	            </BarChart>
   133	          </ChartContainer>
   134	        </SectionCard>
   135	
   136	        <SectionCard title={t("sourcesTitle")} description={t("sourcesHint")}>
   137	          <div className="space-y-3">
   138	            {sourceMetrics.map((s) => {
   139	              const key = SOURCE_KEYS[s.source];
   140	              return (

     2	
     3	import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
     4	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     5	import { AlertTriangle, Info, ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react";
     6	import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
     7	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
     8	import {
     9	  Table,
    10	  TableBody,
    11	  TableCell,
    12	  TableHead,
    13	  TableHeader,
    14	  TableRow,
    15	} from "@/components/ui/table";
    16	import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
    17	import { EmptyState, SectionCard, StatCard, useCLP } from "../primitives";
    18	import type { Anomaly, AnomalySeverity } from "@/lib/analytics/ai-engine";
    19	
    20	interface RiskTabProps {
    21	  anomalies: Anomaly[];
    22	}
    23	
    24	const SEVERITY_STYLE: Record<AnomalySeverity, { badge: string; icon: typeof Info }> = {
    25	  critical: { badge: "bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 border-red-500/30", icon: ShieldAlert },
    26	  warning: { badge: "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 border-amber-500/30", icon: AlertTriangle },
    27	  info: { badge: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border", icon: Info },
    28	};
    29	
    30	
    31	export function RiskTab({ anomalies }: RiskTabProps) {
    32	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.risk");
    33	  const clp = useCLP();
    34	  const [severityFilter, setSeverityFilter] = useState<AnomalySeverity | "all">("all");
    35	
    36	  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    37	    const byType = new Map<string, number>();
    38	    let critical = 0;
    39	    let warning = 0;
    40	    let info = 0;
    41	    for (const a of anomalies) {
    42	      byType.set(a.type, (byType.get(a.type) ?? 0) + 1);
    43	      if (a.severity === "critical") critical += 1;
    44	      else if (a.severity === "warning") warning += 1;
    45	      else info += 1;
    46	    }
    47	    return { byType: Array.from(byType.entries()).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]), critical, warning, info };
    48	  }, [anomalies]);
    49	
    50	  const visible = useMemo(
    51	    () =>
    52	      (severityFilter === "all"
    53	        ? anomalies
    54	        : anomalies.filter((a) => a.severity === severityFilter)
    55	      ).slice(0, 60),
    56	    [anomalies, severityFilter]
    57	  );
    58	
    59	  // The three pipeline cases below are unreachable on the client surface —
    60	  // detectAnomalies no longer emits them — but the switch must stay
    61	  // exhaustive over AnomalyType, which still declares them for whoever
    62	  // enables includePipelineSignals.
    63	  const describe = (a: Anomaly): string => {
    64	    switch (a.type) {
    65	      case "outlier_amount":
    66	        return t("descOutlierAmount", {
    67	          folio: String(a.context.folio),
    68	          seller: String(a.context.seller),
    69	          direction: t(a.context.direction === "above" ? "above" : "below"),
    70	          z: a.zScore.toFixed(2),
    71	        });
    72	      case "high_entropy":
    73	        return t("descHighEntropy", {
    74	          item: String(a.context.itemText).slice(0, 48),
    75	          entropy: String(a.context.entropy),
    76	        });
    77	      case "low_confidence":
    78	        return t("descLowConfidence", {
    79	          item: String(a.context.itemText).slice(0, 48),
    80	          pct: String(a.context.scorePct),
    81	        });
    82	      case "ambiguous_margin":
    83	        return t("descAmbiguous", {
    84	          item: String(a.context.itemText).slice(0, 48),
    85	          margin: String(a.context.margin),
    86	          predicted: String(a.context.predicted),
    87	        });
    88	      case "price_spike":
    89	        return t("descPriceSpike", {
    90	          item: String(a.context.itemText).slice(0, 40),
    91	          paid: clp.full(Number(a.context.paid)),
    92	          usual: clp.full(Number(a.context.usual)),
    93	        });
    94	      case "missing_due_date":
    95	        return t("descMissingDueDate", {
    96	          folio: String(a.context.folio),
    97	          seller: String(a.context.seller),
    98	        });
    99	    }
   100	  };
   101	
   102	  return (
   103	    <div className="space-y-4">
   104	      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   105	        <StatCard label={t("total")} value={clp.num(anomalies.length)} />
   106	        <StatCard label={t("critical")} value={clp.num(counts.critical)} tone={counts.critical > 0 ? "negative" : "default"} />
   107	        <StatCard label={t("warning")} value={clp.num(counts.warning)} tone={counts.warning > 0 ? "warning" : "default"} />
   108	        <StatCard label={t("info")} value={clp.num(counts.info)} />
   109	      </div>
   110	
   111	
   112	      <SectionCard
   113	        title={t("logTitle")}
   114	        description={t("logHint")}
   115	        action={
   116	          <div className="flex gap-1">
   117	            {(["all", "critical", "warning", "info"] as const).map((s) => (
   118	              <Button
   119	                key={s}
   120	                size="sm"
   121	                variant={severityFilter === s ? "default" : "outline"}
   122	                className="h-7 text-[11px] px-2"
   123	                onClick={() => setSeverityFilter(s)}
   124	              >
   125	                {t(s === "all" ? "all" : s)}
   126	              </Button>
   127	            ))}
   128	          </div>
   129	        }
   130	      >
   131	        {visible.length === 0 ? (
   132	          <EmptyState message={t("noAnomalies")} />
   133	        ) : (
   134	          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
   135	            <Table>
   136	              <TableHeader>
   137	                <TableRow>
   138	                  <TableHead className="w-[110px]">{t("severity")}</TableHead>
   139	                  <TableHead className="w-[130px]">{t("type")}</TableHead>
   140	                  <TableHead>{t("detail")}</TableHead>
   141	                  <TableHead className="text-right w-[80px]">{t("zScore")}</TableHead>
   142	                </TableRow>
   143	              </TableHeader>
   144	              <TableBody>
   145	                {visible.map((a) => {
   146	                  const style = SEVERITY_STYLE[a.severity];
   147	                  const Icon = style.icon;
   148	                  return (
   149	                    <TableRow key={a.id}>
   150	                      <TableCell>
   151	                        <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("text-[10px] gap-1", style.badge)}>
   152	                          <Icon className="size-3" />
   153	                          {t(a.severity)}
   154	                        </Badge>
   155	                      </TableCell>
   156	                      <TableCell>
   157	                        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
   158	                          {t(`type_${a.type}`)}
   159	                        </span>
   160	                      </TableCell>
   161	                      <TableCell>
   162	                        <span className="text-sm">{describe(a)}</span>
   163	                      </TableCell>
   164	                      <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   165	                        {a.zScore === 0 ? "—" : a.zScore.toFixed(2)}
   166	                      </TableCell>
   167	                    </TableRow>
   168	                  );
   169	                })}
   170	              </TableBody>
   171	            </Table>
   172	          </div>
   173	        )}
   174	      </SectionCard>
   175	    </div>
   176	  );
   177	}

src/app/[locale]/extractor/page.tsx
     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
     4	import { FileSearch, Download, BarChart3, Table2, Loader2, Zap } from "lucide-react";
     5	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     6	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
     7	import { FileUploader } from "@/components/extractor/file-uploader";
     8	import { SecurityConfigPanel } from "@/components/extractor/security-config-panel";
     9	import { ProcessingView } from "@/components/extractor/processing-view";
    10	import { ExtractedDataTable } from "@/components/extractor/extracted-data-table";
    11	import { CorrelationView } from "@/components/extractor/correlation-view";
    12	import { decodeFile, type DecodeResult, type SecurityConfig } from "@/lib/extractor/xml-decoder";
    13	import { parseXmlContent, type ParseResult } from "@/lib/extractor/xml-parser";
    14	import { exportToExcel } from "@/lib/extractor/excel-export";
    15	import { type FileEntry } from "@/lib/extractor/file-scanner";
    16	import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
    17	
    18	type ViewTab = "table" | "correlation";
    19	
    20	interface ProgressItem {
    21	  fileName: string;
    22	  status: "pending" | "decoding" | "parsing" | "done" | "error";
    23	  decodeResult?: DecodeResult;
    24	  rowCount?: number;
    25	  error?: string;
    26	}
    27	
    28	export default function ExtractorPage() {
    29	  const t = useTranslations("Extractor");
    30	
    31	  const [securityConfig, setSecurityConfig] = useState<SecurityConfig>({
    32	    password: "",
    33	    encodingType: "none",
    34	  });
    35	  const [fileEntries, setFileEntries] = useState<FileEntry[]>([]);
    36	  const [results, setResults] = useState<ParseResult[]>([]);
    37	  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
    38	  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ViewTab>("table");
    39	  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<ProgressItem[]>([]);
    40	
    41	  const handleFilesSelected = useCallback((entries: FileEntry[]) => {
    42	    setFileEntries(entries);
    43	  }, []);
    44	
    45	  const processFiles = useCallback(async () => {
    46	    if (fileEntries.length === 0) return;
    47	    setIsProcessing(true);
    48	    setResults([]);
    49	    setProgress(fileEntries.map((e) => ({ fileName: e.file.name, status: "pending" as const })));
    50	
    51	    const parsedResults: ParseResult[] = [];
    52	
    53	    for (let i = 0; i < fileEntries.length; i++) {
    54	      const entry = fileEntries[i];
    55	
    56	      setProgress((prev) =>
    57	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "decoding" as const } : p))
    58	      );
    59	
    60	      const decodeResult = await decodeFile(entry.file, securityConfig);
    61	
    62	      if (!decodeResult.success) {
    63	        setProgress((prev) =>
    64	          prev.map((p, j) =>
    65	            j === i ? { ...p, status: "error" as const, error: decodeResult.error, decodeResult } : p
    66	          )
    67	        );
    68	        parsedResults.push({
    69	          rows: [],
    70	          columns: [],
    71	          fileName: entry.file.name,
    72	          folderPath: entry.folderPath,
    73	          error: decodeResult.error,
    74	        });
    75	        continue;
    76	      }
    77	
    78	      setProgress((prev) =>
    79	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "parsing" as const, decodeResult } : p))
    80	      );
    81	
    82	      const xmlContents = decodeResult.content.split("\n<!-- SEPARATOR -->\n");
    83	
    84	      for (const xmlContent of xmlContents) {
    85	        const parsed = parseXmlContent(xmlContent, entry.file.name, entry.folderPath);
    86	        parsedResults.push(parsed);
    87	      }
    88	
    89	      const totalRows = parsedResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rows.length, 0);
    90	
    91	      setProgress((prev) =>
    92	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "done" as const, decodeResult, rowCount: totalRows } : p))
    93	      );
    94	    }
    95	
    96	    setResults(parsedResults);
    97	    setIsProcessing(false);
    98	  }, [fileEntries, securityConfig]);
    99	
   100	  const handleExport = useCallback(() => {
   101	    const validData = results.filter((r) => r.rows.length > 0);
   102	    if (validData.length === 0) return;
   103	    exportToExcel(validData, {
   104	      includeFileName: true,
   105	      includeFolderPath: true,
   106	      sheetName: "XML Data",
   107	      separateSheets: false,
   108	    });
   109	  }, [results]);
   110	
   111	  const validResults = results.filter((r) => r.rows.length > 0);
   112	  const totalRows = validResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rows.length, 0);
   113	
   114	  return (
   115	    <div className="max-w-full mx-auto py-8 px-4 space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
   116	      {/* Header */}
   117	      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
   118	        <div>
   119	          <h1 className="text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-3">
   120	            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-primary flex items-center justify-center">
   121	              <FileSearch className="w-5 h-5 text-primary-foreground" />
   122	            </div>
   123	            {t("title")}
   124	          </h1>
   125	          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2 text-lg italic">{t("subtitle")}</p>
   126	        </div>
   127	
   128	        {validResults.length > 0 && (
   129	          <Button size="lg" onClick={handleExport} className="gap-2 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300">
   130	            <Download className="size-5" />
   131	            {t("exportExcel")}
   132	          </Button>
   133	        )}
   134	      </div>
   135	
   136	      {/* Upload & Config Row */}
   137	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
   138	        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
   139	          <FileUploader onFilesSelected={handleFilesSelected} isProcessing={isProcessing} />
   140	        </div>
   141	        <div className="space-y-4">
   142	          <SecurityConfigPanel config={securityConfig} onChange={setSecurityConfig} />
   143	
   144	          <button
   145	            onClick={processFiles}
   146	            disabled={fileEntries.length === 0 || isProcessing}
   147	            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-sm"
   148	          >
   149	            {isProcessing ? (
   150	              <>
   151	                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
   152	                {t("processingLabel")}
   153	              </>
   154	            ) : (
   155	              <>
   156	                <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />
   157	                {fileEntries.length > 0
   158	                  ? t("processFilesCount", { count: fileEntries.length })
   159	                  : t("processFiles")}
   160	              </>
   161	            )}
   162	          </button>
   163	
   164	          {validResults.length > 0 && (
   165	            <div className="bg-card border rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2">
   166	              <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
   167	                {t("summary")}
   168	              </h3>
   169	              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
   170	                <div>
   171	                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{validResults.length}</p>
   172	                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("filesParsed")}</p>
   173	                </div>
   174	                <div>
   175	                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary">{totalRows}</p>
   176	                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{t("totalRows")}</p>
   177	                </div>
   178	              </div>
   179	            </div>
   180	          )}
   181	        </div>
   182	      </div>
   183	
   184	      {/* Processing Progress */}
   185	      {progress.length > 0 && <ProcessingView progress={progress} isProcessing={isProcessing} />}
   186	
   187	      {/* Results */}
   188	      {validResults.length > 0 && (
   189	        <div className="space-y-4">
   190	          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-card border rounded-xl p-1 w-fit">
   191	            <button
   192	              onClick={() => setActiveTab("table")}
   193	              className={cn(
   194	                "flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all",
   195	                activeTab === "table"
   196	                  ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-sm"
   197	                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
   198	              )}
   199	            >
   200	              <Table2 className="w-4 h-4" />
   201	              {t("tabs.table")}
   202	            </button>
   203	            <button
   204	              onClick={() => setActiveTab("correlation")}
   205	              className={cn(
   206	                "flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all",
   207	                activeTab === "correlation"
   208	                  ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-sm"
   209	                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
   210	              )}

     1	"use client";
     2	
     3	import { useCallback, useState } from "react";
     4	import { FileSearch, Download, BarChart3, Table2, Loader2, Zap } from "lucide-react";
     5	import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
     6	import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
     7	import { FileUploader } from "@/components/extractor/file-uploader";
     8	import { SecurityConfigPanel } from "@/components/extractor/security-config-panel";
     9	import { ProcessingView } from "@/components/extractor/processing-view";
    10	import { ExtractedDataTable } from "@/components/extractor/extracted-data-table";
    11	import { CorrelationView } from "@/components/extractor/correlation-view";
    12	import { decodeFile, type DecodeResult, type SecurityConfig } from "@/lib/extractor/xml-decoder";
    13	import { parseXmlContent, type ParseResult } from "@/lib/extractor/xml-parser";
    14	import { exportToExcel } from "@/lib/extractor/excel-export";
    15	import { type FileEntry } from "@/lib/extractor/file-scanner";
    16	import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
    17	
    18	type ViewTab = "table" | "correlation";
    19	
    20	interface ProgressItem {
    21	  fileName: string;
    22	  status: "pending" | "decoding" | "parsing" | "done" | "error";
    23	  decodeResult?: DecodeResult;
    24	  rowCount?: number;
    25	  error?: string;
    26	}
    27	
    28	export default function ExtractorPage() {
    29	  const t = useTranslations("Extractor");
    30	
    31	  const [securityConfig, setSecurityConfig] = useState<SecurityConfig>({
    32	    password: "",
    33	    encodingType: "none",
    34	  });
    35	  const [fileEntries, setFileEntries] = useState<FileEntry[]>([]);
    36	  const [results, setResults] = useState<ParseResult[]>([]);
    37	  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
    38	  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ViewTab>("table");
    39	  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<ProgressItem[]>([]);
    40	
    41	  const handleFilesSelected = useCallback((entries: FileEntry[]) => {
    42	    setFileEntries(entries);
    43	  }, []);
    44	
    45	  const processFiles = useCallback(async () => {
    46	    if (fileEntries.length === 0) return;
    47	    setIsProcessing(true);
    48	    setResults([]);
    49	    setProgress(fileEntries.map((e) => ({ fileName: e.file.name, status: "pending" as const })));
    50	
    51	    const parsedResults: ParseResult[] = [];
    52	
    53	    for (let i = 0; i < fileEntries.length; i++) {
    54	      const entry = fileEntries[i];
    55	
    56	      setProgress((prev) =>
    57	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "decoding" as const } : p))
    58	      );
    59	
    60	      const decodeResult = await decodeFile(entry.file, securityConfig);
    61	
    62	      if (!decodeResult.success) {
    63	        setProgress((prev) =>
    64	          prev.map((p, j) =>
    65	            j === i ? { ...p, status: "error" as const, error: decodeResult.error, decodeResult } : p
    66	          )
    67	        );
    68	        parsedResults.push({
    69	          rows: [],
    70	          columns: [],
    71	          fileName: entry.file.name,
    72	          folderPath: entry.folderPath,
    73	          error: decodeResult.error,
    74	        });
    75	        continue;
    76	      }
    77	
    78	      setProgress((prev) =>
    79	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "parsing" as const, decodeResult } : p))
    80	      );
    81	
    82	      const xmlContents = decodeResult.content.split("\n<!-- SEPARATOR -->\n");
    83	
    84	      for (const xmlContent of xmlContents) {
    85	        const parsed = parseXmlContent(xmlContent, entry.file.name, entry.folderPath);
    86	        parsedResults.push(parsed);
    87	      }
    88	
    89	      const totalRows = parsedResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rows.length, 0);
    90	
    91	      setProgress((prev) =>
    92	        prev.map((p, j) => (j === i ? { ...p, status: "done" as const, decodeResult, rowCount: totalRows } : p))
    93	      );
    94	    }
    95	
    96	    setResults(parsedResults);
    97	    setIsProcessing(false);
    98	  }, [fileEntries, securityConfig]);
    99	
   100	  const handleExport = useCallback(() => {
   101	    const validData = results.filter((r) => r.rows.length > 0);
   102	    if (validData.length === 0) return;
   103	    exportToExcel(validData, {
   104	      includeFileName: true,
   105	      includeFolderPath: true,
   106	      sheetName: "XML Data",
   107	      separateSheets: false,
   108	    });
   109	  }, [results]);
   110	
   111	  const validResults = results.filter((r) => r.rows.length > 0);
   112	  const totalRows = validResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rows.length, 0);
   113	
   114	  return (
   115	    <div className="max-w-full mx-auto py-8 px-4 space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
   116	      {/* Header */}
   117	      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
   118	        <div>
   119	          <h1 className="text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-3">
   120	            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-primary flex items-center justify-center">
   121	              <FileSearch className="w-5 h-5 text-primary-foreground" />
   122	            </div>
   123	            {t("title")}
   124	          </h1>
   125	          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2 text-lg italic">{t("subtitle")}</p>
   126	        </div>
   127	
   128	        {validResults.length > 0 && (
   129	          <Button size="lg" onClick={handleExport} className="gap-2 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300">
   130	            <Download className="size-5" />
   131	            {t("exportExcel")}
   132	          </Button>
   133	        )}
   134	      </div>
   135	
   136	      {/* Upload & Config Row */}
   137	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
   138	        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
   139	          <FileUploader onFilesSelected={handleFilesSelected} isProcessing={isProcessing} />
   140	        </div>
   141	        <div className="space-y-4">
   142	          <SecurityConfigPanel config={securityConfig} onChange={setSecurityConfig} />
   143	
   144	          <button
   145	            onClick={processFiles}
   146	            disabled={fileEntries.length === 0 || isProcessing}
   147	            className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-primary/90 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-sm"
   148	          >
   149	            {isProcessing ? (
   150	              <>
    30	  Table,
    31	  TableBody,
    32	  TableCell,
    33	  TableHead,
    34	  TableHeader,
    35	  TableRow,
    36	} from "@/components/ui/table";

    26	interface GeographyTabProps {
    27	  entries: GeoEntry[];

    29	}
    30	
    31	export function GeographyTab({ entries, onSelectCity }: GeographyTabProps) {
    32	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.geography");
    33	  const clp = useCLP();
    34	
    35	  if (entries.length === 0) return <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />;
    36	
    37	  const top = entries.slice(0, 12);
    38	  const max = entries[0]?.totalAmount ?? 1;
    39	
    40	  const chartData = top.map((e) => ({
    41	    name: (e.city || t("unknown")).length > 14
    42	      ? `${(e.city || t("unknown")).slice(0, 12)}…`
    43	      : e.city || t("unknown"),
    44	    ventas: e.ventas,
    45	    compras: e.compras,
    46	  }));
    47	
    48	  const config: ChartConfig = {
    49	    ventas: { label: t("sales"), theme: CHART_SERIES[0] },
    50	    compras: { label: t("purchases"), theme: CHART_SERIES[1] },
    51	  };
    52	
    53	  return (
    54	    <div className="space-y-4">
    55	      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
    56	        <SectionCard title={t("distributionTitle")} description={t("distributionHint")}>
    57	          <div className="space-y-1">
    58	            {top.map((e, i) => (
    59	              <MeterRow
    60	                key={e.city || `__unknown-${i}`}
    61	                rank={i + 1}
    62	                primary={e.city || t("unknown")}
    63	                secondary={`${t("invoices", { count: e.invoiceCount })} · ${t("counterparties", {
    64	                  count: e.counterparties,
    65	                })}`}
    66	                value={clp.compact(e.totalAmount)}
    67	                exact={clp.full(e.totalAmount)}
    68	                fraction={max > 0 ? e.totalAmount / max : 0}
    69	                onClick={e.city ? () => onSelectCity(e.city) : undefined}
    70	              />
    71	            ))}
    72	          </div>
    73	        </SectionCard>
    74	
    75	        <SectionCard title={t("splitTitle")} description={t("splitHint")}>
    76	          <ChartContainer config={config} className="aspect-auto h-[320px] w-full">
    77	            <BarChart data={chartData} layout="vertical" margin={{ left: 4, right: 8 }}>
    78	              <CartesianGrid horizontal={false} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
    79	              <XAxis
    80	                type="number"
    81	                tickLine={false}
    82	                axisLine={false}
    83	                tick={{ fontSize: 10 }}
    84	                tickFormatter={(v: number) => clp.compact(v)}
    85	              />
    86	              <YAxis
    87	                type="category"
    88	                dataKey="name"
    89	                tickLine={false}
    90	                axisLine={false}
    91	                width={96}
    92	                tick={{ fontSize: 10 }}
    93	              />
    94	              <ChartTooltip
    95	                content={
    96	                  <ChartTooltipContent
    97	                    formatter={(value, name) => [
    98	                      clp.full(value as number),
    99	                      typeof name === "string" && config[name]?.label ? config[name].label : name,
   100	                    ]}
   101	                  />
   102	                }
   103	              />
   104	              <Bar dataKey="ventas" stackId="a" fill="var(--color-ventas)" />
   105	              <Bar dataKey="compras" stackId="a" fill="var(--color-compras)" radius={[0, 3, 3, 0]} />
   106	              <ChartLegend content={<ChartLegendContent />} />
   107	            </BarChart>
   108	          </ChartContainer>
   109	        </SectionCard>
   110	      </div>
   111	
   112	      <SectionCard title={t("detailTitle")} description={t("detailHint")}>
   113	        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
   114	          <Table>
   115	            <TableHeader>
   116	              <TableRow>
   117	                <TableHead>{t("city")}</TableHead>
   118	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("total")}</TableHead>
   119	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("sales")}</TableHead>
   120	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("purchases")}</TableHead>
   121	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("invoicesCol")}</TableHead>
   122	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("counterpartiesCol")}</TableHead>
   123	              </TableRow>
   124	            </TableHeader>
   125	            <TableBody>
   126	              {entries.map((e, i) => (
   127	                <TableRow key={e.city || `__unknown-${i}`}>
   128	                  <TableCell>
   129	                    <span className="text-sm font-medium inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
   130	                      <MapPin className="size-3 text-muted-foreground" />
   131	                      {e.city || t("unknown")}
   132	                    </span>
   133	                  </TableCell>
   134	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm font-semibold">
   135	                    {clp.full(e.totalAmount)}
   136	                  </TableCell>
   137	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   138	                    {clp.full(e.ventas)}
   139	                  </TableCell>
   140	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
   141	                    {clp.full(e.compras)}
   142	                  </TableCell>
   143	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">{e.invoiceCount}</TableCell>
   144	                  <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">{e.counterparties}</TableCell>
   145	                </TableRow>
   146	              ))}
   147	            </TableBody>
   148	          </Table>
   149	        </div>
   150	      </SectionCard>
   151	    </div>
   152	  );

    30	const PAGE_SIZE = 25;
    31	
    32	export function ExplorerTab({
    33	  invoices,
    34	  items,
    35	  categoriesById,
    36	  companiesById,
    37	  catalogById,
    38	}: ExplorerTabProps) {
    39	  const t = useTranslations("Dashboard.explorer");
    40	  const clp = useCLP();
    41	  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
    42	  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
    43	  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Invoice | null>(null);
    44	
    45	  const itemsByInvoice = useMemo(() => {
    46	    const map = new Map<string, InvoiceItem[]>();
    47	    for (const item of items) {
    48	      const list = map.get(item.invoice_id);
    49	      if (list) list.push(item);
    50	      else map.set(item.invoice_id, [item]);
    51	    }
    52	    // Line order is meaningful on a document — preserve it.
    53	    for (const list of map.values()) {
    54	      list.sort((a, b) => a.invoice_line_number - b.invoice_line_number);
    55	    }
    56	    return map;
    57	  }, [items]);
    58	
    59	  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    60	    const needle = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    61	    const base = needle
    62	      ? invoices.filter(
    63	          (inv) =>
    64	            inv.invoice_folio.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
    65	            inv.seller_name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
    66	            inv.buyer_name.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
    67	            inv.seller_rut.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
    68	            inv.buyer_rut.toLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
    69	            (inv.receiver_internal_code ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(needle)
    70	        )
    71	      : invoices;
    72	    return [...base].sort((a, b) => b.invoice_date.localeCompare(a.invoice_date));
    73	  }, [invoices, search]);
    74	
    75	  const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    76	  const safePage = Math.min(page, pageCount - 1);
    77	  const visible = filtered.slice(safePage * PAGE_SIZE, (safePage + 1) * PAGE_SIZE);
    78	
    79	  const selectedLines = selected ? (itemsByInvoice.get(selected.invoice_id) ?? []) : [];
    80	
    81	  if (invoices.length === 0) return <EmptyState message={t("noData")} />;
    82	
    83	  return (
    84	    <div className="space-y-4">
    85	      <SectionCard
    86	        title={t("invoicesTitle")}
    87	        description={t("invoicesHint", { shown: filtered.length, total: invoices.length })}
    88	        action={
    89	          <div className="relative">
    90	            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
    91	            <Input
    92	              value={search}
    93	              onChange={(e) => {
    94	                setSearch(e.target.value);
    95	                setPage(0);
    96	              }}
    97	              placeholder={t("searchPlaceholder")}
    98	              className="h-8 w-[260px] pl-8 text-xs"
    99	            />
   100	          </div>
   101	        }
   102	      >
   103	        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
   104	          <Table>
   105	            <TableHeader>
   106	              <TableRow>
   107	                <TableHead>{t("date")}</TableHead>
   108	                <TableHead>{t("folio")}</TableHead>
   109	                <TableHead>{t("docType")}</TableHead>
   110	                <TableHead>{t("seller")}</TableHead>
   111	                <TableHead>{t("buyer")}</TableHead>
   112	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("net")}</TableHead>
   113	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("iva")}</TableHead>
   114	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("total")}</TableHead>
   115	                <TableHead className="text-right">{t("lines")}</TableHead>
   116	                <TableHead />
   117	              </TableRow>
   118	            </TableHeader>
   119	            <TableBody>
   120	              {visible.map((inv) => {
   121	                const lineCount = itemsByInvoice.get(inv.invoice_id)?.length ?? 0;
   122	                const isSelected = selected?.invoice_id === inv.invoice_id;
   123	                return (
   124	                  <TableRow
   125	                    key={inv.invoice_id}
   126	                    className={`cursor-pointer ${isSelected ? "bg-muted/50" : ""}`}
   127	                    onClick={() => setSelected(isSelected ? null : inv)}
   128	                  >
   129	                    <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
   130	                      {inv.invoice_date}
   131	                    </TableCell>
   132	                    <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">{inv.invoice_folio}</TableCell>
   133	                    <TableCell>
   134	                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] font-normal">
   135	                        {inv.document_type}
   136	                      </Badge>
   137	                    </TableCell>
   138	                    <TableCell className="max-w-[180px]">
   139	                      <span className="text-sm block truncate">{inv.seller_name}</span>
   140	                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">
   141	                        {inv.seller_rut}
   142	                      </span>
   143	                    </TableCell>
   144	                    <TableCell className="max-w-[180px]">

   164	                );
   165	              })}
   166	            </TableBody>

   229	 *  Postgres `numeric` can serialize as a string in some driver configurations,

   231	function num(value: unknown): number | null {
   232	  if (value === null || value === undefined) return null;
   233	  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
   234	  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;

   276	/**
   277	 * Flattens one `item_codes` entry to a display string.
   278	 *
   279	 * The column is untyped jsonb and really does contain objects — an electronic
   280	 * invoice's item code pairs a code type with its value. Rendering or keying on
   281	 * the raw entry yields "[object Object]", and two of those then collide as
   282	 * duplicate React keys. Prefer whatever looks like the value, and fall back to
   283	 * compact JSON so an unexpected shape is still visible rather than dropped.
   284	 */
   285	function normalizeItemCode(entry: unknown): string | null {
   286	  if (entry === null || entry === undefined) return null;
   287	  if (typeof entry === "string") return entry.trim() || null;
   288	  if (typeof entry === "number" || typeof entry === "boolean") return String(entry);
   289	
   290	  if (typeof entry === "object") {
   291	    const lower: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   292	    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(entry as Record<string, unknown>)) {
   293	      lower[k.toLowerCase()] = v;
   294	    }
   295	    // Match keys case-insensitively so casing drift between sources is fine.
   296	    const value = lower.vlrcodigo ?? lower.value ?? lower.codigo ?? lower.code ?? lower.valor;
   297	    const type = lower.tpocodigo ?? lower.type ?? lower.tipo;
   298	
   299	    if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== "") {
   300	      const valueStr = String(value).trim();
   301	      const typeStr = type === null || type === undefined ? "" : String(type).trim();
   302	      return typeStr ? `${typeStr}: ${valueStr}` : valueStr;
   303	    }
   304	
   305	    try {
   306	      return JSON.stringify(entry);
   307	    } catch {
   308	      return null;
   309	    }
   310	  }
   311	
   312	  return null;
   313	}

   315	function normalizeItemCodes(raw: unknown): string[] {
   316	  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
   317	  // Deduped: a repeated code on one line would otherwise become a duplicate
   318	  // React key wherever the list is rendered.
   319	  const seen = new Set<string>();
   320	  for (const entry of raw) {
   321	    const code = normalizeItemCode(entry);
   322	    if (code) seen.add(code);
   323	  }
   324	  return Array.from(seen);
   325	}

   292	// Powers the dashboard: every invoice line within a date range (and
   293	// optionally restricted to COMPRAS/VENTAS), fully paginated — unlike
   294	// fetchItemOccurrences's browse-list use case, a BI dashboard's totals must
   295	// be complete for whatever range is selected, not a bounded sample.
   296	export async function fetchOccurrencesInRange(
   297	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   298	  { startDate, endDate, transactionTypes }: OccurrenceRangeParams
   299	): Promise<ItemOccurrence[]> {
   300	  const rows: RawOccurrenceRow[] = [];
   301	  let from = 0;
   302	
   303	  while (rows.length < HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT) {
   304	    let query = supabase
   305	      .from("invoice_items")
   306	      .select(OCCURRENCE_SELECT_RANGE)
   307	      .gte("invoice.invoice_date", startDate)
   308	      .lte("invoice.invoice_date", endDate)
   309	      .order("invoice_date", { referencedTable: "invoice", ascending: false })
   310	      .order("item_id", { ascending: true })
   311	      .range(from, from + OCCURRENCE_PAGE_SIZE - 1);
   312	
   313	    if (transactionTypes && transactionTypes.length > 0) {
   314	      query = query.in("invoice.transaction_type", transactionTypes);
   315	    }
   316	
   317	    const { data, error } = await query.returns<RawOccurrenceRow[]>();
   318	
   319	    if (error) {
   320	      console.log(
   321	        `[items] fetchOccurrencesInRange(${startDate}..${endDate}) failed:`,
   322	        error
   323	      );
   324	      throw error;
   325	    }
   326	
   327	    const page = data ?? [];
   328	    rows.push(...page);
   329	
   330	    if (page.length < OCCURRENCE_PAGE_SIZE) break; // last page reached
   331	    from += OCCURRENCE_PAGE_SIZE;
   332	  }
   333	
   334	  if (rows.length >= HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT) {
   335	    console.log(
   336	      `[items] fetchOccurrencesInRange(${startDate}..${endDate}): hit the hard safety ` +
   337	        `limit of ${HARD_SAFETY_LIMIT} rows — narrow the range.`
   338	    );
   339	  }
   340	
   341	  return mapOccurrenceRows(
   342	    rows,
   343	    `fetchOccurrencesInRange(${startDate}..${endDate}${
   344	      transactionTypes?.length ? `, ${transactionTypes.join("/")}` : ""
   345	    })`
   346	  );
   347	}

   357	export async function fetchInvoiceDateBounds(

     8	// Small presentational pieces shared across every analytics tab, so the tabs
     9	// stay about *what* they show rather than repeating card/stat/bar markup.

    11	export function useCLP() {
    12	  const locale = useLocale();
    13	  return {
    14	    locale,
    15	    full: (value: number | null | undefined) =>
    16	      value === null || value === undefined
    17	        ? "—"
    18	        : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    19	            style: "currency",
    20	            currency: "CLP",
    21	            maximumFractionDigits: 0,
    22	          }).format(value),
    23	    /**
    24	     * Abbreviated form for places where space genuinely forces it — chart
    25	     * axis ticks and dense meter rows.
    26	     *
    27	     * This ROUNDS, and rounds to nearest, so it can overstate: 8,975,841,296
    28	     * renders as "$9.0B", a ~24M overstatement. That is fine for a scale
    29	     * marker and dangerous for a figure someone acts on, so it must never be
    30	     * the only representation of a value — pair it with `full` (as a visible
    31	     * exact line, a tooltip, or a title attribute) anywhere a reader might
    32	     * take a number from the screen.
    33	     */
    34	    compact: (value: number | null | undefined) => {
    35	      if (value === null || value === undefined) return "—";
    36	      const abs = Math.abs(value);
    37	      const sign = value < 0 ? "-" : "";
    38	      // Two decimals at B/M scale: at one decimal, 8,975,841,296 shows as
    39	      // "$9.0B" — a 24M overstatement. Two decimals brings that to ~4M
    40	      // (0.05%). K keeps one decimal since the worst case there is 50 CLP,
    41	      // and under 1,000 the value is already exact.
    42	      if (abs >= 1_000_000_000) return `${sign}$${(abs / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(2)}B`;
    43	      if (abs >= 1_000_000) return `${sign}$${(abs / 1_000_000).toFixed(2)}M`;
    44	      if (abs >= 1_000) return `${sign}$${(abs / 1_000).toFixed(1)}K`;
    45	      return `${sign}$${abs.toFixed(0)}`;
    46	    },
    47	    num: (value: number | null | undefined, digits = 0) =>
    48	      value === null || value === undefined
    49	        ? "—"
    50	        : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
    51	            maximumFractionDigits: digits,
    52	            minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    53	          }).format(value),
    54	    pct: (value: number | null | undefined, digits = 1) =>
    55	      value === null || value === undefined ? "—" : `${value.toFixed(digits)}%`,
    56	  };
    57	}

+# Frontend correctness audit — 2026-08-27
+
+**Scope.** Static, read-only audit of `milk-company` on `feature/catalog-name-standardisation`; no Supabase connection, build, package install, or source edit was performed. The live-data baseline used by this audit is corroborated by `ML-model/CLAUDE.md:6-14,38-46` and the post-P-01 catalog count by `ML-model/docs/STATE.md:76-84`.
+
+## Decisions this audit leaned on
+
+- **The review gate is the hard limit, not D-001.** A prediction is never a final business classification when `decision='review_required'`; the incident and the distinction from its root cause are stated in `ML-model/CLAUDE.md:52-61`. D-001 explains how an input-blind dedup key collapsed 47 distinct training texts; it is the incident's root cause, not the UI rule (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:18-40`).
+- **D-040:** consistent client filing outranks the model, so a UI must not silently promote a conflicting model prediction (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:850-875`).
+- **D-042:** `client_evidence_backfill` is not client provenance: none of its 612 rows has highest-trust client backing, and `prediction_source` must not be presented as authority (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:924-949`).
+- **D-044:** one real product or recurring service has one canonical catalog ID; spelling/spec/month variants do not create a new product (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:993-1010`).
+- **D-045:** the canonical migration was deliberately paged/idempotent and ended with 4,029 catalog rows before P-01 (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:1016-1049`); P-01 then reduced live `item_catalog` to 4,002 (`ML-model/docs/STATE.md:76-84`).
+- **D-043:** this section records the decisions before the report acts on them; the exception is appropriate because the audit is read-only and writes only this report (`ML-model/CLAUDE.md:68-70`).
+
+## Ranked findings
+
+1. **Wrong client numbers:** the analytics "Item Catalog" is actually distinct catalog IDs observed in the default 12-month invoice window, mixed-unit quantities and prices are added together, payment aging mixes receivables with payables, and a failed line fetch is converted into a successful empty dataset (`milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/items-tab.tsx:62-144,161-215`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/ai-engine.ts:529-608`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:132-154,391-455`).
+2. **Hard-rule violation:** two shared fallbacks promote predictions without checking `decision`; they feed live product tables, category KPIs, charts, filters and explorer rows (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:153-180`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/types.ts:133-144`). This is the exact known defect recorded as still untouched in `ML-model/docs/STATE.md:102-103`.
+3. **Performance:** `/productos` performs a full, wide, 11,746-line joined scan in 1,000-row pages, serializes it into a client component, then groups it into catalog rows in the browser (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:94-130,201-246`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/page.tsx:24-50`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/items-view.tsx:1-3,74-93`).
+4. **Dead code / polish:** `src/components/dashboard/**` is not mounted by the live route, `project/` is an excluded Vite mock, nine workflow routes are static stubs, and shared table chrome renders English in Spanish (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:21-36,266-276`; `milk-company/tsconfig.json:21-38`; `milk-company/src/components/ui/data-table-pagination.tsx:26-94`).
+
+---
+
+## 1. Review-gate violation
+
+### Confirmed break
+
+Both live data models contain the same unsafe rule:
+
+- `/productos`: `final_category ?? predicted_category` is chosen without inspecting `row.decision`, then copied into `categoryId`, `categoryCode`, and `categoryName` (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:153-180`).
+- analytics: `effectiveCategoryId` and `effectiveCategoryCode` return final-or-predicted without inspecting `item.decision` (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/types.ts:133-144`).
+
+For `auto_accept`, a predicted category may be used as the accepted result. For `review_required`, only a reviewed human final value may occupy a final-category field; otherwise the final field must be **Pending review / Unclassified**. A model code/name may still appear in a separately labelled **Model suggestion** field, but pending rows must be excluded from classified-category totals/shares or placed in an explicit pending-review bucket (`ML-model/CLAUDE.md:52-56`).
+
+### Every affected consumer in `src`
+

+### Checked and not violations
+
+- The disabled Model review queue filters to `needs_review` and labels the column **Predicted**, so it uses the prediction as a review hint rather than a final classification (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/aggregate.ts:353-368`; `milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/model-tab.tsx:160-175,206-229`).

Therefore there is no current review-gate export leak to list.

+
+## 2. Why the item catalog page is slow
+
+### Confirmed root cause
+
+The page is a full-table line-history scan masquerading as a paginated catalog browser:
+
+1. The server component starts `fetchItemOccurrences` alongside categories, companies and a count query (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/page.tsx:24-38`).
+2. `fetchItemOccurrences` requests **all** `invoice_items` in explicit 1,000-row ranges until a short page appears (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:4-14,212-246`). At the 11,746-line baseline this is **12 sequential data round-trips**, plus the count query and the parallel category/company requests (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:218-237,414-430`).
+3. Each line carries catalog, predicted and final category joins plus invoice and company fields (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:94-130`). The page does not render invoice net, IVA, exempt, total, due date, payment form, tax flag, score, margin, entropy, prediction source, discount or recargo in the catalog table, although those fields are transferred and mapped (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:81-87,103-123,181-196`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/columns.tsx:28-130`).
+4. The complete line array is serialized from the server component into a client component (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/page.tsx:44-50`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/items-view.tsx:1-3`). The browser filters it, groups by catalog ID, sorts every group, and only then lets TanStack paginate the resulting rows (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/items-view.tsx:74-93,235-305`; `milk-company/src/lib/items/group.ts:7-38`; `milk-company/src/components/ui/data-table.tsx:64-87`).
+
+This is not N+1: each 1,000-line page uses embedded PostgREST joins, not one query per catalog item (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:114-130,218-225`). It is not `select('*')`: the selection is explicit, but materially wider than the page needs (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:91-130`). It is not silent PostgREST truncation: `.range()` is present and loops (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:218-237`). The expensive JavaScript grouping is also work the database can do once, rather than every navigation (`milk-company/src/lib/items/group.ts:7-38`).
+
+No cache wrapper exists in the page or query path, and the Refresh button explicitly calls `router.refresh()`, causing the server scan again (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/page.tsx:24-50`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/items-view.tsx:53-71`). The reasoned cost is 11,746 wide joined rows fetched and serialized to display roughly 4,002 catalog rows, with 12 serial page latencies before grouping; no live timing is claimed because connecting to Supabase was prohibited (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:201-246`; `ML-model/docs/STATE.md:81-84`).
+
+### Smallest correct fix
+
+Page `item_catalog` directly with stable ordering and `.range()`; for only the visible catalog IDs, fetch a single batched occurrence summary/latest-row query. The better one-query form is a database view/RPC returning one row per canonical catalog ID with latest occurrence, company/category counts and review-safe category fields, already sorted and paginated. Either form changes the cost from 12 full-history requests plus browser grouping to one or two bounded requests per page and avoids N+1 (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:129-135` already demonstrates correctly paged direct catalog selection; `milk-company/src/lib/items/group.ts:7-38` defines the aggregation that should move server-side).
+
+---
+
+## 3. Why analytics shows ~3,500 items while catalog shows ~4,000
+
+### Exact query paths
+
+- **Analytics:** the route fetches the entire canonical catalog in pages, but only uses it as a name lookup (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/page.tsx:64-76`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:66-98,129-135`). The visible count is instead `Map(catalog_item_id)` over invoice lines in the active filter, then `aggregates.length` (`milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/items-tab.tsx:62-123,138-163`). Those lines are fetched through an inner invoice join constrained to the default 12-month range (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/page.tsx:25-44`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:156-192`).
+- **Catalog page:** it fetches every historical invoice line, then returns one group per referenced `catalog_item_id` (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:212-246`; `milk-company/src/lib/items/group.ts:7-38`). It does **not** actually count `item_catalog`; therefore a zero-history catalog row would be absent even there.
+
+### Causes checked
+
+| Candidate | Finding | Evidence |
+|---|---|---|
+| PostgREST 1,000/max-rows cap | Not the cause. Both paths repeatedly call `.range()` in 1,000-row pages. | `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:20-26,66-98,171-192`; `milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:4-14,218-237` |
+| Hard-coded `.limit()` / `.range()` ceiling | Not the cause. The analytics table display is sliced to 100, but its summary is calculated before that slice; fetch safety limits are 200,000/100,000. | `milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/items-tab.tsx:125-144`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:20-26`; `milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:7-14` |
+| Different filters | **Actual cause.** Analytics defaults to the latest 12 months and all other filters further narrow its line set; `/productos` scans all history. | `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/page.tsx:25-44`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/filters.ts:28-38,128-152`; `milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:201-246` |
+| Name deduplication | Not the cause. Both group by `catalog_item_id`, not item name. | `milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/items-tab.tsx:62-80`; `milk-company/src/lib/items/group.ts:7-20` |
+| Inner join drops rows with no lines in range | **Yes; this is how the date filter takes effect.** Analytics starts from `invoice_items` and inner-joins date-matching invoices rather than seeding from catalog. | `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:156-192` |
+| Active/deleted or transaction/review filter mismatch | No such default filter. Transaction and review default to `ALL`; no active/deleted predicate exists in either query. | `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/filters.ts:28-38`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:171-190`; `milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:218-225` |
+
+The canonical catalog total should be **4,002** on both surfaces whenever the label means “catalog” (`ML-model/docs/STATE.md:81-84`; D-044 defines the ID semantics at `ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:993-1010`). If analytics intentionally retains its current formula, its value should remain the distinct catalog IDs with invoice lines in the selected range—approximately the observed 3,500—but the tile and section must be renamed **Active items in current filters**, not **Distinct Items / Item Catalog** (`milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/items-tab.tsx:138-163`; Spanish labels at `milk-company/messages/es.json:1074-1082`). The `/productos` count should come from direct `item_catalog` paging, not be inferred from historical lines (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:129-135`).
+

+## 5. Mock and dead code
+
+### `project/` and the legacy dashboard tree
+
+`project/` is a standalone Vite app with its own scripts (`milk-company/project/package.json:1-10`), its app imports `@/data/mockData` (`milk-company/project/src/App.tsx:10-25`), and that data is generated from a deterministic pseudo-random fixture (`milk-company/project/src/data/mockData.ts:3-13`). The Next TypeScript config maps `@/*` to `src/*` and explicitly excludes `project` (`milk-company/tsconfig.json:21-38`). No live `src/` file imports `project/`; the import direction stays inside the prototype (`milk-company/project/src/hooks/useAnalytics.ts:1-2`; `milk-company/project/src/hooks/useAIEngine.ts:1-2`). It is dead with respect to the deployed Next app.
+
+The `src/components/dashboard/**` tree is also orphaned: its tabs import one another internally (`milk-company/src/components/dashboard/tabs/overview-tab.tsx:5-13`; `milk-company/src/components/dashboard/tabs/spend-analysis-tab.tsx:3-7`), while the actual route imports only `components/analytics/**` (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:21-36`). It should not be described as a second live dashboard surface.
+
+### Real product routes vs unfinished stubs
+
+| Route | Status | Evidence |
+|---|---|---|
+| `/dashboard` | **Real Supabase product** | Server fetches categories/companies/catalog/invoices; browser fetches dated lines (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/page.tsx:47-76`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:132-156`). |
+| `/productos`, `/productos/[id]/historial` | **Real Supabase product** | Server queries live tables and sends occurrences/catalog item to views (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/page.tsx:24-50`; `milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:212-268,439-462`). |

+| `/inventario` | **Unfinished mock route** | Six in-file inventory fixtures, derived low-stock count, hardcoded pending-orders `2` and value `$4.2M` (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/inventario/page.tsx:30-122,124-131,150-205`). |

+
+- The reachable order-detail URL uses `MOCK_PRODUCTS`, computes a mock total, and renders raw English controls/table labels (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/[id]/ordenes/[orderId]/page.tsx:37-65,78-82,94-150`); the fixture lives at `milk-company/src/lib/products-data.ts:38-109`.

+- Every shared DataTable renders raw English selection, page-size, page count and navigation accessibility text (`milk-company/src/components/ui/data-table-pagination.tsx:26-94`; the component is mounted at `milk-company/src/components/ui/data-table.tsx:64-87`).
+- Mobile sidebar accessibility text and the dashboard loading announcement are raw English (`milk-company/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx:198-200`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/loading.tsx:13-16`).

+## 6. Correctness risks below the metrics
+
+### Confirmed broken
+
+**Authorization is cosmetic beyond “has a session.”** Middleware checks only whether a session exists; it never checks `ROLE_PERMISSIONS` (`milk-company/src/middleware.ts:35-58`). Roles default to ADMIN, are changed by a header labelled demo, and only filter sidebar links in client state (`milk-company/src/components/header.tsx:30-38,89-109`; `milk-company/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx:37-67`). Therefore any authenticated user can request any localized route regardless of the simulated role (`milk-company/src/lib/roles.ts:18-87`; `milk-company/src/middleware.ts:61-64`).
+
+**The dashboard hides line-fetch failures as zeros/empty data.** The catch branch stores an error but sets `linesReady=true`, which bypasses `PendingLines` and renders the line-dependent components over `items=[]` (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:132-154,391-455`; `milk-company/src/components/analytics/pending-lines.tsx:16-37`).
+
+**Schema typing has drifted from production.** `PredictionSource` says the database permits exactly three values, while backend ground truth says all eight are live (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/types.ts:11-12`; `ML-model/CLAUDE.md:10-14`). The runtime cast does not validate the value (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:350-364`).
+
+**City drill semantics are inconsistent.** Geography attributes each invoice to the direction-aware counterparty city, but clicking that city activates a filter matching either seller or buyer city; the drill can therefore include invoices not counted in the clicked bar (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/ai-engine.ts:622-657`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/filters.ts:47-67`).
+
+### Might be broken; checks required
+
+**RLS cannot be verified from this repository.** Browser and server clients use the normal session/anon-key helpers; no service-role key is embedded in application code (`milk-company/src/lib/supabase/client.ts:1-5`; `milk-company/src/lib/supabase/server.ts:1-18`). That is the correct architecture for user-scoped reads—service role must never be put in the browser—but it is safe only if production has appropriate authenticated SELECT policies. The checked-in backend DDL enables RLS and grants CRUD only to `service_role`, with no authenticated/anon policy in that file (`ML-model/Temp_Inference/normalized_company_item_schema.sql:198-222`). Check production with a read-only policy inventory such as `pg_policies` plus table grants; do not infer protection from middleware, because direct PostgREST access is governed by RLS, not Next routing.
+
+**Middleware trusts `getSession()` for route gating.** It reads a cookie-backed session rather than asking Supabase Auth to verify the user (`milk-company/src/middleware.ts:35-40`). Production should verify whether the library version cryptographically validates/refreshed tokens here; use `getUser()` for an authoritative server check if it does not. Even a route-gate bypass must still be stopped by RLS.
+
+**JavaScript numeric range.** Analytics defensively converts numeric/string values and rejects non-finite results before summing (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:228-239,267-270,327-365`). It still uses IEEE-754 `number`; values beyond `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` would lose CLP pesos, though no evidence in the repository shows totals that large. The product query path relies on typed PostgREST values without the same runtime conversion (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:52-89,153-197`). Check maximum line/invoice totals and aggregate magnitudes in SQL.
+
+### Money
+
+- Live analytics sums unrounded numeric values and rounds only in formatting; CLP output explicitly has zero fractional digits (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/aggregate.ts:76-128`; `milk-company/src/components/analytics/primitives.tsx:15-22`). No pre-sum rounding or average-of-averages was found in the live metrics.
+- Weighted averages divide summed amount by summed quantity after accumulation (`milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/items-tab.tsx:82-108`). Its ordering is correct, but the result is wrong when units are mixed, as recorded in the metric inventory.
+- Product/history pages use locale-unspecified `$${value.toLocaleString()}` rather than CLP currency formatting (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/items-view.tsx:39-50`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/columns.tsx:12-23`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/[id]/historial/columns.tsx:10-21`). This can imply another dollar currency and can show decimals; it should use the existing zero-decimal CLP formatter (`milk-company/src/lib/dashboard/format.ts:1-11`).
+
+### i18n
+
+No missing dictionary path was found: a recursive key comparison produced 949 scalar paths in each of `messages/es.json` and `messages/en.json`, with empty `es_only` and `en_only` sets (`milk-company/messages/es.json:1`; `milk-company/messages/en.json:1`). Literal `t("...")` calls also resolved in the static check. The raw/untranslated strings that do render are the DataTable, sidebar, loading and mock order strings listed in section 5 (`milk-company/src/components/ui/data-table-pagination.tsx:26-94`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/[id]/ordenes/[orderId]/page.tsx:54-60,78-82,94-150`).
+
+### `any`, assertions and user-visible undefined/NaN risk
+
+- Locale validation uses `as any` in both request config and layout, weakening compile-time checking but not directly creating a user-visible undefined value (`milk-company/src/i18n/request.ts:4-15`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx:25-41`).
+- The demo role event accepts `e:any` and writes an unchecked role, after which `ROLE_PERMISSIONS[role].includes(...)` can throw if any script dispatches a malformed event (`milk-company/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx:37-67`). The current header dispatches only known select values, so this is a risk rather than a demonstrated failure (`milk-company/src/components/header.tsx:32-38,92-102`).
+- Product mapper non-null assertions are preceded by an explicit filter for catalog, invoice and company joins, so those assertions are locally safe (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:137-177`). Map assertions in payment aging are also initialized for every legal bucket before access (`milk-company/src/lib/analytics/ai-engine.ts:505-533,556-584`).
+- DataTable suppresses the type error for `row.children`; for rows without children this resolves to undefined and is accepted by TanStack, but the unchecked extension can mask a future row-shape error (`milk-company/src/components/ui/data-table.tsx:64-79`).
+
+---
+
+## The spec asks two wrong questions
+
+1. The audited package is **Next 16.1.1**, not Next 15 (`milk-company/package.json:20-35`). That matters because the server Supabase adapter contains a Next-16-specific async-cookie compatibility cast (`milk-company/src/lib/supabase/server.ts:4-18`).
+2. There are not two live dashboard surfaces. `src/components/analytics/**` is live, `src/components/dashboard/**` is orphaned, and `project/` is an excluded mock prototype (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:21-36`; `milk-company/tsconfig.json:21-38`; `milk-company/project/src/App.tsx:10-25`). Treating findings in all three as equally client-facing would overstate production impact.
+
+## Recommended order of repair (no repairs made)
+
+1. Replace both unsafe category fallbacks with one decision-aware resolver and use it before every render/filter/aggregate (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:153-180`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/types.ts:133-144`).
+2. Split **catalog total (4,002)** from **active items in current filters**, suppress mixed-unit quantity/price, preserve line-fetch error state, and scope payment aging by direction/status semantics (`milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/items-tab.tsx:62-215`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:132-154`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/ai-engine.ts:526-608`).
+3. Replace `/productos`' full history scan with paged catalog summaries (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:201-246`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/queries.ts:129-135`).
+4. Enforce real roles server-side, verify production RLS, remove or quarantine stub/dead surfaces, and localize shared controls (`milk-company/src/middleware.ts:35-58`; `milk-company/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx:37-67`; `ML-model/Temp_Inference/normalized_company_item_schema.sql:198-222`; `milk-company/src/components/ui/data-table-pagination.tsx:26-94`).

+# Frontend correctness audit — 2026-08-27
+
+**Scope.** Static, read-only audit of `milk-company` on `feature/catalog-name-standardisation`; no Supabase connection, build, package install, or source edit was performed. The live-data baseline used by this audit is corroborated by `ML-model/CLAUDE.md:6-14,38-46` and the post-P-01 catalog count by `ML-model/docs/STATE.md:76-84`.
+
+## Decisions this audit leaned on
+
+- **The review gate is the hard limit, not D-001.** A prediction is never a final business classification when `decision='review_required'`; the incident and the distinction from its root cause are stated in `ML-model/CLAUDE.md:52-61`. D-001 explains how an input-blind dedup key collapsed 47 distinct training texts; it is the incident's root cause, not the UI rule (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:18-40`).
+- **D-040:** consistent client filing outranks the model, so a UI must not silently promote a conflicting model prediction (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:850-875`).
+- **D-042:** `client_evidence_backfill` is not client provenance: none of its 612 rows has highest-trust client backing, and `prediction_source` must not be presented as authority (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:924-949`).
+- **D-044:** one real product or recurring service has one canonical catalog ID; spelling/spec/month variants do not create a new product (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:993-1010`).
+- **D-045:** the canonical migration was deliberately paged/idempotent and ended with 4,029 catalog rows before P-01 (`ML-model/docs/DECISIONS.md:1016-1049`); P-01 then reduced live `item_catalog` to 4,002 (`ML-model/docs/STATE.md:76-84`).
+- **D-043:** this section records the decisions before the report acts on them; the exception is appropriate because the audit is read-only and writes only this report (`ML-model/CLAUDE.md:68-70`).
+
+## Ranked findings
+
+1. **Wrong client numbers:** the analytics "Item Catalog" is actually distinct catalog IDs observed in the default 12-month invoice window, mixed-unit quantities and prices are added together, payment aging mixes receivables with payables, and a failed line fetch is converted into a successful empty dataset (`milk-company/src/components/analytics/tabs/items-tab.tsx:62-144,161-215`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/ai-engine.ts:529-608`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:132-154,391-455`).
+2. **Hard-rule violation:** two shared fallbacks promote predictions without checking `decision`; they feed live product tables, category KPIs, charts, filters and explorer rows (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:153-180`; `milk-company/src/lib/analytics/types.ts:133-144`). This is the exact known defect recorded as still untouched in `ML-model/docs/STATE.md:102-103`.
+3. **Performance:** `/productos` performs a full, wide, 11,746-line joined scan in 1,000-row pages, serializes it into a client component, then groups it into catalog rows in the browser (`milk-company/src/lib/items/queries.ts:94-130,201-246`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/page.tsx:24-50`; `milk-company/src/app/[locale]/productos/items-view.tsx:1-3,74-93`).
+4. **Dead code / polish:** `src/components/dashboard/**` is not mounted by the live route, `project/` is an excluded Vite mock, nine workflow routes are static stubs, and shared table chrome renders English in Spanish (`milk-company/src/app/[locale]/dashboard/dashboard-view.tsx:21-36,266-276`; `milk-company/tsconfig.json:21-38`; `milk-company/src/components/ui/data-table-pagination.tsx:26-94`).
+
